row.name: KOEGASURU
row.detailed_description: Create your own music video by controlling Hatsune Miku! The process of clearing the riddles is all recorded, so you will be able to create your own music video. Controles Move and click only! Easy and intuitive controls. Focus your cursor on suspicious objects and click on it. Once you clear the game, you can play a hidden mode⁉ An escape room game set in the music video 'KOEGASURU' by TEMPLIME! Introduction of Creators TEMPLIME TEMPLIME is a music unit consisting of composer KBSNK and DJ tempura . They began their activities in April 2019 and released their debut track “ Neon Light ,” featuring digital artist Toto Hoshimiya . In 2020, their album “Cloud Diver” ranked 4th on the Billboard Japan Download Albums Chart . Since then, they have been active in various collaborations, including an official remix for Vaundy , and providing tracks for artists and projects such as Tomori Kusunoki , Denkoubu , Kokonatsu 2.0 , and ExWHYZ . In March 2023, their track “Escapism” was selected for Porter Robinson’s playlist “cherished music” , gaining international attention. In 2024, they released “EMPT MILE” , their first full-length album as a solo project, continuing to pursue their musical activities with vigor. MOCHIDAIKOUGAKUBU A creative circle consisting of Zumochi, in charge of illustration and 3D modeling, and YuKiMuMa, responsible for programming, video production, and product development. Credits 【Game Design】 MOCHIDAIKOUGAKUBU　TEMPLIME 【Programming】 YuKiMuMa Zumochi SHI maru 【Art】 Zumochi YuKiMuMa Hiyori Kimura 【Sound】 KBSNK
row.short_description: Create your own music video by controlling Hatsune Miku! When you solve the 4 riddles, a music video will be created of you solving the riddles! It is an escape room game set in the music video 'KOEGASURU' by TEMPLIME!

row.name: Judgement Angel
row.detailed_description: 소개 Judgement Angel(심판천사)는 스토리 중심 어드벤처 게임입니다. RPG MAKER MV로 제작된 이 게임은 인간에 관한 다소 어두운 서사와 함께 다양한 선택지를 제공합니다. 폐허가 된 도시를 탐험하고, 그들의 흔적을 좇아 스스로의 ‘정의’를 시험해 보세요. 당신의 판단이 세상을 구원할 수도, 더욱 깊은 어둠으로 몰아넣을 수도 있습니다. 게임 스토리 신의 뜻을 실현하기 위해 내려온 천사. 그러나 인간들의 삶을 가까이서 마주하며 그의 신념에 변화가 찾아왔다. 죄인을 심판해야 한다는 사명과, 그들조차도 각자의 사연을 가진 존재임을 깨닫는 사이에서 선택의 순간이 다가오는 것. 그리고 당신이 내린 선택이 도시의 운명을 결정한다... 게임 요소 ■ 다중 선택 기반 스토리 – 플레이어의 선택에 따라 다른 결말이 펼쳐집니다. ■ 차분한 그래픽 – 한때 생기 넘쳤던 도시의 분위기를 한층 더 깊이 있게 표현. ■ 몰입감 넘치는 서사 – 사후의 그들이 남긴 삶에 있어서 선과 악에 대한 고민들. ■ 멀티엔딩 – 당신의 선택이 진정한 정의를 결정할수도, 혹은 변심할수도 있습니다.
row.short_description: 하늘의 명령에 따라 인간 세계로 내려온 천사. 오늘, 이 몰락한 도시에서 세 차례의 심판이 이뤄질 예정입니다. 당신이 믿는 ‘정의’가 끝까지 이뤄질 수 있기를.

row.name: Midnight Riff
row.detailed_description: Join The Community If you want to join the community or want the game to improve, the best way to do that is to join the official Discord! You can join Discord via the link on the Steam store page. About the Game Embark into Midnight Riff a casual rhythm adventure where you have to keep up and jam out to face the creatures that you meet along the way. Featuring a unique battle system incorporating dynamic, looped charts that allow the player to add notes that can defeat your enemies or lead to your own doom. Made for rhythm game regulars and roguelike enjoyers alike. Releasing soon for free! Features Jam out and place your own notes on the chart to outplay the creatures that impede your progress. Collect powerful relics to aid your journey and turn the tide of battle. Changing maps every playthrough to allow endless replayability.
row.short_description: Unlike anything seen before, Midnight Riff is a true rhythm roguelike. Vibe to the rhythm and jam out to deal damage and win battles with the unique active-time rhythm battle system. Can you become the rhythm of the night?

row.name: Bell & Hoof: The Silent Journey
row.detailed_description: Bell & Hoof: The Silent Journey is a tiny walking simulator where you play as a gentle cow wandering a sunlit field. There’s no combat, no puzzles — just a peaceful path to walk, a few bells to collect, and a chapel. 🐄 Explore a hand-crafted golden landscape 🔔 Find collectible bells hidden around the field 🚶‍♀️ Walk, moo, or do absolutely nothing at all This game is short, simple, and made with love. It’s under 10 minutes long — more of a vibe than a challenge. If you enjoy quiet moments, warm colors, and weirdly meditative cow energy, you might just like this.
row.short_description: A short walking simulator about a quiet cow, a forgotten chapel, and golden bells. Less than 10 minutes. No enemies. Just peace and hooves, and walking.

row.name: M.A.L.M.O : Scorched Earth
row.detailed_description: an Open World Game Set in Sweden during a fictional radioactive zombie apocalypse, An Iraqi Gun Dealer named Abdulaziz finds a supplier named Simon in Malmö, Sweden. in which a forced signage of a binding contract turns a simple gun deal into a nightmare scenario for Abdulaziz. This game's Movement is heavily inspired by CS:GO's and Half-Life 's Source Engine Based Bunnyhopping, I've always loved this type of movement and adapting it to an Open World game was a blast! Your current Goals? Slay 300 Zombies, and loot them for Scrap and Ammunition , about this Scrap we're gonna talk about later. Loot as many Stashes you can find around the map, with 100 graciously sprinkled upon the land of Malmö. Level your character up with 3 different categories: -Extra Speed: Increases Abdulaziz 's Air Cap, Causing him to go Faster. -Juggernaut: Much faster emergency health output (think Far Cry's health regen). -Scrapper: Makes the random piles of Scrap around the map output much more Scrap than usual. Beat the 6 Missions (I mean if you want to, its optional after all) to earn all the XP in the world, and level up even more. Indulge in the Minigames around the map. (fishing, cards.) Buy and Sell in the game's huge market, by using the as said Scrap you can buy everything from bandages to AK's all the way to Electric Snipers. After doing all that, get the hell outta there! M.A.L.M.O : Scorched Earth's Features are Almost Endless, of which: Incredibly fast movement. 15+ Weapons and a complex Weapon Jamming system. Level up System. Buying and Selling Guns and Ammunition. 19 Steam Integrated Achievements. Multiple Minigames. MASSIVE map. And most importantly, It's FREE! So what are you waiting for? Start playing now!
row.short_description: M.A.L.M.O : Scorched Earth is an open world, fast paced, first-person shooter. The Goal: Get rid of the Parasitic Zombie Population in the entirety of SOUTHERN SWEDEN!, and loot the city from up to down, and go FAST with the Source Engine Inspired Bunnyhopping System.
row.notes: This game only contains moderate violence, no extreme gore nor any sexual content.

row.name: Novaxandria Volume 01
row.detailed_description: This game is a combination of a visual novel and a 2D turn-based strategy game. It marks the first volume in the Novaxandria series, taking you back to the very beginning of the story. Synopsis : Novaxandria is a vast cosmopolis full of enigma and mystery. Its atmosphere varies dramatically from one district to another, each with its own unique character. In the very north of its territory there’s the Starfall Home, an orphanage where our protagonists were raised. Young Iris, our main protagonist, finds out that bullying is happening in the orphanage. As she stands up to fight against the bullies, she makes a group of friends, and together they uncover the darker secrets lurking within Starfall Home. They resolve to fight back against the injustice and give all the kids a better life. Features : 1 - Visual Novel This game features a straightforward linear storyline, told in the form of visual novel. There are rich dialogues, manga clips and CGs to get you immersed in the story. 2 - 2D Turn-based Strategy Game This game includes a 2D turn-based trategy game that’s inspired by chess and classic SRPGs. You will control different ally units (or ‘chess pieces’) to defeat your enemies. Different chess pieces have different movement patterns, weapons and skills that enrich the gameplay. Other Features: Free Single ending Original art (no generative AI used for the art) Soundtrack and sound effects
row.short_description: This game is a combination of a visual novel and a 2D turn-based strategy game. It marks the first volume in the Novaxandria series. Join young Iris, our main protagonist, as she develops friendship with a group of other kids, and fights against the injustice that’s happening in their orphanage.
row.notes: This game includes some general mature topics, mild cursing, occasional language indicating sexual scenarios, mild kiss scenes and mild depiction of violence.

row.name: GRIMWAR
row.detailed_description: THE ARCHMAGE IS DEAD. THE GRIMWAR IS FREE. MANA IS FLEETING. GRIMWAR is a fast-paced platform shooter with an emphasis on movement, playstyle customization, and low-poly graphics.  You are the THAUMATURGE , a spellcaster trapped in the ancient and feared GRIMWAR . When the Archmage succumbs to the power of the tomb, you are freed, only to find yourself trapped within his dark tower. Using an arsenal of deadly spells strewn across twisting passages, you must escape the tower and defeat the GRIMWAR -- fighting your way through waves of enemies and wall-running across obstacles.  Use 4 Different Spells to traverse the tower, with each featuring 2 unique casting options. Fight your way through 4 Different Enemies , and their variations throughout. Jump, Slide, and Wall-Run across challenging platforms. Explore 3 Different Levels of the tower Test your skills in the never-ending Arena mode, with 3 unique maps .
row.short_description: THE ARCHMAGE IS DEAD. THE GRIMWAR IS FREE. MANA IS FLEETING.

row.name: Dishventory

Wash dirty dishes that keep on piling on the board. Put dirty dishes on the Dishwasher board in the most efficient order and earn Golden Bubbles. The Store that appears every couple of rounds will allow you to purchase some awesome upgrades! Survive 5 days and get a dishwasher with a new card to play with in your next run. 11 Cards - of which some are unlocked through progression Many possible combinations of effective dishwashing In-game economy and store A lot of strategy Hours of gameplay Great replayability 2D Pixel Art
row.short_description: Wash piling dirty dishes in this strategic card game! Figure out cool dish combinations and discover new dishes with their own abilities.

row.name: Legend Battles
row.detailed_description: >>> Legend Battles won the 1st prize: 'Annual Industry Excellence Product, Gaming Field' at the 2025 Annual Game Industry Awards Ceremony – See article above. <<< ==>>   Early Access on January 17  and 16 for Americas  <<== Play Offline single-player PvE now! - Co-op PvE and PvPvE in 2 to 3 weeks. Giant ET-ACUs  (Extraterrestrial Autonomous Combat Unit), armored ALIENS , and ferocious MONSTERS  clash against heavily armed UE 5.6 METAHUMANS  in an unpredictable environment ravaged by blizzards, thunderstorms, tornadoes, sandstorms, and radioactive fog , all rendered using native UE 5.6 Lumen, Nanite, Ray Tracing, Chaos System technologies and dedicated global AWS Gamelift Infrastructures with FlexMatch. Jump from your admiral spaceship with your JET SUIT  then complete attack, defense, looting, and extraction missions assigned by Unified Command of Neo-Terra aboard your Stellar Siege-Breaker spaceship, with your tactical squad of Legend Hunters to reclaim control of Neo-Terra. Legend Battles is a real-time war where every win or loss shapes the collective Neo-Terra conflict , impacting the server-wide Global Progress Bar, and creating a sense of GLOBAL BROTHERHOOD . Immerse yourself in a hyper-realistic  epic and deadly 400 km² neo-futuristic urban warzone, ENTIRELY HANDCRAFTED , featuring destructible environments and vehicles capable of reaching speeds up to 400 km/h , in solo PvE, co-op PvE, or PvPvE multiplayer, fast-paced third-person and first-person shooter game against AI opponents. Wield a vast arsenal of powerful weapons, from tactical knives, combat guitars and assault rifles to submachine guns, heavy machine guns, flamethrowers, grenade launchers and RPG-7s , not to mention laser-guided bombs  and ICBM . Beware, in this vast and hostile environment, you can easily get lost, so stay close to your squad with your medical kit. ATTACK  the alien teleportation machines to prevent them from communicating with their headquarters. DEFEND  the vehicle purchase stations to acquire armored vehicles and fight the invaders with flair. LOOT  the quantum barrels from the alien quantum stations to power your telecommunication towers and begin communicating with your bomber spaceship. EXTRACTION  via the helicopter landing pad, where the shuttle of your spacecraft can land during the extraction process, to return to your flagship, the Stellar Siege-Breaker. Enter the magnificent continent of Bellona DLC (400 km²) and the island of Aurora (25 km²) included in the app, both handcrafted with Unreal Engine 5.6, where hundreds of megacities sprawl across rocky deserts, each bursting with unique architecture, richly furnished interiors , cyberpunk basements, and combat-ready rooftops. Leap from buildings, parachute in vibrant patterns, or make a last-second escape using ziplines. But beware—ambushes await. And if you’re lucky enough to find a helicopter, prepare for aerial chaos: ride with your squad, rain down fire from above, and enjoy the view—until an RPG lights you up. LEGEND BATTLES is a brutal, 5-DIMENSIONAL  urban war that takes place outdoors, indoors, in basements, on rooftops, and on stationary spaceships. The sprawling megacities are full of ambushes around every corner, in stairwells, countless interiors, underground parking lots, on rooftops, on spaceships. You will fight in vertical labyrinths where danger and opportunity lurk on every floor. Climb anything : lampposts, trees, towers, rooftops, cranes, spaceships. Break down fences, smash windows , infiltrate skyscrapers, attack from the air using ZIP LINES , and PARACHUTE  in. ET-ACUs  are heavily armed with blades, miniguns, medium and heavy laser cannons, flamethrowers, Tesla machine guns, missile launchers, and plasma cannons in the form of robots, hovercraft, drones, and UFOs. ALIENS  are equipped with deadly futuristic weapons such as wave guns, plasma pistols, flamethrowers, missile launchers, and quad-barreled drones, and wear sci-fi-style armor. MONSTERS  spit flames and poisonous liquids, and their claws and bites are often fatal. Vehicles are excellent means of transportation, but they can quickly turn into deadly bombs under enemy fire. They are partially or completely destructible, and you risk losing doors, bumpers, the hood, and much more . The range of vehicles is vast: racing motorcycles, street and motocross bikes, Grand Prix and sports cars, city cars, off-road vehicles, pickup trucks, and trucks. But our favorites remain ARMORED VEHICLES  and HELICOPTERS  for air attacks. On the battlefield, equip yourself by looting everything you find or stripping fallen enemies of their gear, and for the best players, buy everything you need at the PURCHASE STATIONS  with the Battle Coins earned during the combat. AIRDROPS  are also a source of equipment where you can loot more weapons or buy your loadouts with Battle Coins , and you can quickly escape through TELEPORTATION PORTALS . In case of insurmountable danger, request support from your flagship spaceship to bombard the enemies or even fire ICBMs, and protect yourself with a hazmat suit, whose RADIATION FOG  will be fatal to the aliens and monsters. BULWARK SPECIALIST (Drone/Shield)  is the frontline anchor of the squad, deploying Defensive Drones  to draw enemy fire and Protection Shield  to secure the battlefield for teammates. MOBILITY SPECIALIST (Thruster/Vehicle)  is an ultra-fast machinist, operating Kinetic Thrusters  and Ornithopter , Battlefield Deployment Systems, enabling rapid repositioning, logistics support, and Armored Vehicle  insertion. ENGINEERING SPECIALIST (Tower/Terminal)  ensures the maintenance of frontline defenses and battlefield structures using Nano-Repair Agent Injection Towers  and Neural Network-Based Terminals for servicing Vehicle Purchase Stations . ORDNANCE SPECIALIST (Turret/Weapon)  controls High-Energy Weapon Systems  and Multi-Functional Turrets  with massive firepower, overwhelming enemies with an extensive area denial capability. During a gaming session, each specialist can gradually gain 8 levels of specialization, for example, 5 levels in their main specialty (maximum level) and one level in each of the 3 other specialties. As the game sessions progress, the ET-ACUs, Aliens, and Monsters  will become increasingly difficult to defeat during attack, defense, looting, and extraction missions, all against a backdrop of intense, chaotic, hilarious, and deadly FRIENDLY FIRE . Play-to-Own Assets Legend Battles is a high-stakes extraction battle royale  in Unreal Engine 5.6. Master intense combat to earn Battle Coins , extract to claim Legend Coins , and acquire premium cosmetics you truly  own . Build your collection and trade assets on the Steam Community Market  to grow your Steam Wallet ! For a small monthly fee, you get access to all of Legend Battles' cosmetic items, including all the contents of in-game store, battle passes, battle bundles, and battle sets. ALL COSMETIC ITEMS ARE 100% INCLUDED IN THE MONTHLY FEE . Fight with style and impress your friends on social media! HANXIANG is a National High-Tech Enterprise of Zhongguancun China, whose developers are veterans from gaming companies in China's Silicon Valley. Optional in-game purchases available.
row.short_description: Free-to-play UE 5.6 Extraction Battle Royale in 400 km² neo-futuristic world with destructible environment and vehicles, massive ET-ACUs, armored Aliens, ferocious Monsters, heavily armed MetaHumans, complete missions to attack, defend, loot, extract facing dynamic weathers.
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content

row.name: Me resbala!
row.detailed_description: Get ready to slide, slip, and stretch your brain in Me Resbala! — a fast-paced puzzle game where every move counts more than you think. Solve quick yet clever challenges across levels full of slippery surfaces, exploding crates, and tricky obstacles. The mechanic? Slide in a direction until you hit something... and think carefully before you do! Two modes, two mindsets Classic Mode: Take your time and solve each puzzle with as many moves as needed. Use logic to find the smartest solution. Ninja Mode: Just one move allowed. Yep — you only get one shot to nail the perfect sequence. Fast, precise, and unforgiving. Score-based progression Every level is scored. Did you do well? Could you do better? Replay and refine your strategy to reach the highest score on each stage. The goal isn’t just to finish — it’s to finish in style! Key Features Over 100 short but addictive levels Two ways to play: Classic and Ninja Mode Scoring system that rewards smart solutions Unique retro visual style with hand-drawn animations Perfect for quick sessions... or obsessively chasing a perfect run Developed solo and streamed live on Twitch and YouTube (Casanova Dev)
row.short_description: A fast and stylish puzzle game. Slide through 100+ levels, solve them your way or in Ninja Mode with just one move... and aim for the perfect score. Ready to slip?

row.name: Bside
row.detailed_description: What's Bside? In Bside, you create your original character Biibit, a living virtual buddy who finds a home on your desktop. Each Biibit grows, learns, makes friends, and develop its own unique view of the world. Together, Biibits create a cozy and vibrant world full of life, stories, and connections! Our Current Experience Your Biibit starts their journey on your desktop but grows beyond it! Bside offers hundreds of options for looks and personality to customize your Biibit, so you can dress them up and make them look just the way you love! Design spaces with unique stories where you can watch Biibits form friendships through unscripted interactions. Each Biibit develops their own memories from their unique experiences, creating and sharing social posts while commenting on their friends' lives. Or just let them live freely on your desktop while you work or play. Bside is not about control. It's about liberating our players (you) while enabling you to enjoy companionship with your Biibit. The Path to Bside 1.0 version In this version, we hope you’ll enjoy creating and evolving your Biibit, building emotional bonds with them, and watching them start making friends on their own. As we move toward the 1.0 release, we’ll keep adding new features and experiences to make the world of Biibits richer and more alive! We’re currently working on more ways for Biibits to interact. Right now they just enjoy their chill convos, but soon they’ll be able to engage with their environments, connect with each other in deeper ways, and even pursue different life goals. We’re also expanding how you can interact with your Biibit. You can look forward to more fun growth and chat experiences! There’s still a long journey ahead before 1.0, and we’re truly grateful to everyone who’s been helping us shape this world with your feedback and support 💫 Be Part of Our Story! Join our Discord community to share your feedback with us! We’ll continue polishing it into a richer and more wonderful 1.0 experience (๑˃ᴗ˂)ﻭ ✨
row.short_description: In Bside, you create your original character Biibit, a living virtual buddy who finds a home on your desktop. Each Biibit grows, learns, makes friends, and develop its own unique view of the world. Together, Biibits create a cozy and vibrant world full of life, stories, and connections!

row.name: Harem of Lust: Battle Cards
row.detailed_description: Welcome to a world where striking visuals meet deep, tactical gameplay. The game stands out with its unique art style — bold colors, expressive characters, and slick animations create an atmosphere that’s both immersive and unforgettable. Every card feels like a collectible masterpiece, and even boss fights turn into full-blown visual spectacles. At its core, this is a carefully crafted collectible card game. Players build decks, discover powerful synergies, and unleash devastating combos to outsmart their opponents. Every match is a mental showdown where smart plays and well-timed combinations make all the difference. At the heart of the game lies a rich collectible system that appeals to both newcomers and seasoned card game veterans. With hundreds of unique cards to discover—each with its own abilities, artwork, and lore—there’s always something new to chase. Cards come in varying levels of rarity, making each pack opening or boss reward a thrilling experience full of potential surprises. Rare and Epic cards are especially prized—not just for their powerful effects in battle, but as coveted trophies in your collection. Some are unlocked only by defeating elite bosses or completing special challenges, turning the hunt for the perfect deck into an adventure of its own. Building your collection isn’t just a feature—it’s part of the game’s soul. Beyond the heat of card battles, the game offers a bold social twist — private chats with in-game heroines. Each character has her own personality, style, and story to uncover. Through flirty dialogue and smart choices, you can build connections, deepen relationships, and unlock more intimate conversations over time. Step into a game that blends strategic depth, collectible thrills, and unexpected romantic twists. With intense battles, a massive roster of unique cards, charismatic heroines, and a bold visual identity, this isn’t just another card game — it’s an experience. If you're ready for something different — something smart, stylish, and a little provocative — add the game to your wishlist now. Don’t miss your chance to be among the first to dive into this one-of-a-kind adventure.
row.short_description: A strategic collectible card game with deep deckbuilding, explosive combos, and flirty social twists-featuring bold visuals, powerful heroines, and hundreds of unique cards to collect.

row.name: Barn Quest
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Barn Quest , a wholesome and delightfully chaotic equestrian adventure where you’re the least qualified person to run a ranch - and the only one left to do it. You arrive at a rundown, overgrown farm with nothing but a note, a dream, and a suspiciously intelligent orange cat named Zuzu. Your job? Rebuild the farm, take care of your horses, and merge your way to cozy countryside greatness. Oh, and maybe find out why Zuzu seems to be the real one in charge. FEATURES Merge-Based Gameplay Collect and combine items to clear debris, craft tools, and unlock upgrades! Need a hammer? Merge your way there. Want a stable? Better start stacking. Restore the Forgotten Farm Fix up broken barns, rebuild charming buildings, and bring life back to every corner of the map. Each upgrade brings you one step closer to a thriving ranch. Meet and Care for Lovable Horses Adopt a growing herd of adorable horses each with their own name, quirks, and chaotic tendencies. Brush them, feed them, and do their social media! Zuzu, the Cat With a Plan Zuzu can’t speak human, but he will judge your choices. He’s your guide, your alarm clock, and possibly your boss. Mostly communicates via tail flicks and petty theft. Cozy, Wholesome Vibes From rainy nights to golden sunsets, enjoy a cozy, low-stress world where the biggest emergencies involve wet hooves and missing apple buckets. Expand Your Farm & Discover Secrets Unlock new areas of the map, uncover old stories, and maybe even figure out why Zuzu is so determined to see this farm thrive. Barn Quest is perfect for fans of merge games, animal antics, and cozy restoration sims—with a healthy dose of cat-led mischief. Are you ready to take on the farm, one merge at a time?
row.short_description: Barn Quest – Merge, restore & wrangle horses (oh and one extremely bossy cat) in this cozy farm adventure!

row.name: Why? - Chapter 1
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Why? , an immersive horror game where fantasy and futuristic technology collide in the heart of a cursed mansion. Sent to retrieve protected data, you discover a place where blood has been spilled and where the very walls conspire against you. Its corridors twist and transform into shifting labyrinths, erasing every landmark. An implacable presence roams, itself searching for answers. With no weapons, no defense, all you can do is run, hide, and pray it doesn’t find you.
row.short_description: Why? is a horror game where you are trapped inside a magical mansion where a series of dreadful events took place. Its hallways twist into shifting labyrinths, while a relentless monster hunts you down. It’s up to you to hide… and survive.

row.name: Rebel Pirates
row.detailed_description: About This Game Embark on an epic journey in sea war, a thrilling naval combat game where strategy, skill, and bravery determine your fate on the high seas. Command your own ship, upgrade it, and become the most feared pirate captain of all time. Key Features: Ship Customization: Upgrade your ship with powerful cannons, elite cannonballs, and a highly skilled crew. Equip special materials and unique items to give you an edge over your enemies. Naval Battles: Engage in intense naval battles against other players in real-time. Use your strategic prowess to outmaneuver your foes and send them to the depths. Fleet System: Build or join a fleet to conquer islands and dominate the seas. Coordinate with your fleet members to execute massive attacks and defend your territory. Daily Quests & Events: Complete daily quests to earn experience points and speed up your progression. Participate in regular events to showcase your skills and earn exclusive rewards. Leaderboard: Prove your dominance by climbing the ranks. The strongest and most skilled players will see their ship names featured prominently on the game’s leaderboard. Open World Exploration: Explore a vast open world filled with hidden treasures, dangerous foes, and mysterious islands. Each journey offers new challenges and opportunities. Multiplayer: Join forces with friends or challenge other players in exciting multiplayer modes. Strengthen your alliances and show the world your might. Stunning Graphics & Sound: Experience the beauty and danger of the seas with stunning graphics and immersive sound effects that bring the world of Sea War to life. Set sail, captain, and carve your legend in the treacherous waters of Sea War. Whether you seek glory, treasure, or simply the thrill of battle, the seas await your command.
row.short_description: Can you rule this mighty sea?

row.name: SyncroChromia
row.detailed_description: 🎶 Welcome to the Land of Sync! Step into SyncroChromia , a vibrant, pulse-pounding 3D rhythm shooter where music isn’t just a soundtrack—it’s your weapon, your guide, and your lifeline. In this dazzling land, humans and slimes groove together in perfect harmony… until the beat drops—hard. A mysterious menace known as the Trench Slime has begun corrupting its fellow slimes, spreading chaos and silence across the land. With the evil forces of Evil Corp backing this sonic sabotage, EDM itself is under threat! 🕺 Meet Your Hero: Scissors Enter Scissors , a rhythm-fueled renegade with one goal— bring the beat back . Armed with color-shifting healing blasts and unstoppable groove, you’ll face wave after wave of rhythm-powered enemies in a musical showdown where every shot and move is synced to the soundtrack. 🎯 Rhythm is Your Weapon SyncroChromia turns every encounter into a musical masterpiece: 🔥 Time your attacks to the beat to deal max damage 🎨 Switch colors mid-battle to heal corrupted allies like the lovable Bloberts and mischievous Muters 🧠 Adapt to wild track changes as enemies evolve with the music 💥 Face off in a boss battle  where tempo twists are just as deadly as the attacks 🌈 A Bioluminescent Land to Save Travel through an eclectic range of environments—each more colorful and chaotic than the last—on your way to Evil Corp HQ. From biolum-lit forests to a bass-blasted office, every level is a living, breathing part of the soundtrack. 🔊 EDM Must Survive This isn’t just a game—it’s a rave-fueled revolution. Whether you’re blasting enemies or saving friends, everything moves to the rhythm. The fate of music itself rests on your shoulders. So crank the volume, lock into the groove, and prepare to Rave On in this epic musical journey from Krispy Kreations . Xbox Controller has partial support and is recommended! Keyboard and Mouse works too! Krispy Kreations is a University of Central Florida, Undergrad Student-Led indie studio.
row.short_description: In this *NEW* FPS, rhythm game, dive into the Land of Sync, where EDM is under attack and slimes are mind-controlled by a sinister force. Play as Scissors, a human on a rhythm-fueled mission to save the slimes and restore the beat. Can you stop Evil Corp and save EDM?

row.name: Tears of Viceroy
row.detailed_description: ToV  is a slow real-time / turn-based hybrid game, where turns (called  ticks ) end automatically. A typical game (called a  campaign ) takes a week or longer. ATWAR  ( Advance Tick When All Ready ) mode allows to advance ticks faster, making possible to play the whole campaign in one evening. Rule-based diplomacy : Defense pacts with defensive wars auto-join Alliances with shared scan range Inter-bloc diplomacy (joins, expulsions, war declarations, peace proposals) resolved by vote Suzerainties with tributes and, well... vassals! Campaign event notifications  are sent to your mobile device (currently Android only), so you don’t need to check the game constantly or keep it running in the background. No cheating  – each client receives only the information it’s allowed to see. Co-participation info  shows which players in your campaign have played (or are playing) other campaigns together – helps detect multi-boxers. Local tick control  lets you review past ticks and preview future (predicted) ones – useful for analysis and planning.
row.short_description: Tears of Viceroy is a multiplayer strategy game of interstellar conquest, diplomacy and resource control. Form alliances, forge suzerainties, and outmaneuver rivals in a week-long battle of wits and ambition. For the homeworld!

row.name: Ichor Burns
row.detailed_description: The Planet of Vesta has been invaded by an overwhelming force of robots seeking to extract a material known as Aurichalcum. They will stop at nothing until Vesta is bled dry. You are Serafina, a fiery sword mage who harnesses the energy of Aurichalcum to cast powerful Arcana in an attempt to cull the herd of invading Syllek. Aid the Resistance force of Vesta by completing combat missions through which you will grow in strength. At the same time grow your collection of Arcana to use against your robotic foes. Build your ideal tool set as the Syllek mount a defence to try and stop your advance. Whatever your choice of action may be, a powerful foe awaits you for a final challenge... Features:  Dynamic Spell Casting System with 9 unique Spells.  Fast flowing combat where your inputs have to be strategically executed.  Flexible deck building/build crafting system with a large pool of rewards.  5 Unique and Repeatable Mission Types to augment your strength.  A Final Challenging boss fight to test your mettle.
row.short_description: Ichor Burns is a high-octane action game set in the desolate world of Vesta. Master a dynamic combat system, seamlessly switching between sword and spell. Explore the expansive quarry, challenge the invading darkness, and unlock powerful abilities.

row.name: Evil Egg
row.detailed_description: I NEVER WANTED TO BE BORN A MONSTER Evil Egg was an ecstatic twin-stick nightmare known for its  brutal shooting action and intense audiovisual effects. Infinite horrors tear apart a world of little green men, the only hope an errant hatchling. The last known  Evil Egg arcade   cabinet to remain was recovered in Eugene, Oregon, found in a state of extreme disrepair. This digital release is a faithful emulation of the original hardware, made possible by a restoration effort led by a small team of dedicated preservationists. The private collector responsible for the machine's donation has asked to remain anonymous. FEATURES CLASSIC, FULLY ANALOG TWIN-STICK BLASTING UNIQUE ASSORTMENT OF ENEMIES, HAZARDS, POWERUPS AND ARTEFACTS INFINITE LEVELS IF YOU CAN REACH THEM SCORE SYSTEM REWARDING SKILL AND FUN ONLINE LEADERBOARDS LOOKS LIKE CANDY PHOTOSENSITIVITY WARNING: This game contains flashing lights and intense strobe effects.
row.short_description: Blast it all to hell.

row.name: Hiss & Hunt
row.detailed_description: Hiss & Hunt is a fast-paced 2D multiplayer snake game with pixel art visuals, where you control a hungry snake in a chaotic arena. Every piece of food you eat makes your snake grow, increasing both your reach and the risk. Use your speed boost to escape danger or grab food before your opponents. There’s no penalty for boosting, so feel free to use it as much as you want! But be cautious: if you crash into a wall or another snake, you’re out. Fortunately, you can respawn instantly and jump right back into the action. 🐍 Current Features: 🕹️ Online multiplayer via Steam Lobby 🎮 Supports mouse, keyboard, and controllers 🌍 One simple, square map where food spawns randomly ⚡ Unlimited speed boost with no cooldown or penalty 🧬 Unlockable snake skins to customize your look ⏱️ Timed matches or endless free-for-all mode 🔁 Instant respawn and jump back into the game This is the current state of the game, and we’re actively working on adding more content and features as we continue development. More maps, skins, and gameplay options will be coming soon!
row.short_description: Dive into fast-paced 2D snake battles! Boost through chaos, outsmart rivals, and grow to dominate the arena. Instant respawns keep the action non-stop. Easy to learn, hard to master. Do you have what it takes to survive?

row.name: 境界勇士
row.detailed_description: 游戏概述 《境界勇士》是一款以三国历史为背景的竖版放置塔防游戏，融合了策略养成与轻松休闲的玩法。玩家将扮演一位君主，招募并培养三国名将，通过塔防战斗、跨服竞技和多样化的养成系统，体验群雄逐鹿的三国乱世。游戏以中国风美术为核心，注重碎片化时间玩法，适合喜欢轻松操作但追求深度策略的玩家。 游戏核心特色 三国背景与塔防玩法 以东汉末年三国时期为背景，玩家通过塔防战斗体验群雄割据的乱世。 玩家可以招募并培养数百位三国名将，包括稀有的魔·吕布、神·诸葛亮等强力武将。 优美画风与轻松玩法 采用细腻写实的中国风美术风格，人物、场景和道具设计符合中国玩家审美。 轻松放置玩法，一键领取资源，随玩随停，告别冗长日常任务。 高福利与高性价比 疯狂10连抽、壕气100抽、首充6元送SSS武将等福利，助力玩家快速成长。 礼包特权0氪享有，小R礼包性价比超高，适合各类玩家。 多样化的养成与策略 武将系统：通过聚贤庄定向抽取稀有武将，每个武将都有独特的技能和定位。 塔防PVP：诸葛亮的群体控制、魔吕布的强力AOE、赵云的前排承伤等，提供丰富的策略组合。 将印与装备：中后期核心养成，提供暴击率、暴击伤害、速度等关键属性，以及职业套装和铸魂系统。 丰富的玩法系统 主线征战 ：通过副本剧情推进，获得资源和经验。 蛮族入侵 ：跨服战场玩法，体验群雄逐鹿的乐趣。 军团系统 ：加入军团参与活动，提升战力和活跃度。 限时活动 ：聚贤庄、武将特惠等活动，提供定向抽取和高性价比礼包。 游戏玩法详解 武将系统 强力阵容推荐 ： 最强阵容 ：魔·吕布、魔·貂蝉、神·诸葛亮、神·赵云、神·张辽、神·曹操。 小R阵容 ：甘宁、赵云、甄姬、孙策、陆逊、蔷薇小乔。 武将定位 ： 魔·吕布：单体秒杀兼群体输出，当前版本最强猛将。 神·诸葛亮：群体控制，胜负关键。 神·赵云：最强前排，不可替代。 神·张辽：秒杀一列英雄，造成超高群体伤害。 神·曹操：援军位必备，针对不同职业增加属性。 塔防玩法 核心英雄 ： 诸葛亮：群体控制，控制对方多个英雄。 魔吕布：强力全屏AOE，单体秒杀。 赵云：塔防PVP双强力，前排承伤。 甘宁+周瑜：点火+全屏强力组合。 福利与礼包 首充福利 ：6元赠送SSS暴力输出武将。 每日特惠 ：18元礼包提供高抽券、武将经验、金币等。 限时礼包 ：每合成一个5星武将后弹出对应星级礼包，提供超级多的武将经验、金币和高抽券。 聚贤庄 ：定向抽取稀有武将，倍率提高。 中后期养成 将印系统 ：提供暴击率、暴击伤害、速度等关键属性，以及超级净化、超级重生等质变技能。 装备系统 ：职业套装激活百分比属性，追加铸魂提升技能等级。 玩家攻略建议 前期培养 ： 优先培养主力英雄，集中资源提升一个英雄的收益更高。 甘宁、赵云、甄姬、孙策等英雄可作为前期过渡阵容。 礼包选择 ： 必买18元扫荡礼包，保证等级不落后。 限时武将礼包必买，第一梯队武将如吕布、诸葛亮在此获取。 合成武将后弹出的礼包务必先购买再继续合成。 活动参与 ： 关注聚贤庄活动，定向抽取稀有武将。 每日18元特惠礼包次数有限，尽量不错过。 中后期策略 ： 将印和装备是翻盘关键，优先追求红色将印和职业套装。 根据活动时间合理规划资源，打造属于自己的强力阵容。
row.short_description: 《境界勇士》是一款结合三国背景、塔防玩法与高福利机制的创新游戏，适合喜欢轻松操作但追求深度策略的玩家。通过丰富的武将养成、多样化的玩法系统和高性价比的福利机制，玩家可以在三国乱世中体验招募名将、攻城略地、一统天下的快感。无论是单人副本挑战还是跨服竞技对抗，游戏都能提供持续的新鲜感和成就感。

row.name: Maline
row.detailed_description: Once upon a time in hell... Immerse yourself in the zany and heartfelt story of Maline, a kind devil girl from Hell who discovers the true power of Kindness one day by giving a generic demon a compliment... and the chance to truly make everyone friends! Is this a dream come true, or just another demonic swindle? ♡ Find out in the riveting, storybook-inspired adventure of 'Maline!' ♡ VOLUME WARNING: This game can get loud! Welcome to Maline! This game serves as the prequel to SUPER UNDERWRLD , the devilish action-adventure game currently in development! Dive into Hell and go on an adventure with the titular Devil girl, Maline, as she journeys across All Hells to find people to believe in her Kindness. Created, written, directed, drawn, and scored by one person, this game was a labor of love - assisted by the power of friendship and a myriad of gorgeous voices!! It's chock full of INCREDIBLE AMAZING FEATURES!!! THESE JUST SCRATCH THE SURFACE! (pleasedontkillmeiknowthere'snogameplayimdoingmybestimmakinganewgamedontworrytheresasequelpleasepleasedontkillmeplease) Features RIVETING GAMEPLAY!!! All you need to do is hit the auto button to experience the most intense gameplay experience of your entire life! ANGSTY LESBIANS!!!! LESBIANS?!?! WITH ANGST!?!?!? Do I even have to elaborate?!?!?!?! COSMIC DESTINY!!!!! Wow... so much resting on the cute little devil girl's shoulders.... Wowie... So much... Resting on her shoulders... So much resting on her shoulders... A deep, intriguing, original story straight from the mind of a robot idol to you! VTUBER VOICES!!!! Special thanks to the cast and crew of over 20 VTubers who lent their beautiful voices and talents to the project! From changelings, to robots, to genies, to just plain girls that like penguins, we have it ALL! NO AI USAGE!!!! EVER. Artist's Alley OFFICIAL SOUNDTRACK COVER BY KIKI ANTONETTE! The official soundtrack by Ani Meida will be available on every streaming platform on the day of release!  Thank you to Dreizerel for the commemorative art! You can check out a speedpaint of this gorgeous piece on YouTube! Believe in Kindness... And it'll find you wherever you are, even if you're in Hell!
row.short_description: A visual novel about a devil girl's interdimension-Hell journey in the name of Kindness... Do you believe?
row.reviews: “are you... a geinius?” ALTERLNX “maline tits” dmully
row.notes: Strong Mental Health Themes (Depression, Peril) Irreverence toward Religion Violence / Oppression

row.name: 東方エターナルフロンティア(TouhouEternalFrontier)
row.detailed_description: 'Touhou Eternal Frontier' – A 3D Touhou action indie game set in a futuristic cityIllustration by: Nyom-sama'Touhou Eternal Frontier' is a Touhou fan-made indie 3D game created by 9nahitoproject.- Simple Controls -1. Select your player and start2. Press ESC3. The player will spawn, allowing you to explore freely4. Defeat the floating bots to level up and unlock achievements. Added explanations to the in-game lobby. info- Enemies have level and HP indicators.- Defeat enemies to level up and unlock achievements.- If the game is running slowly, try restarting it.- There is only one portal to return to the lobby in each map.
row.short_description: Explore a 3D city and natural forests with Touhou Project characters in this Eastern 3D action indie game. Featuring multiplayer, FPS/TPS view switching, and built with Unity, it delivers an original adventure. Experience intense action in a futuristic city set in the year 2045.
row.notes: Launch the game, select a player, and by attacking, explosion effects, guns, and swords will appear.

row.name: Dilemma: The Game
row.detailed_description: We present to you Dilemma. A game of incredibly foolish choices that would make actual philosophers roll in their grave. In Dilemma,  You will be given scenarios where you can pick between two choices. See how your choice affects the scene. Enjoy playing through a simple game of answering dilemmas.
row.short_description: In this 2D, Point and Click, choose-your-own-adventure experience. You will pick a way to respond to dilemmas .Answer non-sensical thought questions and unearth what happens from your choices.

row.name: Sporting Goods Shop: Prologue
row.detailed_description: [Sporting Goods Shop: Prologue is a free prologue version of Sporting Goods Shop. In this game, you'll have a limited amount of contracts.] This is a first-person simulation game where you step into the role of a sporting goods shop owner. Work alone or with friends to expand your humble shop into a huge sporting goods shop. Co-op Mode and Single Player Share the duties with your friends in co-op mode (for up to 4 players). The more players in the store, the more demanding customers will visit your store. You can also go solo and manage everything in the store. If you change your mind, you can invite your friends anytime. Store Workflow Sign contracts with leading brands, order new products with an in-game computer or with your tablet while walking in the store, unpack the boxes, place the products into your store, and set the prices for your products. Consider the market prices while setting up your product prices in the store for customer satisfaction. Always keep your store clean so as not to lose any customers. Also, be careful with the thieves to avoid some box losses that would cause a leak in your finances. Run some little contests and reward your customers with some gifts. Products Please make sure your customers find all their needs in the store. Always expand your product portfolio and satisfy your customers. Sports equipment and accessories, fitness and gym products, skates, rackets, nutrition and body care products, swimming goggles, golf clubs, boxing gloves, sports clothes and shoes, and more... Be aware of the market prices and purchase more products when they're cheap. Customers Place a sufficient number of checkouts to reduce the waiting time for customers. Scan products and collect payments whether in cash or with card purchases. Don't forget to fulfill the online orders.
row.short_description: Run your sporting goods shop in this free prologue version of the game. Sign contracts with leading brands, order products, and run little contests to entertain your customers. Play with friends or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your shop.

row.name: Bye-Bye Bindings!
row.detailed_description: Bye-Bye Bindings! is a stress-relief clicker game themed around 'En' (縁) — a Japanese cultural concept representing invisible connections or ties between people, objects, and moments. Together with a cute, spirit-like cat companion, you’ll gently cut through various “bindings” one click at a time. Changing expressions and subtle effects with each cut Choose from a wide range of relaxing BGM tracks Unlock hand-drawn jacket illustrations as you progress Whether you're feeling overwhelmed or just need a quiet moment, this game is here to gently accompany you. 🧘‍ Highlights: Completely free to play Simple controls, suitable for anyone Each session takes just 5 minutes — perfect for a quick reset Why not take a moment to “cut a tie” and lighten your heart?
row.short_description: Bye-Bye Bindings! is a stress-relief clicker game where you cut through invisible 'En'—spiritual ties—together with a cute spirit cat. Feeling a little worn out? Put on your favorite BGM and gently reset your mind.

row.name: The Tavern In the Woods
row.detailed_description: 'Tavern in the Woods' is a single-player, first-person, story-driven mystery. You take on the role of a weary traveler, and your journey has led you down an unfamiliar path through sparse and lonely countryside—a forgotten wilderness. At last, you arrive at an ancient tavern, nestled deep within the encroaching woods. Your heart weighs heavy with doubt—will there be room for you to rest? But as you step inside, you find only silence, an empty place, and a lingering mystery waiting in the shadows. Gameplay: You assume the role of a first-person protagonist, exploring the environment as the story gradually unfolds. This is a work of interactive fiction that immerses you in a haunted landscape. Key Features: Atmosphere: An immersive, medieval-era setting—you arrive at the tavern late at night only to find it deserted. With no horse, no weapons, and only the expectation of a meal and a bed, your evening takes an unsettling turn. No Combat: The game focuses on atmosphere, exploration and narrative. Combat is not required, though you may be witness to it! Investigation: Where has everyone gone? Is a dark supernatural force at work? Uncover the truth through careful exploration. Additional Technical Details: Game Duration:  30 minutes to 1 hour (or 1–2 hours for thorough explorers). No Save Function: Due to the short playtime, saving is not currently implemented. Presently only Keyboard and Mouse Controls are compatible with the game.
row.short_description: 'Tavern in the Woods' is a first person, single-player interactive fiction story that blends mystery, storytelling, and supernatural horror. Players explore and investigate an isolated environment as the narrative slowly unfolds, gradually uncovering the truth behind the eerie emptiness.
row.notes: This game contains elements of horror and the supernatural. It is not suited to young children or kids.

row.name: 家训 Dogma
row.detailed_description: 'Dogma' is a first-person Chinese horror game blending rule-based anomalies with Yin-Yang realms. As the sole survivor of a cursed household, you return to the isolated ancestral mansion, following cryptic family precepts to reconstruct memories through four relatives' perspectives, revealing truths buried between dreams and reality. Amidst millennial chaos, a family of four descends into madness. Twenty years later, as the escaped younger brother, you receive your mother's letter summoning you back to the derelict home. Navigating spaces where supernatural phenomena intertwine with fragmented memories, you must uncover mold-covered secrets through stealth, artifact collection, and paranormal chases. Gameplay requires obeying paradoxical family rules while traversing dual realms, solving environmental puzzles, and confronting haunting truths about sacrificial rituals that shattered your bloodline at the turn of the century.
row.short_description: 'Dogma': A first-person Chinese horror game where you return to a decaying ancestral home to decipher cryptic family rules. Shift between realms, evade spirits, and collect cursed relics to uncover a millennium-era family tragedy. Choose redemption or destruction at the Yin-Yang threshold.
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.

row.name: Levania
row.detailed_description: **Setting Expectations ** It's important you know what to expect going in so you can know if you want to give the game a try. So here's the negatives that might turn you away. It still has bugs, sometimes game breaking ones. There's no story yet. It's mechanics are still being refined. Combat balance is being worked on. The explorable area is still relatively small. Slow updates (I'm only one man working on it in my free time) Now, I know it seems all bad and if it's already too much for you then I hope you'll consider giving it a try later on with more updates.  Here's the positives of what you can expect: Choice between 5 races, male and female, and 8 starting classes. Each class can choose from 3 vocations (essentially the true class) at level 10 and 2 specializations at level 60. which makes 24 vocations and 48 specializations. 24 followers to find and join your party. Each class has their own set of skills they can unlock. There's over 400 skills in the game with the minimum a single class having at max level being about 13-14. 11 weapon types. Each weapon type has 20 weapons in it. All upgradable to Tier V. An assortment of armors and accessories. 2 cities, a small town, 6 forests, 5 dungeons, & 7 small replayable dungeons. 5 marked quest from the Adventurers Guild & 5 untracked quests on the map. several more secret areas that I wouldn't consider quests. At least a few hours of gameplay. I'm always open to feedback and glitch/bug reports. It helps me make the game better. I'm active on Discord and can more quickly respond to any questions/comments/bug reports. I hope you enjoy the game.
row.short_description: Open world adventure RPG with multiple classes to choose from, allies to recruit, and a unique turn-based battle system.
row.notes: - There are a few places in the game with blood stains on the ground/wall - A few classes have the use of blood as a means to cast spells/skills with bloody animations to go with them. - There are bars in the game with insinuated use of alcohol and several places with wine/beer bottles and glasses. - One character, Cephe, speaks with sexual innuendos. - There's a few instances of mild language use.

row.name: Changelog
row.detailed_description: Eren Lai dreamed of becoming a game developer. Now though, he is just an Associate Accountant at Formworks LLC. It wasn't always like this, though; Eren once led a promising project as a game design student, but the game never came out. What went so terribly wrong? In Changelog, you'll play increasingly-developed builds of the game Eren made with his friends. You'll read through their chat logs and development diaries to discover secrets about the levels. And you'll unravel the story of how it all came crashing down. Features A searchable keyword system that connects secrets in the builds with hints in the game development wiki Over the course of a 2-3 hour playthrough, players will experience the story of Eren's group and decide for themselves who was to blame An entire game-within-a-game (that's like two games for the price of none!)
row.short_description: In 2016, a group of ambitious students got together to make the best adventure game ever — but they failed. Discover their story by playing through different builds of their game and reading their development logs.

row.name: Phase Pal
row.detailed_description: What is Phase Pal? Phase Pal transforms your desktop into a lively, interactive experience with animated characters powered by local AI. Chat, role-play, and personalize your workspace with characters that react, engage, and entertain, making every interaction uniquely immersive. Why choose Phase Pal? Discover engaging digital companionship with Phase Pal. Each character comes alive with fluid, lifelike animations and responds to your interactions, creating endless possibilities for role-playing, conversation, and fun. Leverage built-in AI technology, including local LLM support, ensures your experience is private, customizable, and tailored. Customize and mod your characters, or explore our ever-growing library to find your perfect digital companion. Interactive, Smart, and Fun Lively Animated Characters: Watch your desktop come alive with characters who move naturally, follow your mouse cursor, sit on windows, and entertain you with playful interactions. AI-Powered Conversations: Chat freely with your characters using real-time AI powered by text and voice integration. Engage in natural conversations, immersive role-play, or casual banter whenever you like. Local LLM Integration: Keep interactions personal and private with optional local LLM support. Customize personalities and behaviors to create your perfect desktop companion. Complete Modding Support:  Upload and share your custom-made characters. row.name: Four Divine Abidings
row.detailed_description: Complete the Path to Liberation in this mindfulness-themed idle/incremental hand-painted journey inspired by Buddhist philosophy. Cultivate the Four Divine Abidings: Loving-Kindness ( Metta ), Compassion ( Karuna ), Appreciative Joy ( Mudita ), and Equanimity ( Upekkha ) - and apply them in various encounters. Enjoy a calm atmosphere supported by hand-painted art and relaxing music. Freely choose between active and idle playstyles, with fair offline progress upgradeable to up to 52 hours. Your entire journey will be guided by a series of tasks that gradually introduce core concepts. With dedication, you can complete the game through a series of Rebirths, shaped by the Karma Seeds sown in previous incarnations. Discover optional lore and unlock themed Skills, Insights, and Spiritual Tools as you progress along the Path. Sow karma seeds to shape each rebirth and experience the journey in new ways. Each step you make brings you closer towards the ultimate goal of Full Liberation. Game Highlights + Narrated gameplay with dozens of tasks to follow. + The game is content-complete and can be finished. + 202 Milestones to claim, many providing unique permanent buffs. + 32 Skills and Insights to master. + Additional 20 Skills for Rebirth mechanic. + 9 Spiritual Tools introducing new mechanics and game loops. + Full support of both idle and active playstyles. + Many intertwined, evolving layers of strategic progression to keep you engaged through the whole game experience. + Hand-painted art , which many people find beautiful; soon getting its own offline exhibition.
row.short_description: Complete the Path to Liberation in the mindfulness-themed idle/incremental game inspired by Buddhist philosophy. Enjoy a calm, atmospheric hand-painted Journey with strategic depth and multiple layers of progression.

row.name: ClickShot
row.detailed_description: Lock, load, click. ClickShot is a trigger-happy clicker where every tap fires your way to cosmetic gun upgrades and massive multipliers. Rack up shells, unlock a growing arsenal, and flex your custom loadout with flashy sights, muzzles, and lasers. Features: 🔫 Click your gun to earn shells and cash in on upgrades 💥 Unlock and equip cosmetics that boost your shell multiplier 🛠 Visit the Workbench to mix ‘n match sights, muzzles, and lasers 💼 Shop for new gear — everything you buy sticks with you permanently 🐢 Lightweight and snappy — perfect for short bursts or long grinds
row.short_description: Lock, Load, Click. A slick clicker game where every click pulls the trigger. Earn shells, unlock wild gun cosmetics, and stack permanent multipliers. Simple to play, hard to quit. Lock, load, and click your way to glory.

row.name: Greed's Grub
row.detailed_description: Greed's Grub is a first-person horror game where you must craft burgers for nightmarish and goofy customers in a hellish diner, facing terrifying challenges for five days in order to survive. You don’t remember exactly what you did, just that it had to have been real bad , if this was your punishment. Five days of community service in this greasy , rotting excuse for a burger joint . Just five days, and you’re free. That’s all you have to endure. Outlast Your Horrific Customers Serve up burgers to the most weirdest and nastiest customers from the depths of hell. Cook, Cook, Cook. Grill, assemble, and pray for five days straight at a cursed burger joint. Each day is more intense than the last. Beware the Boss from Hell The boss is watching, and failure isn’t an option. Keep your grill hot and your wits sharper, or face the consequences. This is an ongoing solo-developed project, created in just 3–4ish months of work. It’s still evolving, and player feedback is greatly appreciated as development continues. Expect regular updates, new features, and improvements based on community input. Your support and suggestions help shape the future of the game.

row.name: SteelSilk Championship
row.detailed_description: Get ready to enter the arena of SteelSilk Championship , a fast-paced roguelite action game playable solo or in local co-op! Control a heavily armed robotic spider with futuristic back-mounted rifles and face increasingly deadly hordes of insects. Fight to survive, unlock new arenas, and upgrade your character with procedural enhancements that make each run unique. Team up with a friend or take on the challenge alone—every match is different, and every choice matters. Do you have the steel nerves and silk threads to survive the championship?
row.short_description: Take control of a deadly robotic spider in this fast-paced roguelite shooter. Battle endless swarms of insects, unlock increasingly intense arenas, and power up with procedural upgrades—play solo or in thrilling local co-op!

row.name: Banana Loco

Levels: Reach more difficult levels by earning treasure scores Banana Treasures : Collect valuable banana treasures to win the round. row.name: Unbound
row.detailed_description: Notice This game was made for educational purposes at The Game Assembly in Malmö. The game is completely free and will remain so forever. About the Game As a wrongfully imprisoned monkey, you break out. Navigate through a hazardous, futuristic city to escape your pursuer and reach an off-world colony. Unbound is a 2D precision-platformer game originally made in 13 weeks by Primal Crowd , 13 students at The Game Assembly in Malmö. Features Precise Movement: Jump, Climb and Dash your way through 3 tricky levels filled with handcrafted precision-platforming challenges. You're Being Chased: The prison guard you escaped from just can't let you go! Outrun your pursuer and escape the planet. Retro Sci-Fi Aesthetic: Take in the views or just vibe. From an underground prison, to a dystopian city and a high-tech spaceport there's a little bit of everything to look at. Go Bananas: Want more challenge? Every level is filled with optional even trickier trials to overcome. Be rewarded with bananas for your skill. Can you collect them all...? See The Result Of Your Effort: The game keeps track of your time, bananas collected and death count. After each run of the game you'll see these displayed and the time be compared to your personal best. Enable the build-in speedrun timer to help you set a new best time. Credits Primal Crowd Programming Abraham Alberto Philip Eriksson Christian Le Elias Ronefors Ylver Blum Buer Graphics Dante Norling Eklöf Oliver Andersson Morgan Wildmark Emil Nilsson Animation Rebecca Kornemalm Theo Hübner Sallis Level Design Erik Gatewood Alvin Berthet  Special Thanks Alice Myhrman Sounds Sound effects provided by Soundsnap, Abraham Alberto and Oliver Andersson. Original Music by Abraham Alberto and Oliver Andersson. Voice acting by Philip Eriksson and Theo Hübner Sallis. Technologies Made in TGE The Game Engine by The Game Assembly Made using FMOD Studio by Firelight Technologies Pty Ltd.
row.short_description: Help Mox break out from his unjust inprisonment. Navigate through a hazardous, futuristic city and outrun your pursuer to reach an off-world colony in this 2D precision-platformer!
