row.name: Off The Grid
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Off The Grid, the next evolution of the shooter genre from visionary director Neill Blomkamp (District 9, Elysium). Set in a near-future world where contestants are cybernetically augmented and dropped into a televised bloodsport where death is temporary, but fame is forever. In Off The Grid, YOU are a modular death machine. Switch your cyberlimbs at any time, and adapt your playstyle on the fly. Loot the body parts of those that have perished around you, and assemble your dream loadout. With more than 15 limbs available to loot, steal or drop in with, the possibilities for mayhem are endless. Off The Grid takes movement to the next level with a dexterous aerial movement system driven by advanced jetpacks. With strong utilization of the verticality of the maps players are able to both enter and exit fights rapidly, rewarding aggression and a fast-paced gameplay. Drop onto Teardrop Island, a living, breathing paradise built with cutting-edge technologies. Every corner of the map is designed to deliver a truly cinematic experience, setting the stage for an ambitious 60-hour narrative campaign coming later this year. Finetune weaponry to fit your play style: with thousands of combinations there is a loadout for any kind of killer. Tune your guns to perfection with a wide variety of cosmetics and attachments, or lean heavy into Teardrop Island’s latest cyberlimbs in order to dominate the battlefield. Call in your customized loadout at any time and make the battlefield your playground. Extract high-value loot off the island amidst a brutal battle for survival. Adapt, outsmart and work your way closer to victory. Off The Grid isn’t just about being the last one standing, it’s about looting and extracting the most valuable gear before becoming the next casualty. Every item you extract or earn can be traded on the in-game marketplace. We've build a truly open game economy, whether you're snagging that weapon you’ve been coveting, or flipping unused gear, every deal is driven by real supply and demand. List, trade and build up your perfect loadout. When Regen technology is invented, it's bought out exclusively by a consortium of billion-dollar gaming companies to stage a Real Battle Royale. It's a Super Bowl-style televised bloodbath where everyday people are augmented with cyberlimbs and dropped onto an abandoned island to fight to the death.
row.short_description: Welcome to Off The Grid, the next-gen free to play Battle Royale from visionary director Neill Blomkamp. Set in a near-future world where contestants are cybernetically augmented and dropped into televised bloodsport. Death is temporary, but fame is forever.
row.notes: Off the Grid features violence, including futuristic gunfights, blood, and character deaths within a dystopian setting. The story explores mature themes such as social inequality, abuse of power, and surveillance. The game includes mild and veiled nudity. There are no sexual acts or depictions of sexual violence in the game.

row.name: Dream on
row.detailed_description: Dream On is a short first-person walking simulator focused on introspection and atmosphere. You’ll embark on a meditative journey through a symbolic dreamscape, exploring surreal environments that reflect the inner world of fears, hopes, and desires. Features: A brief experience — the game can be completed in about 5-10 minutes. Linear narrative with symbolic visuals and ambient storytelling. Immersive sound design — no dialogue or text, just music and sound to guide your experience. Simple controls — walk, look around, and interact with key objects. A meaningful choice at the end — what will you wish for? Dream On is not about challenges or puzzles. It's a quiet space to reflect, feel, and simply be . Perfect for players looking for a short emotional escape or a peaceful moment before sleep.
row.short_description: Dream On is a very short, atmospheric walking simulator (5-10 minutes) about making a wish. Walk through a symbolic dreamscape, explore your thoughts and feelings, and make a quiet, meaningful choice at the end of the journey.

row.name: Train Driver 2
row.detailed_description: Experience Polish railways like never before! Welcome to Train Driver 2, a unique Polish railway simulator created by enthusiasts for enthusiasts, which will transport you right into the heart of the dynamic world of railways. Designed with online multiplayer gameplay in mind, Train Driver 2 lets you take on one of two key roles: a Train Driver operating the train, or a Dispatcher managing complex traffic at stations and posts. Feel true cooperation, where the dispatcher's actions directly impact the driver's work, and smooth traffic flow depends on your coordination.   The simulator emphasizes high realism, offering faithfully recreated Polish rolling stock (electric and diesel locomotives, EMUs/DMUs), realistic, multi-kilometer routes, and detailed railway procedures. Immerse yourself in the depth of the simulation thanks to the recreation of specialized traffic control systems, such as SWDR, relay interlocking panels, and computer-based systems. Drive various trains – from passenger and fast trains, through expresses, to heavy freight consists, and even perform shunting operations.   Not ready for online challenges? Practice your skills in offline mode . Want to leave your mark on the game world? Use the scenery editor to create your own stations – fictional or based on reality – and share them with the entire community.   Train Driver 2 is more than just a game – it's a vibrant community of enthusiasts, a platform for learning about railways, and a chance to virtually experience the work of a railway professional. Join us and start your railway adventure!
row.short_description: Polish railway simulator emphasizing multiplayer and realism. Become a train driver, operating faithfully recreated trains, or a dispatcher, managing traffic and signalling equipment at your post. Cooperate online, build stations in the editor, and join railway enthusiasts!

row.name: RuJuWi
row.detailed_description: Run, Jump, Win! Build your own levels, share them and play the levels the other players created! RuJuWi is a fun little platform game that lets you create your own levels, play them as the little slime Puya and share them with others via the Workshop. Use blocks and platforms to create the base structure of your level, fill it with power-ups, enemies and various objects. You can even use mechanisms, allowing you to make logical circuits to move platforms, create blocks or open doors! Finally, add some decorations in the background to really personalize your levels! This game contains: Dozens of Blocks and Platforms to shape your world as you want: from the classic plains to the frozen heights, a fiery volcano and modern buildings! Pickups to help Puya through her adventure: more health, more jumps, invincibility time and keys to open doors. Powerups that make Puya stronger by allowing her to dash, fly, climb walls, drill and even more! Whether to help her mobility or to defeat enemies, powerups are essentials! Of course, Enemies are here too! They walk, run, dash, fly, even explode, but most of all, they want you gone! Mechanisms to make your level a little more 'brainy'. There's everything you need: buttons, switches, targets, timers, doors, teleporters, fans... And even logical gates to link them up! Some Objects will also help Puya during her adventures: boulders and boxes to climb higher, geysers to make her fly, bumpers and shooters to send her in every direction. However, be careful to not end up on some pikes, it could be... deadly. You can also change the rules of your levels, by adding water and lava flooding the level, make it night time, reducing the field of vision of Puya, end even change gravity! Make whatever YOU want and play whatever YOU want!
row.short_description: Run, Jump, Win! Build your own levels, share them and play the levels other players created!

row.name: Drift Legends 2
row.detailed_description: Arcade drift physics • 50+ legendary cars • Story campaign • Visual customization • Online PvP & co-op • Cross-platform competitions • Daily & weekly events with prizes • Weekly leaderboards • Controller & Steam Deck support • Low-spec friendly Drift Legends 2 is an arcade drifting game built for pure style, collection and competition. Start your journey from rookie to elite  in a full story campaign , collect 50+ beautifully detailed cars  — from JDM icons  to American muscle  and European legends  — and dominate in online PvP  and co-op  events. Show your identity with visual customization  (paints, liveries, wheels, tires, license plates), climb weekly leaderboards , and win cosmetics and premium cars . The game features controller support , is optimized for Steam Deck , and runs great on everyday PCs . Key Features Arcade drift physics — smooth, responsive and satisfying slides. 50+ legendary cars — JDM classics, raw muscle and timeless European machines. [b] Story campaign (beginners→elite)  — prove yourself and unlock new chapters. Online PvP & co-op — ranked duels, team challenges and casual rooms. Cross-platform competitions — play with friends across platforms. Daily & weekly events with prizes — chase new goals every day. Weekly leaderboards— compete for top spots and exclusive rewards. Visual customization only — paints, liveries, wheels, tires, license plates (no performance tuning, no pay-to-win). Controller support & Steam Deck optimization — pick up and drift anywhere. Low-spec friendly — designed to run smoothly on typical office PCs. Why you’ll love it If you enjoy the style and freedom of Forza Horizon and the high-energy vibe of Need for Speed , this is your drift playground : collect legends, perfect your lines and rule the leaderboards — for free . Note: customization affects visuals only and does not provide gameplay advantages .
row.short_description: Arcade drifting with 50+ dream cars, from JDM icons to American Muscle. Master the art of the drift in a huge career, then dominate the competition in cross-platform online battles. Your legend begins now—no high-end PC required.

row.name: 디시인사이드 중붕이의 모험2 (Jungbung's Adventure 2)
row.detailed_description: This game supports English subtitles. This is a role-playing game about the adventures of 'Kim Jungbung,' a game streamer active on DC Inside. It follows a traditional JRPG style where the player engages in conversations with characters to progress through the story. This is the sequel to “Jungbung’s Adventure on DC Inside” , continuing from the first installment. After many twists and turns, Kim Jungbung finally becomes a retro game master— but now, he's on the verge of losing his job due to the low popularity of his game streams. Will Kim Jungbung be able to overcome this crisis and keep his title as a retro game master? Let’s join the journey and fight through the struggles of an ordinary young man!
row.short_description: This is a role-playing game about the adventures of 'Kim Jungbung,' a game streamer active on DC Inside. It follows a traditional JRPG style where the player engages in conversations with characters to progress through the story.

row.name: Kindergarten of hell
row.detailed_description: Kindergarten of hell: A childlike terror Synopsis : Dive into the heart of horror in Kindergarten of Hell, a horror adventure game where the nightmare takes on childlike allusions. You play a detective, investigating a mysterious disappearance in a seemingly innocent nursery. But behind the pastel walls and seemingly harmless toys lurks a twisted, monstrous reality. Mysterious creatures, from the childhood imagination. Gameplay : Kindergarten of Hell combines exploration, puzzle solving and the course Winding Journey : Navigate through the labyrinthine corridors of the daycare, each more terrifying than the previous. Classrooms transformed into torture chambers, a playground haunted by menacing shadows, and a canteen where the day’s meal is an unspeakable horror await you. Macabre puzzles : Solve twisted puzzles, inspired by children's games, but perverted and morbid. Clues are hidden in unexpected places, and their discovery will not be without danger. Get ready to face your own warped childhood. Atmosphere : The atmosphere of the game is designed to immerse you in a constant discomfort. The graphics, stylized yet horrific, accentuate the contrast between the innocent appearance of the school and the monstrous reality that lurks there. Characters : You will meet unreassuring pets
row.short_description: You are a detective investigating a case that has been forgotten for 5 years. The case involves finding out why everyone disappeared from a daycare.

row.name: ESA SHIELD
row.detailed_description: ESA SHIELD - Earth's Safety Starts with You! Become head of the European Space Agency's Space Safety Department and protect Earth from real cosmic hazards like Asteroids , Space Debris , and Space Weather . This science-based Planetary Protection Simulator combines tower defense, roguelite, and strategy elements to create a unique gameplay experience grounded in reality. Before you can defend Earth, you need to see the threats coming. Build powerful ground-based monitoring systems to scan the skies for incoming danger—from massive solar storms to fast-moving asteroids. But ground systems alone won’t be enough. Built and sent your satellites into orbit to create a global network of satellites. The more eyes you have in space, the better your chances of survival. Early detection is your best defense. With the right data, you can assess each threat, determine its danger level, and launch the right countermeasures—before it’s too late. Every successful mission makes you stronger. Earn resources, unlock new technologies, and upgrade your systems to stay one step ahead of the next big space threat. ESA SHIELD  is more than a game: It’s a space mission! It is developed as an outreach initiative for the European Space Agency to confront one of the most overlooked challenges in spacecraft: Space Safety. Play the game and support ESA in its mission to keep space safe and Earth protected. ☄️  Encounter Real Space Threats  Face the same dangers ESA deals with today. Coronal mass ejections, asteroid impacts, and space debris. Each threat behaves differently, affecting systems in unique ways, and demands its own monitoring and defense approach. Every decision could be the difference between survival and orbital disaster. 🔬 Research Real Technologies Unlock and implement real-world tech from past missions, current prototypes, and near-future plans. Build your strategy using actual science and engineering: from telescopes to deflection rockets. 🛰️ Build and Customize Satellites Design your own space systems: choose components, mission goals, and orbital paths. Balance cost, stability, and lifetime to create your optimal satellite system. 📡 Monitor the Skies Deploy and upgrade detection systems like telescopes and radar arrays. Expand your coverage, improve precision, and catch incoming threats before they hit. 🚀 Defend Earth and Infrastructure Build and operate space-based defense systems to prevent catastrophic impacts. Launch interceptors, trigger system shutdowns, or send clean-up bots into decaying orbits. 🎯 Make Strategic Decisions Under Pressure Every threat comes with uncertainty. React with limited data, weigh the risks, and choose between bold moves or conservative actions. Your judgment matters. Under a programme of, and funded by, the European Space Agency.
row.short_description: Join the European Space Agency's SHIELD mission and discover why aliens aren't the biggest threat to us! In this science-based Planetary Protection Simulator, you fight real cosmic hazards. Build, Monitor, Protect! Become Earth's Last Defense.

row.name: Lords of the Fallen - Free Friend's Pass
row.detailed_description: Experience the epic dark fantasy action-RPG, Lords of the Fallen, with the new Free Friend’s Pass.  Provides all players with free access to the character creator and tutorial area Upon completion of the tutorial area, you can then join any friend who owns the base game in online co-op, ready to continue your adventure through Mournstead side-by-side from beginning to end All character progress and loot will be saved between online sessions. Only the host owning base game saves world progression. All character and world progress made during the Free Friend's Pass will be transferred to the full game upon purchase. Lords of the Fallen introduces an all-new, epic RPG adventure in a vast, interconnected world. Aeons after his defeat by the hands of man, the demon God Adyr’s resurrection draws nigh. As a fabled Dark Crusader, journey through the realms of the living and the dead in this expansive RPG experience to overthrow Adyr once and for all. Featuring colossal boss battles, fast challenging combat, and deep, immersive storytelling.  Explore A Vast, Interconnected World Journey across two expansive, parallel worlds - the world of the living and the dead - with each harbouring its own pathways, secrets, treasures… and foes. Master Fast, Challenging Combat Choose from 100s of unique weapons, from heavy-hitting flails to rapid-fire crossbows, or forgo metal for magic with devastating attacks of the arcane. Unite in Online Multiplayer Experience the campaign alone, or unite with other players in full ‘shared progression’ online co-op. Provided you and your companion are on the same ‘New Game’ playthrough and have defeated a similar number of main bosses (within one), both players will save all mainline progress. Or invite any friend who doesn't own the game to adventure by your side using the Free Friend’s Pass.  Customise your Journey With the Advanced Game Modifier System, fully customise your gaming experience, including enemy density, randomised loot, pre-upgraded weapons, permadeath, and more.  Define Your Legend Personalise your character’s appearance before selecting one of nine varied character classes. Whichever starting path you take, develop your own playstyle by upgrading stats and weapons. Post-Launch Updates  Over 50 post-launch updates have been released, vastly improving the experience with significant performance enhancements, rigorous difficulty balancing in response to player feedback, multiple new questlines, enhanced combat and character movement, and a number of new Quality-of-Life features.  Key Features: Journey across two vast, parallel worlds Fully customise your experience with the Advanced Gameplay Modifier System (immediately available)  Master a fast, fluid and challenging combat system Overcome epic boss battles Wield devastating magic attacks and character buffs Adventure side by side in  full ‘shared progression’; online co-op with crossplay functionality Play with any friend who doesn’t own the game with the Free Friend’s Pass (only host saves progress) Choose from 9 starting character classes, including Knight, Rogue and Fire Apprentice Replay any boss in ‘Echoes of Battle’ mode (accessed at any vestige)  Face the ultimate bossrush challenge in ‘Crucible’ mode (accessed at any vestige)
row.short_description: Experience the epic dark fantasy action-RPG, Lords of the Fallen. With the Free Friend’s Pass, join any friend who owns the base game in online co-op and journey side by side through the entire campaign for free.

row.name: FREST
row.detailed_description: When Riley stumbles across a mysterious portal in her backyard, she’s transported to Nekojima —a mystical world teetering on the edge of collapse. Inhabited by feline-like beings called Cates . Three tyrannical World Lords now rule the once peaceful land. Guided by a strange talking frog named Ben , Riley must fight to restore balance, uncover the truth, and find a way back home. Master your moves and push your limits! Master your moveset and learn new tools to overcome increasingly difficult obstacles. Replay levels against a timer, or go up against new and more challenging areas once you've beaten a level! Reconnect a fractured world. Traverse across three different provinces to free the trapped cates, and build a new home. Uncover hidden pages that slowly reveal the secrets of a world lost to time.
row.short_description: Unravel a forgotten world. Discover your power. Decide its fate. When Riley stumbles across a mysterious portal in her backyard, she’s transported to Nekojima—a mystical world teetering on the edge of collapse.

row.name: Moon Tropica
row.detailed_description: Moon Tropica is a free-to-play, top-down, hack and slash PVP fighter. Team up with, or play against friends using a wide array of powerful weapons in a variety of unique, dynamic maps. BECOME A LEGEND Step into the adventurous, energetic, heart-pounding battle arenas where strategy, skill, and determination are put to the ultimate test. Earn XP progression, complete quests, conquer challenges, and receive rewards all while customizing your fully dynamic character from head-to-toe. POWERFUL ITEMS By any means necessary! Open chests and loot your opponents for a variety of special weapons ranging from boomerangs, bows, elemental staffs, and the ever-so-powerful 'Zuka'. Strategically use objects and dynamic elements from around the map to eliminate your opponents. EXCITING GAME MODES Fend for yourself, eliminate all of the other opponents, and show them who's boss in the ultra fast paced Free-For-All, and 5 Lives game modes. If you're looking for more strategy, team up with friends and dominate the other team in Team Deathmatch and King Of The Hill. VIBRANT COMMUNITY Join the fight and meet other players on the battlefield. Express yourself with a variety of emotes and utilize the  seamless text chat. Whether you want to play solo, or with a group of friends, there is always a new experience that awaits. Disclaimer: Moon Tropica is currently in Early Access. Some advertised features shown in-game or in promotional materials are not yet available in the current build. These elements are presented for visual and illustrative purposes only and will be introduced as development progresses. The following features are coming soon: Item Shop Quests Friends Career Jeet Fest Palm Haven Controller Compatibility Sprays Fireworks Animations Pets We appreciate your support and patience as we continue building the full Moon Tropica experience.

Engage in high-energy, low-temperature warfare across dozens of unique maps, wield a variety of wacky and powerful weapons, and customize your penguin to strike fear (and maybe laughter) into your enemies. row.name: The Communist Manifesto ~ A Visual Novel
row.detailed_description: The visual novel adaptation of The Communist Manifesto by Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels. Experience the Manifesto in a conversational style and choose your own topics to focus on. Choose whether to ask Engels for footnotes. Unlock the ending after reading Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Get more detail about the vocabulary used in the glossary and track your completion of the glossary to unlock extra features. Unlock extra features including music, introductions, postscript, backgrounds, and the image gallery. Choose what music to play from the soundtrack using the Music Select menu. Unlock 19th century paintings related to locations and events of the Manifesto and its authors to display as backgrounds during your reading. Customize your reading experience further by turning off choice menus, music changes, and animations. Unlock and view images of the authors, drawings of them, and sketches by Engels.
row.short_description: The visual novel adaptation of The Communist Manifesto by Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels. Experience the Manifesto in a conversational style for the first time and fully customize your reading.

row.name: MineSweeper Rush
row.detailed_description: Introduction MineSweeper Rush is a new 2D casual game that follows classic Minesweeper rules and adds new features for a fast-paced, competitive experience. The minefield grows upward continuously. When you hit a mine, the game does not end immediately—instead, two new rows are quickly added. Clearing a row happens when you mark all the mines in it. If there are fewer than four rows, four new rows appear along with bonus points. As your score increases, the game speeds up. This racing element means every second counts and makes the challenge even tougher. You can choose from three modes: Easy, Normal, and Hard, or change the board size and the number of mines using shortcut keys. Your high score is recorded on one of five leaderboards so you can compare your speed and accuracy with other players. Gameplay Right-clicking a block puts a question mark on it. A block gets a flag only when it is confirmed to have a mine. You can mark a block by clicking the number next to it, and the game will automatically place flags based on the situation. Four different drag modes help you clear mines faster and score more points in less time. An AI system keeps the game fair. If no safe move exists, clicking a mine will not cause a penalty. Features A built-in tutorial shows you how to play quickly, while the help menu provides clear pictures and step-by-step instructions on rules and strategies. Background music and sound effects build excitement and help you focus during the race. Six different skins are available to reduce eye strain during long, fast-paced sessions. The game window can be resized to perfectly match the board size and your screen resolution. A hidden cheat mode displays solvable blocks and automatically clears mines, making it easier to learn quick strategies. Various number display styles help you see the game state clearly, so you can plan your moves rapidly.
row.short_description: MineSweeper Rush brings a fresh twist to classic Minesweeper with a growing minefield and fast row clearance. Every second counts as you race to beat your high score and climb the leaderboards.
row.reviews: “It's all cheap and cheerful, especially that midi music, but it's a free Minesweeper variant. I'm quite charmed by it. Feels like a freeware game I might have got off a cover disc with cheery RPS fanzine PC Gamer in the late 90s.” Rock Paper Shotgun

row.name: Dependency Psychological Test
row.detailed_description: Dependency Psychological Test is a narrative-driven point-and-click game that blends everyday storytelling with interactive psychological testing. Rooted in the field of psychometrics, the game invites players to explore the concept of dependency through branching dialogue, subtle choices, and relationship-building. In a cozy, life-like setting, you'll interact with family members, friends, and neighbors. Through meaningful conversations and small yet impactful decisions, you’ll uncover how you respond to emotional, social, and practical challenges—on your own, or by relying on others. Do you trust yourself, or do you seek help when things get tough? Your choices shape not only the story but also your personal psychological report at the end of the game, offering insights into your dependence levels and self-confidence. Whether you’re a fan of introspective games, narrative exploration, or simply curious about yourself, Dependency Psychological Test offers a calm, reflective gameplay experience with multiple outcomes based on how you engage with the world.
row.short_description: A narrative-driven point-and-click game that explores dependent personality through interactive psychological testing. Make choices, build relationships, and discover how your behavior shapes your mental assessment.

row.name: The Journey East and West
row.detailed_description: You are a claim jumper, you must make your way back to Missouri for another chance to receive a claim in Oregon. This game was made for my NMU CS120 Winter 2025 semester final project. It is a text-based game similar to games like The Oregon Trail, where you use number inputs in order to make decisions that control the game played through the console. You will have to deal with random events with success based off of random chance and manage resources because there has to be some fail state or the game would be boring. Open JDK no longer needs to be installed and added to your systems PATH. Do not be alarmed when a Command Prompt window opens, that is the game.

row.name: Dillo's Dilemma
row.detailed_description: Step into the role of Dillo, the ingenious armadillo with pinball expertise, in this dynamic 3D physics collectathon! Master mind-bending pinball structures and fast-paced movement as you roll through vibrant, sprawling worlds filled with intricate challenges. With every agile flip, bounce, and roll, unleash your creative strategies to overcome movement puzzles and destroy Rat King's forts. Rally your firefly friends scattered across diverse environments and prove that clever mechanics and bold determination can light up even the darkest corners of the world. Will your pinball prowess and quick wits save the day? Roll Fast, Think Smart – Save the Fireflies! In Dillo’s Dilemma , you play as Dillo, a clever armadillo who mastered the art of rolling into a high-speed pinball to navigate the world! Use your shell not just for defense, but for movement, puzzles, and offense! Master the World of Pinball Movement Traverse the environment with lightning-fast momentum using handcrafted pinball contraptions. Build and chain your own machines to create wild traversal paths and reach new achievements! Explore Two Vast Worlds and a Vibrant Hub Discover two different worlds – each packed with secrets, challenges, and hidden fireflies. Dive into mini-levels scattered across the overworld and return to your cozy home to prepare your next move. Save Your Firefly Friends from the Rat King The Rat King’s minions have taken over your homeland. Pinpoint their forts across the land, plan your route, and launch strategic assaults to rescue your captured friends! Game Features Momentum-based movement through rolling and bouncing physics. Build and ride through pinball contraptions of your own making. Two expansive worlds with layered mini-levels and a central Hub area. Overworld forts to scout, plan, infiltrate, and destroy in your mission to save fireflies. A colorful, stylized world full of secrets, shortcuts, and surprises. Test your skills and complete your collection by finding all the hidden fireflies.
row.short_description: Play as Dillo, a clever armadillo with pinball contraptions, in this thrilling 3D physics collectathon! Roll through vivid, expansive worlds, conquer dynamic puzzles, and smash the Rat King’s mighty forts. Rally your brave firefly friends to overcome challenges and save the day!

Guild Hall Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Ready your guild. Shape your destiny. Guild Hall Simulator: Prologue gives you an early chance to step into the role of a guild master — build your guild, manage heroes, and guide your hall to legendary fame! Don't forget to wishlist the full game to continue your journey and build the greatest adventuring guild the world has ever seen. Guild Management Design and build your perfect guild hall: • Place crafting stations, taverns, research labs, and training grounds. • Optimize your layout to empower your adventurers and boost quest success. • Unlock adventurers' hidden potential by matching the right hero to the right quest — from humble G rank missions to elite SSS ranked challenges. Economy Management Start your journey from zero fame and no gold : • Set item prices and manage your inventory. • Grow your guild’s economy carefully — even when pressure rises. • Balance risk and reward: will you prioritize fame, fortune, or survival? The Adventure Continues! This Prologue is just the beginning. Wishlist Guild Hall Simulator to experience the full game, where your choices matter: • Rebuild your guild from rubble in an abandoned town. • Gather materials through mining, farming, and logging. • Craft rare weapons, forge armor, and brew powerful potions. • Train weaker adventurers to meet quest requirements. • Defend your guild and town against monster attacks. • Automate your operations to run a thriving guild hall — even while adventurers eat, drink, and celebrate! Will your guild rise as the last beacon of hope - or collapse under the weight of ambition? The choice is yours, Guild Master.
row.short_description: Build your guild. Shape your story. In Guild Hall Simulator, you don't slay dragons — you send others to do it. Manage gold, assign quests, upgrade your hall, and wrangle rowdy adventurers who drink too much. Will your guild rise to fame...or collapse under a mountain of paperwork (and slimes)?

row.name: project; VIRAI: DOOMER’s LIFE ESCAPE Playtest
Granvir: Zero Front
row.detailed_description: Experience The Full Game Out Now! About the Game Granvir: Zero Front is a third person shooter action roguelite featuring mech building. Experience the prelude to the Millennium Horizon campaign in Granvir as the first resistance response to the Millenium Company invasion. Players battle through a route of their choice reaching extraction and completing side objectives at the cost of valuable resources. Between battles, players can swap out parts for upgrades found on the battlefield and manage their campaign by taking on loans to afford ammunition, aiding the locals for support in battle and more. Equip devastating melee weapons such as swords, rocket spears and pile bunkers. Wield powerful long range guns like cannons, machine guns, flamethrowers and rocket pods. Mix and match armaments to suit your play style. Mix torsos, legs, armatures and special modules to customize your Granvir. Defeating enemy ace pilots unlocks their unique parts. Complete any campaign in single-player or multiplayer co-op with up to 10 Granvir pilots at a time. Share parts and resources utilizing the squad depot in rest areas as you plan your next moves. No campaign is the same as you manage time, resources and your route to each objective. Each zone impacts what services and resources are available. Use down time between missions to refit and upgrade your Granvir to prevail.
row.short_description: Granvir: Zero Front is a 3rd person action roguelite mech-builder with co-op multiplayer. Experience the prelude to Granvir as the resistance response to the Millennium Company invasion. Pilot your Granvir, manage your campaign between battles to find the best equipment, and stay in the fight.

row.name: Path of Master 大師之路
row.detailed_description: Path of Master is built with Unreal Engine 5. The gameplay blends survival, Musou, and bullet‑hell elements. We’ve removed the usual roguelike pause‑to‑select‑skill mechanic and now upgrade skills on the fly by picking up skill cubes at the right moment. Your weapon has two interchangeable attack modes; using a special attack sacrifices your normal attack. After surviving the first four stages, Hell Island unlocks—granting massive gold but far tougher challenges. Survive ten minutes there to earn a powerful hidden perk.
row.short_description: Path of Master is a roguelike‑inspired casual monster‑grinding game.You can continuously upgrade your skills to slay hordes of monsters and strive to survive.

row.name: ちゅーちゅーパンケーキ
row.detailed_description: Game Overview A high-speed puzzle action game for all ages, with a cute world view and stress-free operation. The operation is simple, but it is a deep game where player skill is important. Carry, match, and stack! Let's make a tall pancake tower! 'Deliver the pancake tower to the sky!' While chasing the moving cargo bed, you quickly carry food and make pancakes. Not only carrying, but also the quick thinking to instantly decide which food to stack from the food on the spot is important. Completing the recipe will generate a combo bonus and you can aim for a high score. The performance after clearing is also a point of interest. Try stacking pancakes high and high to make a giant pancake tower! Single Play For all ages
row.short_description: This is a high-speed puzzle action game for all ages, with a cute world view and stress-free controls.

row.name: ddz Online
row.detailed_description: 'ddz Online' is a classic card game that faithfully recreates the traditional Dou Di Zhu gameplay. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned player, you can easily dive into this widely loved national game. Simple rules, intense strategy, and thrilling rounds make every match enjoyable and challenging. Play with friends or hone your skills in single-player mode—experience the charm of this timeless poker game anytime, anywhere. The game server currently has very few players, so you might only be able to play against bots. Note: The game client is open source. If you are using a client downloaded from a non-Steam source, please do not recharge gold in it. The only legitimate way to recharge gold in the game is through the official Steam store; any other websites or private recharge exchanges are scams.
row.short_description: 'ddz Online' is a classic card game that faithfully recreates the traditional Dou Di Zhu gameplay.

row.name: Blade & Soul NEO
row.detailed_description: The Story Embark on a treacherous adventure as you track down the villains who killed your master. Uncover hidden secrets as you meet dozens of complex characters. Develop your skills and reveal your true potential as you become a master in your own right. The World Immerse yourself in the dense forests, breathtaking vistas, expansive deserts, and savage wildlands of the Earthen Realm. Freely explore alluring regions, meet friends in bustling villages, and delve into dark corners where dangerous foes lie in wait. Infinite Windwalk With no stamina bar explore the far reaches of the Earthen Realm with unprecedented freedom. Scale walls, soar over mountains, and run on water in style with new custom Windwalk animations. Martial Arts Enjoy Blade & Soul's iconic action-based combat with upgraded animation and graphics. Switch seamlessly between Classic and 'B&S' combat modes as you spar with powerful opponents. The new skill extraction system allows for an unprecedented amount of customization as you master the unique skills of your class. Dungeons Powerful opponents threaten the balance. To defeat them you must master your skills, learn their attack strategies, and work closely with your allies. With each victory, you'll earn powerful weapons, valuable accessories, and unique portraits. Explore dungeons solo or use the robust party matching system to team up with up to 5 other players.
row.short_description: Relive an iconic tale with Blade & Soul NEO. Fully remastered where players reconnect with the original spirit of the free-to-play, open-world MMORPG. Experience a richer visually enhanced experience set in a world of Wuxia mythology where fast-paced combat collides with the stunning visual beauty.

row.name: There Will Be Light
row.detailed_description: Descend into a dreamlike journey through the subconscious, where foggy thoughts cloud the path forward. Solve atmospheric puzzles to bring clarity and light back into a fractured mind. Explore surreal landscapes in this introspective and emotional puzzle game about healing and self-discovery. The story is about a person and their fears and negative subconscious thoughts that inhabit them. As you progress, you dive deep into the subconscious to fight those foggy thoughts and regain confidence in yourself. Perhaps in the end, your view of yourself, the world, and all the problems you deal with might be a little more optimistic. Can anything really go wrong?
row.short_description: There Will Be Light is a top-down puzzle adventure in a gloomy but cozy environment. To progress, you have to solve tricky logic puzzles, while defending yourself against enemies. Dive into this cozy but challenging puzzle adventure as you solve riddles and fight your way back to the light.

row.name: My Desktop Sister
row.detailed_description: Meet My Desktop Sister , an interactive Virtual desktop companion with a tsundere twist! She’s not just a cute anime girl sitting on your screen—she reacts to your actions, remembers past interactions, and has a personality all her own. Whether she’s teasing you, giving you quests, or demanding attention, she’ll make sure you never feel alone at your desk. Features: Interactive Desktop Companion – She lives right on your screen, constantly moving, reacting, and even commenting on your activities as you go about your day. She’s more than just an icon—she’s an engaging, dynamic character that interacts with you in real-time, adding a layer of personality and charm to your desktop experience. Dynamic Mood System – Her personality evolves based on how you treat her, shifting between a variety of moods such as Happy, Annoyed, Playful, or even Sad. The way you interact with her directly influences her reactions, creating a truly personalized experience where your actions shape her behavior. Fully Voiced Dialogue – Immerse yourself in her world with tsundere-style voice lines that bring her to life! And that’s just the beginning—expect even more voice lines and character development in future updates, as her personality and interactions continue to grow. Gift & Inventory System – Show your affection by giving her gifts and watch her adorable, sometimes humorous reactions. Each gift unlocks new ways to interact and build a deeper connection with her, making the experience more rewarding and fun. Quests & Daily Interactions – Take on daily tasks and complete unique quests to earn rewards and unlock special dialogue events. As you progress, you'll discover hidden moments and surprises that make each interaction feel fresh and exciting, all while strengthening your bond with your desktop companion. Whether you’re looking for a productivity companion, an interactive VTuber-style friend, or just a fun, tsundere-infused desktop experience— My Desktop Sister is here to stay (whether she admits she likes you or not).
row.short_description: My Desktop Sister is a computer desktop companion. Experience the love and kindness from My Desktop Sister.

row.name: Treasure Hunters: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Every dungeon you step into presents its own set of challenges. To stand a chance against the odds, your equipment selection is key. Choose wisely, for your survival depends on it. Set off on exciting adventures through randomly generated dungeons. Each trip brings fresh surprises. Seek the most valuable hidden treasures and overcome different challenges while wandering through twisting paths and mysterious rooms with your friends. As one of the few talented treasure hunters out there, your only duty is to find and steal the most valuable treasures in various dungeons alongside your gang. But keep that in mind not all loot is worth the haul. Heavy, cheap finds could slow you down, choose 'em wisely. And sell them to acquire new equipment for raiding larger and more perilous dungeons, or purchasing cosmetics to customize your character. These dungeons are too dangerous and complicated to raid alone. Form your gang to overcome the creatures that you will encounter and solve the puzzles that require cooperation. Within ominous depths of these ancient dungeons, fraught with twisting passages and hidden traps, lie in wait for an array of perilous creatures, each more fearsome than the last, their eyes gleaming with malevolence and hunger, so do your utmost to stay alive against these formidable odds!
row.short_description: Treasure Hunters: Prologue is a free intense CO-OP treasure-hunting game set in mysterious dungeons filled with puzzles, platforms, and deadly creatures where your goal is to find and steal the most valuable treasures.
row.notes: The game set in a realistic dark place. Players can die for various reasons, kill creatures and their coop friends. The game includes blood ,skeletons and spiders. Players can use medical drugs to boost their stamina.

row.name: Coded Black
row.detailed_description: Coded Black is a bold, narrative-driven experience that immerses players in the hidden and haunting histories of anti-Blackness in the US and UK. This is an experience designed to be difficult – mentally and emotionally. Drawing from primary sources, historical records and scholarly analysis, Coded Black offers a journey through past atrocities and moments of triumph. Explore two distinct, atmospheric scenes  – a plantation and a modern 20th-century city – each filled with real historical documents and audio visual storytelling. With a structure that surfaces different content in each run, Coded Black is a narrative crafted for both personal reflection and educational engagement. Amidst the darkness, Coded Black also shines. Players can find glowing “balls of light” that reveal stories of Black achievement, resilience, and humanity – offering powerful moments of reflection and hope. Blurring the lines between game and museum exhibit, this is an experience about witnessing, understanding and feeling the weight of history through an interactive lens. _ This game is free to play and designed to be used as both an interactive exhibit and a teaching tool. A companion website provides expanded resources, bibliographies, and theoretical materials not included in the game itself. For information about the game, its creators and sources, visit codedblack.info.
row.short_description: A narrative-driven social justice game exploring the suppressed histories of anti-Blackness in the US and UK. Confront racial injustice and discover moments of Black resilience and humanity through storytelling and historical evidence.
row.notes: The game deals with the historical topic of slavery and racism, and therefore includes descriptions of violent acts, images of devices used for the chastisement of enslaved people, and archival imagery depicting victims of lynching.

row.name: Desktop Garden
row.detailed_description: Type, grow, and decorate – let your plants thrive while you work! Every keystroke helps a plant grow! You can write, code, or just chat and this peaceful desktop overlay will reward you by growing your own plants during your everyday routine. Start with a tiny sprout that grows as you type and turn it into a wonderful plant. When your screen gets crowded, move your plants to a foldable plant shelf, where they continue growing quietly in the background. Over time, you'll discover a variety of plant types! Decorate your desktop with your favorite green companions and build your own little digital garden. Place stickers on your plants and give them names :) And if you're the productive type, track how much you've typed with a gentle growth-based progress system – watch your focus bloom alongside your plants. Features Plants grow with every keystroke Move grown plants into a collapsible shelf to clear your screen Discover a variety of plants Place stickers on plants and give them a name Keep growing plants even when they're in storage Decorate your desktop with your favorite green friends Track your typing activity through plant growth
row.short_description: Type and watch your garden grow! Every keystroke and mouse click lets your plants grow. Decorate your screen, or store them away to keep your screen clear. Place stickers on your plants and give them a name! Can you collect all types of plants?

row.name: Bakery Cafe Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Experience the first few hours of “Bakery Cafe Simulator” solo or with up to 4 players online. In this prologue you'll find 10 recipes to cook for your customers, including various coffee recipes and a few pastries such as cookies and cakes. Thirty or so customization elements for your store will also be available, allowing you to let your imagination run wild as you personalize your store. About the game mechanics Build and furnish your café according to your desires. Place tables for customers, decorate and organize your kitchen to be productive. Manage your orders for raw materials so you always have something to offer your customers. Enjoy a varied and demanding culinary experience. Be careful not to keep customers waiting, they could become unhappy.
row.short_description: Start bake, build, and grow your dream bakery cafe with prologue now! Create delicious pastries, design your space, and serve customers. Play solo or with friends in online co-op to expand your business and experience the excitement of running a bustling cafe!

row.name: Quantum Dogfight
row.detailed_description: Superposition Quantum Dogfight is a guessing strategy game centered around the quantum mechanical principle of superposition.  At the beginning of each game both players place their planes in two distinct locations, as shown below. Guessing Locations The core gameplay of Quantum Dogfight is turn-based guessing of each player's plane locations. While in superposition, both locations of a plane can be 'attacked', with the goal of successfully attacking all locations of either locations.   Measurement Collapse While attacking your opponent's hex tiles is the way to win, players must also monitor their own board and strategically choose when to invoke a 'measurement collapse'.  This action begins a measurement like shown below, which probabilistically chooses one of the two superposition locations to be final location of the plane.  Players will want to utilize measurement collapses to confuse their opponent, but be warned, just like in quantum machanics you can't control probability! Learning Quantum Mechanics Quantum Dogfight was designed with young STEM-oriented students in mind, providing a fun and interactive way to learn about elements of quantum mechanics.  Found within Quantum Dogfight is a learning module which helps students understand how principles of quantum mechanics are woven into the mechanics of the game. Ways to Play Quantum Dogfight v1.0.0 features two ways for players to enjoy the game.      Local - Players take turns sharing a single computer    Online - Players can connect from two computers over the internet
row.short_description: Quantum Dogfight is a 2-player guessing strategy game where players must correctly locate all of their opponent's planes on a hexagonal grid. Inspired by the principles of quantum mechanics, Quantum Dogfght is a fun and interactive way to learn about superposition and measurement collapse.

row.name: Changgwi
row.detailed_description: One pitch-black night, an entrance of Joseon-era village is right in front. By royal command, you are here to uncover the truth behind the tragedy in this once-inhabited place. In a situation where you can't see even an inch ahead, t he only thing you can rely on now is a small lantern upon your hand. Evade the cursed bodies. Explore the village. Find a clue to end this tragic story. Play solo or co-op with friends (up to 4 players). Use items you find during your investigation to survive. Trailer BGM Credit : Samulnori - “Hwimori” by eeunbook (YouTube Channel)
row.short_description: First-perspective Co-op horror game (up to 4 online players). A terrible incident has struck a Joseon-era village. Become an investigator and survive the cursed night.

row.name: The Others
row.detailed_description: Overview 'The Others' is a multiplayer first-person survival game set in a mysterious factory. Players awaken with no memory, only to find themselves trapped in a facility where mannequins roam—not as lifeless props, but as deadly beings trying to become real humans. Some players are real humans who must cooperate and escape , while others are mannequins in disguise , hunting the rest while hiding their true identity. Who can you trust? Will you escape... or be replaced? Design The Others blends psychological tension, survival, and horror into an asymmetric multiplayer experience. Each round is a battle of trust and betrayal, as mannequins grow stronger and more dangerous over time. Players must explore the dark, confined factory to find weapons, unlock escape routes, and stay alert. A single mistake can turn a potential ally into a predator. Key Features : First-person multiplayer survival with psychological mind games Two distinct roles: Humans (escape) vs Mannequins (hunt) Eerie atmosphere set in a closed mannequin factory Procedurally randomized exits, item spawns, and events for each round Role-based voice chat system with restricted communication Mannequins evolve and grow stronger as the game progresses Dead players enter Observer Mode to watch the rest of the game unfold
row.short_description: A first-person multiplayer survival game where humans must escape and mannequins hunt—who's real, and who will replace you?
row.notes: Players can find and use guns and knives, and must escape from a dark and oppressive environment. It is possible to kill other characters using guns and knives.

row.name: The Maze: Treasure Hunters
row.detailed_description: Description The Maze: Treasure Hunters is a game for 2-4 players where you become a hunter fighting for treasure. Each round begins outside the walls of a mysterious labyrinth. Inside, obstacles await you in the form of pitch darkness, the unknown, and opponents who were once your friends. To win, you'll need to memorize your moves, mark your route in your guild book, and try to anticipate the actions of other treasure hunters. Find or steal the key and open the hidden chest... or become another lost soul in the labyrinth. Game Features Turn-based multiplayer for 2-4 players. Competitive elements. Randomly generated labyrinth. Limited visibility. Pixel graphics and a guild atmosphere.
row.short_description: Feel like a true adventurer and explore a dark labyrinth. In this turn-based tactical game, you'll search for keys, use weapons to slow down your opponents, and map the labyrinth based on your own and others' movements.

row.name: Godzilla x Kong: Titan Chasers
row.detailed_description: This world never belong to us. It always belonged to them. It is a time of monsters! Join the Titan Chasers - elite explorers, mercenaries and thrill-seekers - and step onto the shores of the Siren Isles, an untamed new ecosystem forged by the Rise of the Titans. Battle for survival and control on the edge of civilisation. Face epic monsters like the Mother Longlegs, Rock Critters and the deadly Skullcrawlers. Witness the fury of Godzilla and Kong, and join the fight against colossal predators. The Monsterverse comes to life in Godzilla x Kong: Titan Chasers; a 4X MMO strategy game where you will take your place among legends! Explore a stunning 3D map featuring multiple biomes. Defeat classic and brand new superspecies, rescue survivors, and seek out the resources you need to survive against the forces of nature - and rival Chaser factions. Recruit elite Chasers to lead your forces, each offering their own set of unique skills to turn the tide of battle. Use powerful Monarch tech to hunt, capture and study the Superspecies of the Sirens. Rank up and learn how to unleash their ferocity in battle! Embark on thrilling expeditions and test the mettle of your squads in strategic, turn-based RPG combat. Delve into the dark secrets of the Sirens in the main story campaign, or fight as your favourite Superspecies in the monster vs monster campaign! Forge powerful alliances, expand your territory, and secure critical landmarks with your friends. Bring your forces together to join the fight against monster swarms and gigantic beasts. Turn an abandoned, overgrown outpost into a formidable stronghold. Build up your forces and level up your tech to become a power player within this new frontier. Titan Chasers, get ready to stand face-to-toe with Godzilla, Kong, and your favourite creatures of the Monsterverse!
row.short_description: Hunt, capture, and command the monsters of the Monsterverse. Build your base, recruit elite Titan Chasers, and lead squads into tactical turn-based battles. Expand your territory in a shared online world, forge alliances, and face colossal threats like Godzilla, Kong, and Skullcrawlers.

row.name: Survival: Hold Your Self
row.detailed_description: Enter a challenging survival world full of dangers, discoveries, and decisions. In this single-player survival game, your survival is the focus. Gather resources, build your own base, and craft equipment to face the elements. Explore different biomes – from scorching deserts to icy snowscapes – each region presents new challenges. The right clothing is crucial: a straw hat will protect you from the sun, while a winter jacket is vital in the cold. Find abandoned locations, loot valuable items, and face dangerous creatures. Firearms like pistols are rare but can be purchased from merchants for resources or currency. In addition to surviving, you can also build your own small farm: Buy animals from a merchant and breed animals to provide for yourself in the long term. You're on your own – how long can you survive?

row.name: Relapse

Players take on the role of Kin, a former freerunner who is forced to confront the consequences that stemmed from his past addictions. Wall run, wall climb, and slide across various sections of platforming. With no pay-to-win mechanics, progress comes from your skill and smart deck-building. Win cards, unlock new tactics, and rise through the ranks based on merit alone. VISUALLY DISTINCT, STRATEGICALLY DEEP Every unit, spell, and battlefield is brought to life with unique animations and effects. Whether you’re spectating or clashing head-on, the world of Dfiance keeps you immersed with each move. WIN WITH BRAINS, NOT LUCK Victory in Dfiance isn’t random. Outsmart your opponents in a duel of wits across a dynamic battlefield. Control the tempo, predict your rival’s moves, and dominate with your strategy — not your wallet. MULTIPLE MODES. ONE GOAL: DOMINATE From ranked PvP battles and weekend tournaments to themed challenges and custom lobbies, there’s always a new way to test your deck and prove your dominance. With our new Spectate Mode , you can even watch the top players live and learn from their every move. FIGHT ACROSS THE FRONTLINES Engage your cards across unique lanes — manage the formation, time your combos, and deploy key units when the moment is right. row.name: The Honours Project
row.detailed_description: The Honours Project is an autobiographical walking simulator about a moment where I was struggling to come up with an idea for my University project in 2024. You are tasked with helping, by inspiring me with music. Enjoy a narrative experience by adventuring through dream-like levels, solving an occasional puzzle and listening to the dark and sometimes comical dialogue that acts as a commentary about being a student and game development. Move along at your own pace, enjoy the audio experience in a fully 3D soundscape. Find notes that explore extra lore, and get an extra sense of who I am.  The year was likely the toughest I have ever faced, and I wanted to depict these moments as an audiovisual experience with light puzzle mechanics and gameplay. The game takes around about 25 to 35 minutes to complete. The aim of this game was to help others who are in education to understand that it is okay not to know, and that the ideas will come. I too wanted to express myself in the only way I know how, and figured this would be the best platform to be able to do so. Voice work done by the talented Josef Boon While the game is completed, I am still relatively new in the world of game development and I expect bugs and issues, which I will hopefully have a chance to iron out. I am also not the best at optimizing due to Audio Design and narrative being my field of expertise. The game was created over the course of 5 months and was submitted as my fourth year University project that focused on how audio and narrative work together to better player experience. This game should work with mouse + keyboard, and an Xbox controller. Controls   WASD to move E to Interact ESC to bring up more options Developers Note This game will forever be free, and hopefully everyone can find their own level of enjoyment. I am forever learning and always open to feedback so please let me know what you think in the reviews!
row.short_description: The Honours Project is an autobiographical walking simulator. Enjoy a narrative experience, adventuring through dream-like levels, solving an occasional puzzle and listening to the dark and sometimes comical dialogue that acts as a commentary about being a student and game development.

row.name: Phobies Playtest
row.detailed_description: Phobies Playtest Welcome a special Playtest version of Phobies, this version of the game will be used to bring developers and players together to preview near future updates. Some key points: Accounts and games are hosted and played on different servers than the live game Test servers may periodically be cleaned of all accounts and games Participants may need to start over from time to time Phobies Playtest Steam App availability will be determined on whether there is an active Playtest occurring Test servers may be brought down as exciting new work starts Phobies Playtest availability will be communicated primarily over on Discord The following is still accurate from the live version of... ⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀ ⠀⠀ From the industry veterans who brought you Company of Heroes and Age of Empires: Castle Siege, comes Phobies, Smoking Gun Interactive's new terrifying collectible card game! Summon your worst fears and use their abilities to seize control of perilous environments. Wield a masterful strategy and outsmart all players who dare challenge you in an asynchronous battle and arena. Collect over 180 powerful and mischievous Phobies inspired by your most irrational fears. Evolve your strategies as you unlock new fears and abilities. Level up your Phobies to give them an added edge in battle. Watch your fears come to life in the whimsical world inspired by your subconscious. Traverse hazardous tiles and use the environment to stem the tide in your favor. Unlock weekly and seasonal rewards while ascending the Mount Ego leaderboards. Play solo challenge modes, battle your friends, or faceoff against millions of players worldwide! Join the community of fellow Phobie enthusiasts, eager to unlock their deepest fears. Are you brave enough to face your fears? FEATURES: COLLECT FEARSOME PHOBIES: Overpower your opponents by unlocking and upgrading your favorite Phobies. With an army of terrifying Phobies at your beck and call you are sure to win any battle. MASTER TACTICAL GAMEPLAY: Plan your strategy around hex-based environments. Utilize tactical positioning across spine-chilling terrains to gain an upper hand on your opponents. REFINE YOUR STRATEGY: Utilize the practice mode to test out and further refine your strategies before using them on your unsuspecting victims. TEST YOUR WITS IN CHALLENGE MODE: In need of a quick brainteaser? Try out the PvE challenge mode containing various puzzles and objectives to sharpen your wits. PLAY WITH YOUR FRENEMIES: Add and duel your friends in asynchronous PvP battles. That is one way to put them in their place! EXPERIENCE ASYNCHRONOUS BATTLE: Take your horror show to the masses by engaging in PvP battles with players worldwide. The turn-based mechanics of asynchronous battles allow players to play multiple matches simultaneously. Enjoy the never-ending terror and fun. COMPETE IN ARENA MODE: Feeling a bit antsy with competitive tendencies? Then experience the real-time mayhem of the arena mode. Assert dominance through strategic superiority in real-time battle. Why wait when you can win? PLAY WHEREVER YOU WANT: Take your worst fears with you wherever you go through cross-platform capabilities. Whether you prefer to dominate via PC or on the go through your mobile: play the game your way. JOIN OUR DISCORD SERVER: ⠀⠀⠀        ⠀ Meet other Phobies Wranglers in our Discord Server ! You'll get to share your tips and tricks, learn new strategies from other players, ask our devs questions, share your feedback and suggestions with us, or get support from our amazing moderators and staff. Follow the Discord link in our Steam Page sidebar to join the community!
row.short_description: Join the Phobies playtest to experience content and balance updates early, accounts and games are hosted on servers separate from the live game. Phobies is a tactical card collecting strategy game where players battle one another in the surreal realm of the subconscious, where fears manifest.

row.name: Markus's Miasma
row.detailed_description: Welcome to UCSC—well, kind of. This isn’t the sunny college campus you remember. In this 2D puzzle horror game, you're dropped into a fog-drenched, twisted version of UC Santa Cruz where nothing feels quite right. Familiar landmarks are warped, the silence is heavy, and the mist hides more than just bad weather. You’ll explore eerie paths and unsettling buildings as you piece together the story behind Markus —a guy with a past so dark, it’s bleeding into reality. Solve creepy puzzles, uncover buried memories, and try not to get too lost in the fog (literally and emotionally).  Key Features: 🧩 Puzzle-Based Exploration : Navigate through haunted versions of labs, libraries, and forest trails. Solve logic puzzles to unlock new areas and piece together fragments of Markus’s mind. 🕯️ Atmospheric Horror : Inspired by Silent Hill and Mad Father , this game focuses on slow-building dread, psychological unease, and eerie sound design—not some cheap jump scares. 🗺️ A Twisted UCSC Campus : Iconic locations like the Quarry Plaza and Porter Meadow are reimagined in a surreal nightmare. Expect familiar spaces, distorted by guilt and memory. 📖 Narrative-Driven Gameplay : Dive into a branching, emotionally charged story with themes of trauma, regret, and identity. Your choices affect how much of Markus’s truth you uncover. 🧠 Estimated Playtime: 1–2 hours Inspired by spooky favorites like Mad Father and the chilling vibes of Silent Hill , this game mixes emotional storytelling with mind-bending mystery. It’s not about cheap scares—it’s about slowly realizing that something’s really wrong here... On a side note...all characters, locations, and events in this game are entirely fictional. While the setting draws inspiration from the real UC Santa Cruz campus, this is not a reflection of the actual university. Any resemblance to real people—living or dead—is purely coincidental. But the Markus irl is pretty rad 😎  So grab your flashlight, steady your nerves, and get ready to uncover the secrets hidden in the fog... Welcome (back?) to UCSC. You might not leave the same.
row.short_description: Explore a fog-choked, twisted version of UCSC in this 2D puzzle horror game, where cryptic clues and buried memories reveal the disturbing truth behind one man's obsession...
row.notes: Markus's Miasma contains themes of suicide and accidental death. These topics are depicted through narrative events and character experiences. Player discretion is advised, especially for those sensitive to themes of self-harm or loss.

row.name: Colony 19
row.detailed_description: Having finally escaped your white room, you find yourself in an overwhelming and unfamiliar world hidden from you all your life. Piece together the true reality kept from you and people like you whilst locked away. This game is a VR climber game where you must physically climb out of the concrete and metal hell that towered over your head all your life. Explore a monolithic environment and ascend through an unforgiving megastructure that is COLONY 19.
row.short_description: Colony 19 is a VR horror climbing game. Immerse yourself in a harrowing struggle for freedom as you crawl your way out of a dystopian megastructure.
row.notes: Shows depictions of blood, gore, and body horror.

row.name: Hizca
row.detailed_description: Play as Xie, an ancestral water guardian. Awaken in a sanctuary hidden among the mountains of Colombia, armed with a sacred staff that channels the powers of the earth. Your mission is to protect the heart of the páramo from creatures corrupted by centuries of mining, fire and deforestation. A spiritual wave-based shooter Combat in first person against symbolic enemies that represent real ecological threats: mining sulfides, igneous creatures and deforesting monsters. Three progressive waves with increasing difficulty in this Early Access version, offering intense combat and a deep ecological message. Use your powers to purify enemies and transform them into frailejones, sacred plants that restore life to the wasteland. Inspired by the Muisca culture Each mechanic is based on symbols and ancestral knowledge of the Muisca people. Invoke the power of the earth, restore sacred altars and participate in a narrative that intertwines mythology, spirituality and ecological science fiction. Key Features First-person action game with an ecological and symbolic approach. Unique setting inspired by the Colombian páramos. Wave-based combat with themed enemies and magical mechanics. Immersive narrative based on the Muisca cosmovision. Early Access version with three playable waves, designed as a short, but intense and meaningful experience. Translated with (free version)
row.short_description: Experience a first-person adventure as Xie, a spiritual guardian of the Colombian páramo who confronts forces corrupted by fire and mining. Use ancestral powers in magical combat and explore a world inspired by Muisca culture and environmental care.

row.name: Brainrot's HAMSTER GAME
row.detailed_description: Introducing a new type of endless runner...          ...the ( very real ) endless struggle hamsters experience on a day-to-day basis. Jump from platform to platform, nimbly avoiding lava as you try to survive as long as possible to reach a new high score! A surprising amount of depth is found in its simple mechanics, making it a game all about mastery. Learn the tech, become the hamster, and reach the top of the leaderboards! It's a singleplayer game, but it's a very social game too. Compete against your friends and family , flaunt your scores, and share tips as you go. Features Take your shot at the DAILY HAMSTERDLE —a new gauntlet generated every day. Here, you compete against players across the globe for the top spot of the day, however you only get  3 attempts  so make sure they count! Complete ACHIEVEMENTS to unlock   silly  SKINS  and colorful  PALETTES  to mix up the gameplay and impress your friends who don't even know how to unlock them. (More skins coming soon...) Personal Note from the Creator Apologies if this is cheesy or pretentious but hey this is my game I do what I want... This game has taught me what it means to create. The value of art, I feel, comes when you can feel the presence of a soul within. When you create art, you impart your identity into it simply by virtue of you creating it, meaning in effect, it becomes an extension of yourself. Therefore, to reach down and express yourself to the fullest extent into your creation you must also understand yourself to know what there is to express. For me this has meant working on my habits, my connections, my worldview, and everything I can possibly do to be happy, because only by thoroughly enjoying the creation process will that joy be reflected on the other side. This has been my first big project I've ever released and I think it does feel authentically myself, but I definitely ain't stopping here. No art is perfect because no one can be perfect — all we can we do is strive to create bigger and better things by continuously trying to be bigger and better ourselves. I urge you to create something, to experience the pain, the embarrassment, and the deep sense of fulfillment that comes from dedicating your entire self to something and ascribing your identity to it for all the world to see. I've definitely felt like I've come out the other side a better person. I've worked with such beautiful people to be here, especially my good friend Kenneth who did all the art, music, and more, and I feel by going through this difficult self-reflective journey together, we've really gotten to know a deeper side of one another. Without him and everyone whose supported me, I could not accomplish anything close to this, so thanks guys :D and with all that said... I genuinely hope playing this game brings some value to your life.        -Ethan
row.short_description: a silly free endless runner depicting the 1:1 experience of a hamster
row.reviews: “with simple and intuitive gameplay, a new wordle to keep on top of, and actually seriously no ads or microtransactions, this game really makes you FEEL like a hamster.” 5/5 – mugmun

row.name: 龍躍九天 - 情繫江湖
row.detailed_description: 龍躍九天是一款非牟利同人遊戲。 這一款高自由度的RPG遊戲, 玩家能在遊戲中體驗善惡兩大主線,解鎖獨門技能, 招攬個性隊員, 購買大宅, 攻打領地等等。 由前作主角的大弟子（玩家）闖盪江湖歷險旅程， 過程中會遇到的人物和劇情，穿插其中同時， 能習得強大技能與裝備，開創自己宗派和養成人生哲學。 故事前奏： （一版）光明之境幫主雲曦為了復活已故紅顏和好友，被陰謀者算計從而令天下遭受戰火洗禮， 其徒（玩家 ，也是主角）也選擇步入江湖，與眾多角色互動， 揭露陰謀， 為天下蒼生而戰。 個中善惡的選擇會掌握在玩家手中，究竟主角最後的結果會是怎樣呢？

row.name: Prism

From the open-space 3D world to a classic-style 2D world, you'll face different levels throughout the game. Play in 3D Go through different levels with unique challenges and multiple ways of overcoming. Experience the two worlds meet Play in 2D as you encounter special levels that progress after beating the unique minigame. Or just play classic, fully in 2D Tone down the game and play in one dimension less. Or play infinitely to your hearts desire Pick your adventure, play longer and see how far you can go! Complete levels and experience a different gameplay based on the mode you pick. Don't die though or else you'll be back at the start!  Play a new set of levels that change with each playthrough. Get to the end to claim victory! Who knows what you'll find there...

row.detailed_description: 联系我们 客服QQ：1030704203 客服微信：kfgm8888 联系客服送见面礼一份，期待您的来信。 About the Game 【世界观：志怪宇宙的黑暗史诗】 在蒲松龄笔下的聊斋世界被黑暗裂缝撕裂的百年后，九大鬼王挣脱《幽冥录》的封印。玩家将扮演游走阴阳两界的「引魂使」，收集散落的「残卷」以重构上古封印。游戏采用动态叙事系统，每个NPC的生死抉择都会影响势力平衡——超度聂小倩的怨灵可解锁「兰若寺」副本，而放任其堕落则可能触发「百鬼夜行」事件。美术团队耗时三年研发「水墨粒子渲染」技术，使画皮妖的每次变形都伴随宣纸皴裂效果，而鬼火照明系统则通过物理模拟实现「灯火摇曳，魑魅现形」的恐怖氛围。 【创新战斗：五行相生相克】 独创「符咒熔铸」系统允许玩家将200+种道家法术组合成连招。例如「雷符+桃木剑」可触发「天雷引」，而「水符+摄魂铃」则生成「忘川漩涡」。Boss战引入「业力值」机制：过度使用阴招会积累心魔值，当数值满格时鬼王将获得「附身」能力，操控玩家角色进行反杀——此时需快速完成QTE念诵《清净经》来净化。战斗场景支持环境互动，在「酆都城」地图可引爆油灯制造火墙，而「黄泉渡口」的河水会随月相涨落改变战场格局。 【角色养成：三魂七魄系统】 角色成长突破传统等级制，改为「三魂（天魂/地魂/命魂）+七魄（喜/怒/哀/惧/爱/恶/欲）」的魂魄拼合体系。每收集一件遗物（如宁采臣的毛笔、黑山老妖的骨笛），即可解锁对应魂魄技能。当「怒魄」达到三级时，可激活「血怒」状态大幅提升暴击率，但会持续消耗「天魂」导致幻听副作用。装备系统引入「阴德」概念——超度亡魂积累的阴德可锻造「往生甲」，而滥杀无辜则会生成「业火缠身」的诅咒装备。 【探索玩法：罗盘驱动的动态地图】 采用「子午罗盘」导航系统，指针会因鬼气浓度产生磁偏现象。在「子时」进入「乱葬岗」可能遭遇「鬼打墙」，而「午时」探索则触发「阳气灼烧」的持续伤害。随机事件包含「鬼市竞拍」（用阳寿典当法宝）、「阴差赌局」（猜鬼魂生前死因）等36种分支。隐藏区域「枉死城」需集齐「孟婆汤」「判官笔」「阎罗令」三件信物，其中「孟婆汤」需在「奈何桥」剧情中选择不饮用才能保留。 【多人模式：灵界协作与背叛】 支持4人联机「镇魂塔」爬塔玩法，队伍需平衡「怨气」与「正气」值。当怨气过高时可能触发「鬼王降临」团灭事件，而正气过量则导致「天劫」秒杀。独创「借尸还魂」机制：玩家死亡后可以选择附身队友（消耗其「地魂」）或操控Boss残魂进行复仇。赛季制「百鬼宴」玩法中，八支队伍争夺「鬼王令」，最终胜者将获得「酆都之主」称号及限定皮肤「阎罗冕旒」。 【技术亮点：次世代志怪体验】 故事引擎 ：支线剧情，每个NPC都有独立记忆库 动态音效系统 ：采用杜比全景声技术，鬼魅低语会随玩家「天魂」值变化出现方位偏移 MOD工坊支持 ：提供「志怪编辑器」工具，玩家可自定义鬼怪行为逻辑（如设定画皮妖的变身条件） 开发者的话 尊敬的玩家们，
