row.short_description: 在这款黑暗风策略游戏中，你将化身《聊斋》中的精怪，在诡谲的阴阳交界处争夺鬼王宝座。融合卡牌构筑、势力经营与回合制战斗，通过收服孤魂野鬼、结盟千年妖仙，逐步扩张你的冥界版图。游戏复刻原著奇谭设定，独创“因果”系统——每个抉择都将触发蝴蝶效应，或成救世明主，或为灭世魔君。水墨画风与动态幽冥场景交织，配以诡谲的民乐配乐，带你沉浸式体验一场权谋与妖术交织的东方奇幻盛宴。

row.name: NoFlash
row.detailed_description: This is a flash-dodging training game specifically designed for VALORANT , featuring nearly all in-game flash effects. It innovatively combines a dot-clicking mechanic, challenging players to precisely hit targets while swiftly avoiding sudden flashes. This dual-tasking gameplay enhances reaction speed and multitasking skills, making it an effective training tool for players.
row.short_description: VALORANT flash-dodging trainer with dot-clicking mini-game. Two modes: ① Practice (customize flashes/targets) ② Time Attack (score under limit). Master flashes while boosting aim!

row.name: Sereno
row.detailed_description: Sereno is a classic puzzle with the simple goal of creating a tile with a purple drink out of tiles with glasses, bottles and ices of various colors. Move all your tiles around the board with the arrow keys. When two tiles of the same color and with the same picture touch, they merge into a new one with the same picture but of the next color of the rainbow. If tiles with a bottle and ices of the same color touch they merge into a tile with a drink of the same color. Features: Soft relaxing music that enables player to unwind, rest, and recharge. Classic tile mechanics: press an arrow to move all the tiles in the direction of the arrow. Simple intuitive rules: it takes less than a minute to master the rules, but the strategic challenges are limitless. Smooth design: clean and satisfying visuals for an enjoyable puzzle experience. Sereno is perfect for quick relaxing sessions.
row.short_description: Sereno is a free relaxing puzzle played on a 4x4 board. A player uses arrow keys to move all the tiles in one of 4 directions. Sometimes a pair of tiles will combine into a new one. Listen to immersive smooth jazz music, lean back, unwind, and give yourself a break you deserve.

row.name: Gravity Sandbox
row.detailed_description: Gravity simulation environment. Accurate enough for demonstration and educational purposes. Has options to show gravitational systems in 2 presentation modes: - simple Euclidean 3D space - 2+1D space where X and Y dimensions are Euclidean while Z represents gravitational potential DISCLAMER!!! This product is in no way shape or form intended to be used for scientifically accurate predictions of real-life space events! For this purpose, go to credible space research institutions. They have way better mathematicians and physicists then author of this product and way better computers then you respected user.
row.short_description: Gravity simulation environment. Accurate enough for demonstration and educational purposes.

row.name: DuoQ
row.detailed_description: A 2-Player Game, Played Entirely in Singleplayer DuoQ is an e-dating sim about romancing another person in an online game . Play alongside Tala, a mysterious stranger met in the fictional FPS game To the Heart . With Tala at your side, you'll solve co-op challenges, learn about her IRL life, and answer the question: is she into you? Features Talk with Tala using your real voice, with open ended conversations, a rich narrative to uncover, and plenty of flirting to do! Overcome multiplayer-like challenges and puzzles, fully playable in single player Discover collectibles, secrets, and multiple distinct endings ...So is this a Multiplayer Game? Nope! DuoQ uses voice recognition to track your conversation with Tala, allowing for real time conversations and history. Tala isn't a real person, but using these new technologies, we can tell a new kind of story through the structure of a multiplayer game. Plus, nothing in DuoQ is AI Generated. We use machine learning to advance the conversation, but we don't use AI to generate voice lines, art, or the story itself. This is a handcrafted game and a labor of love from our team - enjoy!
row.short_description: Squad up with Tala, a mysterious (and flirty!) player you meet in the lobby of a fictional FPS game. Use your real-life voice to talk with Tala over comms, solve puzzles, and outwit enemies. By the end, you’ll answer the most important question: Is she into you?

row.name: Blocky's Short Quest
row.detailed_description: Play as Blocky with super high jumping height in this 2D adventure platformer. Discover new worlds where Blocky's abilities change. Gain the ability to always jump, float in the air, always move right, and other abilities. Game features: A world map with levels to complete to continue your adventure. Many worlds with new gimmicks. Over 130 levels. Float in the air. Always jump. Explore the world map.
row.short_description: Play as Blocky with super high jumping height in this 2D adventure platformer. Discover new worlds where Blocky's abilities change.

row.name: 50 Cents Please
row.detailed_description: Navigate around the map solving puzzles to collect coins. Gather enough coins to take the subway home. Simple game without many mechanics, my second game on this platform.
row.short_description: You are stranded in a subway where everybody has seemingly disappeared. With only a penny to your name, solves puzzles around the map and find your way out. Explores shops, and various rooms--and avoid the train tracks.

row.name: Dual Shadows
row.detailed_description: Ancient magic. Futuristic tech. A synthetic weapon caught in between. Dual Shadows is a combat-focused action game set in Pulsanh, a neon-drenched city powered by the imprisoned energy of two divine beings: the Phoenix and the Dragon. You play as Linh, a synthetic lifeform forged by the tech conglomerate Harmoni —spliced from fragments of the beasts she’s sent to destroy. DUAL COMBAT SYSTEM Swap freely between: Melee Form aggressive, close-range combat Ranged Form precision-based spellcasting Each form builds energy to use Linh’s abilities, rewarding fluid switching and adaptive play. How you engage with each enemy is up to you! YOU DECIDE Absorb or Release: After defeating a boss, make a critical choice: Absorb: Take enemy spirit for yourself and unlock order-aligned abilities. Release: Free enemy spirit and unlock chaos-aligned abilities. Each choice alters dialogue, unlocks new abilities, and reshapes your story. MULTI-PHASE BOSS ENCOUNTERS Each borough culminates in a unique boss battle: The Phoenix wields embers, fire fields, and a resurrection mechanic. The Dragon strikes with torrents of water, closes distance with sudden dashes, and conjures towering hands of crashing waves. Bosses evolve mid-fight with layered mechanics that test your mastery of both forms. Fail to react in time, and you’ll meet your end. STRATEGIC BUILDCRAFTING Choose from four core abilities that shape your combat style. Each core modifies how your Q and E abilities behave—creating synergy between your chosen form and your Order/Chaos alignment. Alt – A fixed mobility skill for repositioning and evasion. Q / E – Offensive and utility abilities unlocked through narrative progression and Absorb/Release choices. Your build evolves as you progress—encouraging experimentation, alignment mastery, and flexible playstyles. A DENSE, CHOICE DRIVEN WORLD Two boroughs: Phoenix District and Dragon District, each with unique terrain, hazards, and enemy types Replayable encounters with branching outcomes based on Absorb/Release ratios and borough order Flat, linear level design focused on forward momentum and environmental storytelling Dual Shadows blends a gritty cyberpunk setting with mythic undertones drawn from Southeast Asian legend. From barricaded streets and brutalist towers to flickering signage and sacred arenas, the city of Pulsanh reflects a world where divine power has been caged, commodified—and now confronts what it helped create.
row.short_description: The city of Pulsanh is left in the dark after its power source escapes. Navigate the city, confront the Absent, and stop the beasts from causing more chaos.
row.notes: This game contains content that may not be suitable for all audiences, including stylized violence, combat involving enemy elimination, strong language in dialogue and subtitles, and characters depicted in suggestive clothing. Player discretion is advised.

row.name: Pet Hero vs Zombie
row.detailed_description: The zombie apocalypse is here! 🧟‍♂️🐾 Choose your animal warrior – a brave cat with a pistol, a mighty crocodile with a bazooka, or a daring chicken with a revolver! More heroes await to be unlocked. Face endless hordes of zombies, fight for survival, and collect golden coins to upgrade your weapons and unlock new characters and maps. Every battle is a test of skill and endurance – how long can you survive? 🔥 Game Features: ✅ Unique animal heroes, each with their own powerful weapon ✅ Fast-paced action-packed gameplay ✅ Multiple maps to explore and conquer ✅ Endless waves of zombies – the challenge never ends! 🎮 Controls & Goal: Move your hero with simple and intuitive controls, aim, and shoot your way through endless zombie waves. Your mission? Survive as long as possible, eliminate zombies, and collect coins for upgrades. 🐾 Join the battle now! The world needs a hero – and that hero is YOU!
row.short_description: The zombie apocalypse has begun! Choose your animal hero – a cat with a pistol, a crocodile with a bazooka, or a chicken with a revolver! Survive endless zombie waves, collect coins, upgrade weapons, and unlock new heroes. How long can you last?

row.name: Dichotomy Illusion: The Coser Disassembly Incident
row.detailed_description: The bisected corpse split precisely along its central axis and gruesomely suspended from a dilapidated ceiling fan - belonged to a former underground idol and cosplayer who had gained local fame in the commercial district. The bisection occurred during production of a live-action promotional video for an unreleased sequel to a Chinese indie horror game... Shortly after the bisection incident... severed limbs of a woman began surfacing in niche culture stores across the Commercial District, each bearing bizarre yet distinctly coded terminology comprehensible only to hardcore ACGN enthusiasts... The cases may seem like closed chapters, all present efforts appearing as futile gestures. Yet when you launch the game and immerse yourself with genuine curiosity, you might seize the  hidden truths  of these twin tragedies, bearing witness to their ultimate reckoning through digital resurrection. Character Introduction： Armchair Detective / Curator Investigation Aide / Citrus Sugar (IRL Handle: Cheng Zicheng) Quizmaster, Primary POV / Solaris Custard Chronicle-Bound Cast: The bisected cosplayer, a socially challenged indie dev, a reassuring game editor veteran, an opportunistic photographer boyfriend trailing his cosplayer girlfriend for impromptu shoots, and proto-otaku twins whose crude promotional video operations resembled cavemen discovering fire... Their stories laced with cryptic agendas (a subjective yet imprecise descriptor) during the incident will gradually crystallize through digital ephemera. Yet this is merely the prologue, nothing but an overture. Supporting Cast of Chaos: Elementary schoolers obsessively pinning otome game husbandos on their itabags? The gyaru merch boutique clerk at 'Spring Valley' compulsively collecting PokeCough Mon catalogs? A plus-sized staffer in band tees sneaking fancams of indie idols from livehouse control booths? A four-member girl band resembling chromatic warriors from some yuri rock manga (with their cerulean bassist currently AWOL in legendary fashion)... These gloriously unhinged denizens of the ACGN underworld shall aid the investigation through chaotic means, for critical clues might lurk within their meme-laden otaku-speed diatribes – postmodern hieroglyphs demanding cultural literacy to decode. Scene Recon Log In their investigation of the limb abandonment case, Solaris Custard and Citrus Sugar shall conduct 'fieldwork' (or more accurately, fish-flopping) at these locations. Beyond the macabre biological evidence, the crime scenes themselves might spark morbid fascination among otaku-crossover socialites – each site functioning as geek pilgrimage grounds where murder-mystery tourism collides with ACGN subcultural ecospheres. Merch Mausoleum : A resurrected deadmall where ACGN shops wage merchandise warfare amidst peeling posters of last season's waifus PS5 Purgatory : A luxury plaza's white elephant - that overpriced PlayStation experience zone bleeding yen through its marble floors Idol Crucible : A sweatbox dungeon vibrating with hardcore wota chants, where dreams of 'next Cinderella' dissolve into body odor fog Venue Vanitas : Livehouse boasting instagrammable neon façade but delivering sonic disappointment worthy of bargain-bin earphones Collecting merch, grinding co-op achievements, snapping cheki with minor idols, enduring ear-bleeding band covers... Surely these ACGN detours during criminal investigations deserve absolution . (Unless you claim to despise hanging with bro-coded gloom maidens - though that tsundere protest sounds sus coming from an itabag-toting legend like yourself.) Core Case Matrix (Visual evidence redacted per narrative constraints) Chinese indie horror titles, rhythm games featuring idol project crossovers, that notorious domestic indie publisher, grotesque merch from a 90s mecha IP rife with faction wars and Oedipal mech-pilots, an onion-wielding digital diva, psychotic battle royale mascots reduced to environmental decor, and of course the retro cringe of girl band tropes - all deliberately stitched into the game's fabric like inside jokes carved in radioactive neon. Should these culturally-coded Easter eggs trigger your neural pathways into involuntary mirth, congratulations on your otaku baptism. Discern the real-world IP correlations, and you might just outpace our protagonists in unraveling this bloodstained tapestry of references.
row.short_description: 'Dichotomy Illusion' is a Shin Honkaku mystery visual novel that combines real-world entertainment elements with physical locations, utilizing ACGN (Anime, Comics, Games, Novels) subculture knowledge to solve criminal cases and uncover the truth.
row.notes: This game is a mystery visual novel where all characters are adults, portrayed in a distinctive artistic style. The story contains no sexual violence or sexual acts (not even kissing), with absolutely no pornographic depictions or dialogue. While there are romantic elements between male and female characters, these are presented without explicit language, and the CG artwork contains no sexual content (trust me, nobody would view my art style through a sexual lens). Regarding violence, deceased characters and descriptions of corpses exist solely to provide investigative clues, not for gratuitous gore. All graphical depictions are artistically stylized—no sensitive body parts are exposed, no explicit displays occur, and dismembered limbs are represented through black silhouettes with text collage effects.

row.name: Ratatata
row.detailed_description: Ratatata is an isometric Tower Defense game where you lead a space rat kingdom fending off a ruthless cat invasion! Fight across diverse environments and adapt your strategies to survive the relentless waves of these fierce felines!  There are 24 racruits divided into 6 families. Each unit bears a name that begins with the syllable 'Ra-' . Their weapons and powers are directly derived from this. For example, the Rapier fights with rapiers, the Ragout cooks delicious meals to strengthen allies, and the Radioactive spreads a deadly gas. Your enemies, the Cats , also draw their powers from their names, which begin with the syllable 'Cha-' , such as the Carpenter , the Shaman , or even the fearsome Chardasso !
row.short_description: Ratatata is an isometric Tower Defense game where you lead a space rat kingdom fending off a ruthless cat invasion! Fight across diverse environments and adapt your strategies to survive the relentless waves of these fierce felines!

row.name: Tears of Vanfell: New Beginning
row.detailed_description: Tears of Vanfell: New Beginning is an action-packed dungeon crawler with roguelike and hack-'n-slash elements. Choose between a wide cast of characters and climb the Mountain as you swap weapons and grow stronger as a team of up to four player in online Co-op. Explore and climb the procedurally-generated Mountain to find and defeat Bosses, and continue on your journey. During your adventure, you'll pick up powerful new abilities, weapons and equipment, all of which you'll need to use if you plan on surviving. Explore the Mountain with a team of up to four players! Or, if you would rather take on the Mountain by yourself, don't worry -- you may also bring another member of your camp to help you out. Prepare yourself for your next expedition at your campsite. At first, it will be just you and your thoughts... but as you explore, you'll find others willing to help you out -- from other explorers with unique skills, to specialists who can help behind the scenes. During your adventures, you'll meet many characters and grow to understand them and their motivations. But you may also find yourself caught up in the aftermath of a century-old war...
row.short_description: Your life begins anew in front of an imposing mountain... Climb and explore it with a wide cast of characters in this dungeon crawler RPG with up to four player Co-op.

row.name: Living Nightmares - False Familiar
row.detailed_description: An episodic psychological horror experience based on fragmented memories and twisted perception. You’re looking at the first chapter of the Living Nightmares series — standalone stories that follow people grappling with distorted realities, fractured identities, and unsettling truths they were never meant to uncover. False Familiar After a strange event leaves you disoriented, you begin to question the memories you thought were real. A familiar face keeps reappearing — but something about them is deeply wrong. You're not sure if you’re being haunted… or if your mind is turning against you. A first-person psychological horror game focused on atmosphere and story-driven progression. Explore your environment, uncover clues, and piece together the reality — if it exists. Key Features A disturbing narrative driven by exploration and subtle choices. Use a phone to receive texts and check messages, uncovering clues through unsettling conversations. Authentic analog horror presentation. Visions, messages, and hallucinations that blur the line between truth and delusion. Minimal HUD, fully immersive experience. Built for short, intense play sessions.
row.short_description: Carl Williams, a 15-year-old boy, finds himself alone at home one unsettling night. What begins as a quiet evening soon spirals into something far stranger. Shadows shift, silence speaks, and someone—or something—seems to know him better than he knows himself.

row.name: Operation: Surface Takeover
row.detailed_description: Take back the Earth in a high-stakes action RTS where humanity fights for survival. Battle swarms of giant, radiation-mutated bugs as you reclaim the surface with advanced technology, tactical turret placement, and strategic defenses. Every decision counts as you push back the infestation and fight to restore what was lost. In this game, you have access to turrets that can be placed on any ground tile—design your base however you want. Your mission: defend headquarters at all costs. Enemies will come in waves from spawners, each with different methods of attack, so stay vigilant. Be careful—they can even destroy the structures you’ve placed. With a 10-level campaign and an endless mode to truly test your skills… the question is, can you handle it?
row.short_description: A pixelated 2.5D RTS meets tower defense as you battle mutated ants in a short campaign. Build walls, place turrets, and hold the line to reclaim Earth's surface in this tactical fight for survival where placement of everything matters.

row.name: Rhythm Survivor Maiden & the Beat-Dropping Cursed Forest Playtest
Nightmare Visions Chapter 1
row.detailed_description: Nightmare Visions: Chapter 1 is not a traditional horror game. There are no save files. No skip buttons. This is a narrative horror experience , not a survival challenge. You’re not here to escape. You’re here to witness. Developed entirely by one person , not a team, in 1 Month as a Challenge. If you're expecting a AAA horror game, you’re in the wrong place. If you're ready for something different , press play. Chapter One introduces the beginning of the Nightmare Visions anthology . Each chapter explores a new character, a new setting, and a new psychological thread woven into the same unnerving universe. Story This is not a game of combat or escape. It is a slow-burning descent into an atmosphere of unease, where story and tension unfold through exploration and observation. Every object, every symbol, and every shadowed corner tells a part of a larger, unsettling truth. Game Features: -First Person Walking Simulator -VHS Effects -Puzzles and Cryptic Messages Total Playtime: 20-30 Minutes Future: Chapter One is available now for free. Chapter Two is currently in development.
row.short_description: You investigate a secluded rural home of an old friend that's gone missing, abandoned under mysterious circumstances. You begin to uncover a haunting trail left behind by a man consumed by paranoia, isolation, and something far more disturbing.

row.name: 衔言碎语
row.detailed_description: 《衔言碎语》是一款免费的2D成语卡牌游戏。 【玩法介绍】 你需要观察卡牌上的成语文字内容，选中拥有 相同文字 的卡牌，尽可能凑出复杂的牌型，同时运用道具卡，获得更高分数。 【游戏特色】 属性和标签 每张成语卡牌都拥有“朝代”这个属性，朝代根据其出处的典籍划分。不同朝代对应了不同基础分，年代越久远的朝代对应的基础分越高。 部分成语卡牌拥有“标签”这个属性，标签根据其文字内容划分，例如：“虎视眈眈”中因为包含“虎”字，所以这个成语有“动物”这个标签。 珍宝阁 每次闯关结束后，可以在“珍宝阁”购买道具卡，合理使用道具卡能够获得更高的分数。 道具卡中有非常多针对不同朝代和标签进行加成的增益卡，也有针对每个回合、每张卡牌的增益卡，种类繁多，任君挑选。 背包 增益卡的卡槽只有7个，当我们背包里的道具超过7个时，就需要根据出牌时的卡牌内容，调整、使用增益卡。
row.short_description: 恭喜你发现了这款独一无二的成语卡牌游戏！你需要观察卡牌上的成语文字，选中卡牌组成各种牌型，搭配使用各种道具卡，获得更高的分数。百种游戏道具，数千张不同的成语卡牌，合理运用卡牌和道具，攻破一个又一个关卡吧！

row.name: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Regnus! Begin your MMORPG adventure in an anime-styled fantasy world! Explore the Open World Magna is a vast land full of wonder: mine rare crystals, gather mystical herbs and mushrooms, or stumble into sudden monster stampedes! Between battles, lose yourself in breathtaking vistas. Be Whoever You Wanna Be Tank with unbreakable shields, heal with radiant spells, or unleash skillful moves to deal great damage—then swap styles anytime! And combat roles are just the start! In Star Resonance, you can also express yourself with deep customization and various outfits that make you a star in town! Rally, Raid, and Reap Your Rewards Assemble multiplayer parties to topple bosses with attack patterns that are easy to learn but still demand teamwork. Keep looting and make yourself—and your guild—legendary. We Are in This Together Fish at riversides, dance at the town's fair, set off fireworks at night, or even meme in guild chat—remember to have fun with friends, because Regnus shines brightest when shared.
row.short_description: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance expands the Blue Protocol universe with a vibrant MMORPG experience. Create your own hero, team up for strategic raids, or simply relax and have fun with friends fishing, crafting, and endless exploration. Adventure awaits!

row.name: GeTrix
row.detailed_description: GeTrix is a modern reinvention of the classic block-falling game, powered by intuitive gesture controls, where a camera tracks your hands. Whether you're stacking solo or waving your way through the challenge mode, GeTrix delivers a fresh and futuristic twist to a timeless favorite. ✋ How It Works – Gesture Controls Play using just your hand and a webcam: ☝️ Index finger – Move block left 🤙 Pinky finger – Move block right 🤚Palm  – Rotate block 🖕 Middle finger – Drop block faster Prefer traditional controls? Use your keyboard to play classic-style too! To use it, just use the arrow keys in order to play.
row.short_description: Stack, swipe, and wave your way through a fast-paced puzzle challenge powered by intuitive hand-tracking controls.

row.name: Architect Life: A House Design Simulator Playtest
Mandatory Fun
row.detailed_description: You play as a young man conscripted into the Finnish military. In Finland, service is mandatory — and you don’t know how it’s going to play out. You’ll have to get used to a new setting and new rules. Your actions shape how things turn out — for you, and for those around you. This is a story-rich experience with elements of drama , comedy , and romance … if you can call it that. This is Part One of a multi-part story. It is a standalone release, and future parts will be released separately. Stay tuned for updates. Estimated playtime: around 1 hour Available for Windows
row.short_description: You play as a young man conscripted into the Finnish military. Your actions shape how things turn out — for you, and for those around you. This is a story-rich experience with elements of drama, comedy, and romance… if you can call it that.
row.notes: The game contains nudity, alcohol use, mild text-based violence, and suggestive dialogue implying sexual activity.

row.name: Strange Shores: A Desktop Fishing Game Playtest
Split Times
row.detailed_description: Synopsis You have been personally selected by the mayor to save the city of Split from unreasonable housing prices! Over the course of the following year, and on a tight budget, you'll have to use all the tools at your disposition to buy as many houses in the name of the city as you can so that they may be rented for cheap. That being said, there are a lot of people who would rather you fail in your mission... And besides, grandma ain't gonna visit herself, right? Gameplay The game is mostly played with the mouse, but it also uses the keyboard a little. Most of the game is reading the local newspaper and using your knowledge to find the best deals on a map. Once there, you will have to gauge if the price is too high, low, or if you want to try and haggle with the owner of the property. Manage your turns well and you will be victorious! There are also RIVETING bossfights to break the pace by testing your skills on the keyboard through challenges, or testing your wits with mind boggling questions and choices. What to expect A short, simple game made as a hobby. Nothing very ambitious, but made with a lot of heart. The game isn't too long, one play-through takes somewhere between 15 and 30 min. That being said, it is unlikely you will beat the game on your first try. The game is filled with jokes and memes. Even though the game is singleplayer, it is also a very enjoyable experience with friends. Sharing the joke is always a good time. A fun, satirical take on life in the Balkans. Try to spot the references and just have a good time overall.
row.short_description: Use your wits and savvy to save the city of Split from unreasonable housing prices! Find the best deals, evade angry sports fans, survive your part-time job and vanquish your inner demons in this short but intense experience.

row.name: Bonki Bonk
row.detailed_description: Bonki is trapped in your screen with the legendary meme character, BONK! There’s no way out for them, the only thing they can do is bonk each other. Once you start clicking and press a key on your keyboard, Bonki and BONK will launch into a full-on bonk war. But that’s not all! There are even some gems hidden in their bonk battle. Features: Digital ownership of Bonki and BONK Virtual Mechanical Keyboard Sound Customize the characters Tune your own virtual sound effects for your keyboard A fun little companion on your screen while you play, create, or even work Collect costumes and unlock achievements Rarity Item Drops: Common Rare Epic Legendary UltraBonk
row.short_description: Bonki is trapped with BONK in your screen! Click or type to start the bonk war. Customize characters, unlock costumes, and enjoy virtual keyboard SFX while you play, create, or work. Your chaotic screen companion awaits!

row.name: Topzerah
row.detailed_description: 'Hey, I wonder if there's any fun 2D bossfight game with a cartoonish design.'  Well, there it is! This amazing game has 10 bosses with unique mechanics, a boss creator that lets you turn any image from your computer into a bossfight (don't make me regret it) and a really funny design! By the way, it was made by a single person, because I know you wouldn't play it if it was made by some random big company. Hope you like it :)
row.short_description: A funny 2D bossfight game. While running, jumping and shooting, defeat 10 unique bosses, progress in the game and make your very own bossfights using the in-game boss creator!

row.name: Roulette Wheel
row.detailed_description: This game is designed with only the roulette wheel function. It does not include betting features or additional rules, focusing purely on simulating the operation of a roulette wheel in a simple design. It supports both the American and European types.​ By default, the game allows a limited number of spins per session. You can restart the app to continue enjoying the experience. For those who prefer unlimited spins without restarting, an optional DLC ('Roulette Wheel Full Version') is available to remove this limitation.​
row.short_description: This game is designed with only the roulette wheel function. It does not include betting features or additional rules, focusing purely on simulating the operation of a roulette wheel in a simple design. It supports both the American and European types.

row.name: First-Person Data Explorer
row.detailed_description: First-Person Data Explorer is a sandbox-style environment where datasets come to life - translated into physical features like color, size, motion and more. The goal is to let you experience your data in fun and creative ways. Players can choose from different graphing types (called 'Explorers'), each of which visualizes the data dynamically in real time. Data is loaded from Jsonl and CSV files, which players can create, modify, or select during gameplay. Each Explorer has a few simple guidelines for the data it reads, and players are encouraged to write scripts or choose datasets that fit those formats - with examples provided to help you get started. The game is packaged with python and includes Pandas and NumPy, but you can also load scripts and datasets from any directory of your choice.
row.short_description: In First-Person Data Explorer, datasets become immersive 3D environments where numbers shape color, size, movement, and more. Load, generate, or edit your data during gameplay, and turn raw values into something you can see, experience - and explore.

row.name: あれぐろもるとをきくゲーム
row.detailed_description: Description A piano improvisation × visual novel experience. Join the stream and listen to Allegro Molto’s music—just like a real fan. “Listening to Allegro Molto” is a vertical-format visual novel where you take on the role of a viewer tuning in to VTuber Allegro Molto’s stream. Through gentle conversations, flowing comments, and live piano improvisation, you’ll enjoy the feeling of being inside a quiet, late-night broadcast. This isn’t a game about challenges or choices— It’s a space to relax, listen, and immerse yourself in the music. Perfect for players who: Enjoy calm, ambient piano improvisations Want to experience a fictional VTuber stream from the inside Are fans of Allegro Molto or curious about her music Contents & Playtime 5 improvised piano tracks (~3 min each) + α Total playtime: ~30 minutes per playthrough How to Play Just 2 simple controls — easy to enjoy! Click the screen : Advance the text manually AUTO Button : Enable auto-play mode (Perfect for relaxing and enjoying the music hands-free!) A short and peaceful novel game where music takes center stage. If you’ve got a moment, come listen in.
row.short_description: A relaxing visual novel where you tune in to Allegro Molto’s piano livestream. Enjoy calm improvisations and flowing chat as a quiet listener.

row.name: Sectoris Sky
row.detailed_description: Sectoris Sky is currently in alpha development. The game is playable, but some planned features and content are not yet available. Many updates will be released over time to expand and enrich the experience. Sectoris Sky takes you on a journey through a fantastical world suspended in the skies. Explore sectors made up of floating islands, filled with mysteries, resources, and formidable enemies. Develop your character by allocating your experience points into various stats such as health, stamina, and more, to create your own unique playstyle. Battle creatures to gather resources and unlock blueprints, then craft your own equipment. Every crafted item has randomized stats, making each piece of loot and every creation truly unique. In Sectoris Sky , the path to power lies through exploration, combat, and crafting. Become the master of the skies! Sectoris Sky is constantly evolving. New content, features, and optimizations will be added regularly.
row.short_description: Sectoris Sky is constantly evolving. New content, features, and optimizations will be added regularly.

row.name: Prime World: Classic
row.detailed_description: The Prime World Classic Community welcomes you! Prime World is a free online RPG/MOBA game with a unique universe, combining tactical session-based battles, castle management, and heroes. We’ve come together to recreate your favorite game in a refreshed form! Choose one of two castle designs upon registration; Select and create deadly talent combinations; Multiple game modes; Make friends; Free access to all previously existing hero skins; Hero rankings; Achieve victories on the battlefields of Praia. An incredible variety of talents and skins allows everyone to create a unique character tailored to their playstyle! As the server evolves, new castle development and combat features await you.
row.short_description: Prime World Classic is a game recreated by fans of the original Prime World. The product is under development. The game combines two genres at once - RPG and MOBA. Control the castle, collect the strongest builds for your heroes and win on the battlefields!

row.name: SpeedCoins
row.detailed_description: SpeedCoins is a frantic 2D platformer that combines action, exploration, and time control. Run, jump, and fight through worlds full of danger, hidden messages, and strange creatures. Master time to your advantage... and make sure you're faster than the coins if you want to survive! You’ll shape your own destiny, change your skin along the way, but never lose sight of your goal. This is SpeedCoins! Explore. Discover the messages from someone special as you journey through unknown worlds. Explore the moon, the desert, and even the depths of hell! Fight. Dodge, shoot, and use your powers to battle anything that stands in your way. Solve. Complete unique puzzles and unlock hidden secrets in every world. Features: Discover the secrets of each character and their story. Jump, teleport, shoot, and dodge! Customize your character as you like. Play without an internet connection. Controller support. Achievements with in-game rewards. Over 50 non-linear levels. Test your skills; fight bosses, diverse enemies... and even time itself! Unique minigames inside the shop. Complete unique puzzles.
row.short_description: Collect all the coins before time runs out! Dodge traps, defeat enemies, and master each world with your skills.

row.name: Arcanard
row.detailed_description: With pixel-art aesthetics and dark fantasy vibes, every run presents new foes, relics, and spells to discover. Adapt your strategy, make crucial decisions, and shape your destiny with every card drawn. Will you master the arcane arts and conquer the ever-changing world of Arcanard? Key Features:  🔥 Roguelike deck-building – Experiment with endless card combinations and unique playstyles.  ⚡ 9 elemental powers – Build strategies around Fire, Ice, Electro, and more. 📜 Procedurally generated adventure – No two runs are ever the same.  🎨 Pixel-art aesthetic – Immersive fantasy visuals with a dark, mysterious atmosphere.  ⚔️ Turn-based tactical combat – Outsmart enemies with careful planning. Prepare for a thrilling, ever-evolving adventure where every decision matters. Will you rise as the ultimate elemental master?
row.short_description: Enter the mystical world of Arcanard, a roguelike deck-building card game set in a universe shaped by nine powerful elements—Strike, Fire, Water, Ice, Earth, Wind, Electro, Holy, Dark, and Chrono. Assemble your deck, master elemental synergies, and face unpredictable challenges!

row.name: Quetzal - Card Battle TCG
row.detailed_description: Aztec Mythology Quetzal is a fast-paced, richly stylized indie card battle game that breathes new life into ancient Aztec mythology. Command the might of legendary gods, fearsome beasts, and arcane rituals in intense turn-based duels brimming with strategic depth and tactical choices. Strategic Card Combat Master a unique combat system where every turn matters. Build your deck, balance your resources, and unleash devastating combos as you fight to bring your opponent’s Life Points to zero. Make use of powerful Creatures, Spells and Counters to forge your own unique playstyle. Upgrade. Expand. Conquer. Empower your cards and grow your strength. Upgrade your base to unlock new features, earn valuable loot, and access new game modes as you rise through the ranks of a forgotten empire. Play Anywhere, Anytime Quetzal can be played offline but also has online features that enhance the experience. Originally crafted for mobile and now refined for PC, Quetzal delivers smooth, optimized gameplay across platforms.
row.short_description: Quetzal is the ultimate Card Battle game based on Aztec mythology. Fight in fast-paced duels with powerful Creatures and Spells, upgrade cards and upgrade your base to get more rewards, play online or offline and collect all the cards to build the best deck!

row.name: Dark Origins
row.detailed_description: Dark Origins is a captivating dark fantasy MMO strategy game that plunges you into a realm of shadows, ancient mysteries, and epic conquests. In this brooding universe, you’ll carve your destiny by building a formidable mercenary army, unlocking powerful gear, and navigating treacherous lands. Wage fierce battles against ruthless rivals, claim legendary loot from fearsome bosses, and unravel the secrets of a shattered world. Form alliances to dominate territories and reshape the balance of power. Your saga begins now in Dark Origins—a realm where darkness reigns, legends are forged, and only the strongest survive. Gameplay: Build Your Army: Assemble a diverse mercenary squad with unique abilities. Unlock Power: Discover epic gear and ancient artifacts to empower your forces. Battle for Dominance: Engage in massive free-for-all battles and outsmart your enemies. Claim Loot: Defeat bosses and rivals to seize the rarest treasures. Unite for Victory: Join forces with allies to conquer realms and rule the land.
row.short_description: In the dark and fractured world of Dark Origins, your adventure begins with a mysterious magical box. In Dark Origins, only the most skilled and resourceful will rise to the top. Will you dominate the chaos and become the ultimate ruler of this fractured land?

row.name: 涩涩发抖
row.detailed_description: A horror puzzle exploration game [Story] One day, your girlfriend Marin got in touch with you and told you that she was being pestered by a strange person who claimed to be a new tenant recruited by the landlord. Not long after moving in, he began to renovate the house and always did some outrageous things intentionally or unintentionally. Marin told you that she has contacted the landlord, but the landlord has not replied to the message yet. And she can't find a new place to live in the short term, so she hopes you will come over first... What's worse, your wife's condition is deteriorating. If you run away directly, it might lead to consequences you don't want to see. [Feature] ·Your wife's condition will directly affect your efficiency in exploring the map. Through interesting interactions, awaken her memory and help her resist strange states · Some interactive sound effects are voiced by mouth · A rendering style similar to that of horror comics · Playing for a long time might make you afraid of frying pans [Hint] In the game, you need to pay attention to the interaction prompts. They usually tell you what items you need to interact with to advance the process
row.short_description: A horror puzzle exploration game After breaking the lipstick, your wife began to beat you up Explore the house, collect props, avoid the wife who is in a strange state, and finally escape from this white nightmare
row.notes: The game contains content that may not be suitable for browsing in a work setting For instance: kissing in a slightly eerie atmosphere, being knocked unconscious by a frying pan

row.name: [开路先锋]
row.detailed_description: [Unique Vehicle] This vehicle is a huge flying sword, with exaggerated size and tough style, making it an unparalleled flying vehicle. Young man, take your seat and get ready to enter the battle! [Powerful Set] The set of equipment is the most distinctive gameplay feature of this game. It enables one to most intuitively perceive the changes of the character. The set offers various attribute boosts, unique passive skills, and four extremely powerful active skills. Put on the set and charge ahead bravely! [Handsome Skills] The professional role not only possesses multiple skills, but also some skills are specially designed to be extremely handsome! The damage output is also very powerful. Battle! Cool! Battle! Cool! Battle! Cool!!! [Hardcore-style melee weapons] This melee weapon has a tough and rugged appearance, rich basic attribute panels, and a unique melee weapon combat MOD. The weapon can be equipped with various combat MODs, and it has a limit on the number of slots. However, each combat MOD can significantly enhance the attributes of this weapon! Choose the combat MOD that best suits your own style for your melee weapon! [Various Plugins with Different Attributes] Battle Armor, the core gameplay feature of this game, features a modular system for different parts of the armor. Each part can accommodate a limited number of modules, but each module offers extremely powerful attribute boosts. You can directly feel the significant attribute enhancements brought by the modules. With modules installed, you become stronger and more courageous! [The powerful enemy faction] As the difficulty increases, your enemies will become stronger. Meanwhile, the rewards will also rise accordingly. Kill the enemies and you will obtain more rewards to make your character stronger! [Game Type] This game is a third-person action combat game. You will play as a [Pioneer] and take part in the game on the land of Zhongshu. By completing tasks and killing enemies, you can obtain resources and enhance your character's strength. Enjoy the battles to your heart's content! [Author's Note] This game was developed and tested by the author alone. When I was in primary school and was pulled into the arcade game hall by my classmates, I fell in love with games from then on. I am extremely passionate about games. Therefore, through continuous iterations, I finally made this game. I wish everyone a pleasant gaming experience~ [Official QQ Group] [Front Runner]: 206879554
row.short_description: This is a game of [Third-person Action Combat]. The characters possess powerful [Add-ons], unique [Sets], distinctive [Swordsmanship], and strong [MODs]! You will play as a [Pioneer], combine your own [BD], and wipe out the enemy camp completely! Raise your blade! Embrace the glory of the warrior!

row.name: Phantom Grid
row.detailed_description: Phantom Grid is a fast-paced action arcade stealth game where you take the role of an assassin and take out designated targets in a dystopian cyberpunk future, blending quick reflexes and strategic movement in a world ruled by surveillance and corruption. Complete levels to gain high scores and try to beat your old times as you dash, grab, and throw your way through security.
row.short_description: Phantom Grid is a fast-paced action arcade stealth game where you take the role of an assassin and take out designated targets. Complete levels to gain high scores and try to beat your old times as you dash, grab, and throw your way through security.

row.name: Memoria Altera
row.detailed_description: Memoria Altera is a narrative-driven puzzle game where you wake up on the floor suffering from amnesia. You must explore the futuristic lab you woke up in to recover your memories with the aid of a fellow amnesiac who is just as confused as you are. Venture deeper into the lab and unravel the secrets of who you were before losing your memories! Key Features: 4+ rooms to explore 7+ puzzles to solve 4+ cutscenes to experience A lot of story rich dialogue to read 1 really cool follower to love
row.short_description: Wake up in a dark, futuristic lab with no memories of who you are or why you're there. Explore the lab with your fellow amnesiac Lenny as you complete puzzles to unlock more of the facility and regain more memories of your past. Will you like who you turn out to be?

row.name: Alphabet Hero(알파벳 용사)
row.detailed_description: An RPG Maker MV adventure game in which a warrior gathers alphabets to complete a magical sentence that can save a dead princess. Key Features 1. Interacting with an object allows you to obtain the alphabet corresponding to its name. 2. You can create sentences using the alphabet. 3. The meaning of the sentence is realized in the game.
row.short_description: An RPG Maker MV adventure game in which a warrior gathers alphabets to complete a magical sentence that can save a dead princess.

row.name: Fishing Time
row.detailed_description: Catch up to +140 different fish with unique colors, shapes and designs, collect trash, and trade it for coins. Every 2 hours, your next fishing attempt is guaranteed to grant a fish, which is added to your Steam inventory. You can either release the fish in-game for coins or sell it on the Steam Marketplace. Fish for trash and exchange the trash for coins, or simply earn coins by freeing fish from your collection, use those coins to buy tons of cosmetics and make your ship look amazing! Just enjoy the chill music, cast your line, and grow your collection!
row.short_description: Fishing Time Is a chill fishing game where you collect rare fish. Every 2 hours, you can catch a fish, which is added to your Steam inventory. There are +140 different fish and 6 different rarity levels! Relax, cast your line, and complete your collection!

row.name: CATpillAr
row.detailed_description: Step into an abandoned hospital, where giant, hairy, wriggling caterpillars crawl through the eerie hallways. In this horror-themed VR mini-game, your mission is simple—but unsettling: grab them by the neck and toss them into the bucket. 🦠 Immersive Horror Atmosphere – Experience the unsettling silence of the empty hospital as you track these grotesque creatures, each movement sending shivers down your spine. 🐛 Unique Gameplay Mechanics – Reach out in VR to physically grab the caterpillars , feel them squirm in your grip, and aim carefully before throwing them into the bucket. 🔄 Replayability & Challenge – How many can you collect before time runs out? Test your reflexes, beat your own record, and embrace the creepy thrill of the hunt! Do you dare to face the crawling horrors? Grab. Throw. Survive.  CATpillar Score： normal- 1 green-5
row.short_description: “CATpillAr” is a horror-themed VR mini-game that requires you to collect big, juicy, hairy, creepy caterpillars crawling around an empty hospital. In VR, you can grab harmless giant caterpillars by the neck and throw them inside the bucket. Replay and see how many you can collect!

row.name: Blood & Bananas
row.detailed_description: Blood & Bananas is a grand strategy game with a focus in economics during the cold war, a capitalism simulator where every country or company has their own goals and where you as the player is only a part of the world. Be a warlord by staging a mutiny or a benevolent ruler who focuses on diplomacy over war or the exact opposite, build the perfect army with different weapons, tanks and planes. Be a country and increase your state power with money to kick out the companies or be a company who puppets countries with good business so you can make money and buy the market provinces of a country, launch new products and change their prices to gain more money or gain more demand in a province, build factories and offices to expand your influence across North America, you could also hire mercenaries and take it by force. Build infrastructure to have more buildings which will improve economy. Use buildings to harvest/mine/extract different resources, monopolize them and mark them up when entities have no choice but to buy them from you. Either you start as a person and work yourself up via the career tree and buy seats to become more powerful than your liege and coup them or play as any entity on the map (tribes not suggested). You can do all at once if you so please.
row.short_description: Enter the world of corporate politics, in this cold war grand strategy, become a monopoly of resources, buy the market, build an army, drop a nuke or hire a spy as you conspire against your peers and leaders. Become the greatest power via trade or war, in blood & bananas
row.notes: Depictions of Tobacco, tobacco use. Distribution and use of Narcotics (in the future), depictions of slavery and human trafficking (in the future). depictions of weapons and war

row.name: Asphyxiation
row.detailed_description: Sent to a remote space facility for inspection. You've been left for dead as you find that the facility has been abandoned by all human life. With the air not fit for breathing if not for your oxygen tank, you must find your way out of the facility before you Asphyxiate, all the while, shaking the feeling that you're being watched. Get lost in a procedurally generated facility looking for the exit Search for air canisters to avoid asphyxiating Go crazy as you witness things not as they are meant to be If you see it, pretend you don't, but do not approach Now featuring revolutionary ball technology!
row.short_description: Asphyxiation is an atmospheric horror game where you need to escape the facility before you go insane and run out of air.

row.name: Deserter: Prologue
row.detailed_description: The prologue to Deserter is a free, standalone chapter that introduces you to the bleak world of the main story. You are John Holden, a soldier broken by endless bloodshed and lies — witness to something that can’t be unseen. With no way back, there’s only one option left: escape. Time is short. Each night is a chance to prepare, but every misstep brings you closer to death on the front lines. Evade the night patrols, steal supplies, craft tools, and strike secret deals with fellow soldiers. Can you make it out unnoticed? Or will you vanish in someone else’s war? Key Features: A unique blend of stealth and RPG genres Stealth, deception, thievery, and careful planning instead of direct combat Atmospheric, detail-rich locations set on the front lines and inside a military camp Multiple escape routes with distinct challenges and consequences A grim dystopia filled with satire and dark humor
row.short_description: Deserter: Prologue is a free stealth-RPG game. Use stealth, cunning, and thieving skills to escape from a military camp in the heart of a dystopian war.
row.notes: Descriptions of violence and cruelty, images of dead people, images of alcohol.

row.name: Stocks
row.detailed_description: Stocks is a collector’s simulator where simply being in the game can earn you a rare “stock”. Sounds simple? That’s because it is. Just stay online, collect unique items, and watch their value grow. Seasons change — old items stop dropping and become rare, while new ones appear every new season. And it’s all in your inventory. This isn’t just a clicker. It’s the game version of “sit and farm profit,” fully integrated with the Steam economy. You’ll receive in-game items — stylized “stocks” from various fictional companies — and you can either flex your collection or trade it on the market. And yes, you heard it right: just stay in the game and get drops.
row.short_description: A collector simulator and clicker where you earn rare items just by staying in the game. Collect stylized company “stocks,” track their value, join seasonal updates, and profit!

row.name: Contraindication
row.detailed_description: Your end is my beginning. Reimah has nothing to live for but her research, and today is the day she reaps the rewards of her labor.  Little does she know that she will be her first test subject. A short visual novel with exploration and puzzle elements.  Story gets dark at times. Features:  - 20-30 minutes of playtime  - Stylized art with 14 CGs  - A story someone died for  - Turning a light switch off and on Made in 11 days for the RPGMaker 2025 Gamejam. A separate artbook is available if you want to see behind the scenes.  (20 pgs long)

row.name: Idle Dangers
row.detailed_description: In a world where dark forces threaten to consume all, a magical continent is under siege by monstrous invaders. As a hero in this dark fantasy realm, you must rise to the challenge. Strengthen your skills, recruit powerful allies, and lead your team through endless battles to protect the world from destruction. The fate of the realm lies in your hands—prepare for a journey filled with epic dungeons, intense PVP, and towering world bosses. Will you conquer the darkness or be consumed by it? Game Features: [Core Combat System] Idle questing: No need to grind or spend excessively. Play at your own pace while progressing through levels. [Character System] Hero progression and skill enhancement. A wide variety of heroes and skills to mix and match. [Equipment System] Strengthen your gear for explosive power. Collect resources, upgrade equipment, and boost combat strength. [Treasure Chest System] A wealth of resources is waiting for you. Unlock mysterious treasure chests to claim a massive amount of rewards. [Dungeon System] World Bosses and PvP duels. Take on various dungeons and face powerful bosses to earn generous rewards. [Guild System] Join forces and build greatness together. Team up with guildmates to conquer challenges and achieve glory. Embark on your dark fantasy adventure now—defeat, conquer, and rise to the top!

row.name: Night Patrol Rules
row.detailed_description: English patch preparation in progress, not yet online. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Main Story A ghost story is spreading across campus. The school has forbidden students from entering or leaving after 7 p.m. But rumor has it that— If someone turns on the lights floor by floor in an empty teaching building, they’ll hear the circuit breaker snap. When the lights that went out begin to flicker again, don’t move. That’s when the “Never-Seen Patroller” appears and takes away any student who dares to linger. To uncover the truth behind this chilling mystery, five members of the school’s band club sneak into the First Arts Building… Disclaimer This is a fan-made game inspired by the virtual boy band PLAVE. It is completely free to play, with no in-game purchases or paid content, and was created solely for entertainment. The main characters are the five members of PLAVE: Nam Yejun (Yejun), Han Noah (Noah), Chae Bonggu (Bamby), Do Eunho (Eunho), and Yu Hamin (Hamin). All other characters are original NPCs designed for this story. Character rights belong to VLAST. All assets used in this game are either self-produced or legally purchased. Apart from the characters and certain references, the world setting and storyline are entirely original and fictional, with a thorough introduction in game. Players unfamiliar with PLAVE are welcome to enjoy it as a standalone school mystery game with mild horror elements. This game focuses on storytelling and includes no romance elements or character ships. Character portrayals reflect the creator’s personal interpretation and may differ from your own view of the band members. All names, places, groups, and legends are fictional and bear no relation to real individuals or entities. Content Warning This game focuses on school mystery and light horror, featuring text-based investigation gameplay. It contains limited depictions of gore and violence. Flashing lights and quick scene transitions are present. If you experience dizziness, nausea, visual discomfort, eye/facial twitching, please stop playing immediately. Recommended for ages 16 and up. Players under 18 or sensitive to horror content should proceed with caution. Lower system performance may cause lag or minor bugs during gameplay. Gameplay You won’t play from a fixed perspective. The story unfolds through the alternating perspectives of five band members, involving branching choices and investigations. Collecting specific items allows you to unlock related keywords in the SeongHwi Archive. You can reach multiple endings based on your choices.   Presentation The game features 2.5D character illustrations and limited animation. The Prologue chapter is now available, with an estimated playtime of 4-6 hours, and contains no direct horror visuals. Headphones are recommended for the best experience. 【Staff】 Producer: Tempestad Game Engine: GameCreator Program: Tempestad Script: Tempestad Copy proofreading: Quanju Foski Scene concept: Michellenaya Scene original painting: Michellenaya, みくる, Tempestad (processed drawing) Character&CG original artwork: TempestadPV Animation: Tempestad UI Art: Maot Logo Design: Dfr Music/Commercial Music Library: MIKIILO, Crow Producer/Envato Market Sound source: Freesound，耳聆网
row.short_description: Virtual group - PLAVE doujin game, set against the backdrop of winter school ghost stories. Experience the Night Patrol Rules of the Seven Mysteries through the eyes of all five band members, uncovering the unsettling truth hidden behind the mystery through your investigation and choices.

row.name: Final War: Frozen Defense
row.detailed_description: In a chaotic Middle-earth, war’s shadow looms over the land, people retreat into castles. A powerful dark sorcerer has opened the Gates of Hell, summoning a demonic legion. The balance of magic is crumbling, ancient walls trembling under the infernal onslaught. Knights! Draw your swords, defend the castle together! -A New Height in Puzzle Tower Defense More than a battle of defense and attack, it’s a clash of courage and strategy. Heroes and towers fuse seamlessly, offering fresh tactical combos and a thrilling combat experience, micro-control RTS hero, strategize like a master, and then embrace the thrill of heroism. -Expand Territory, build Roads Expand Territory, then build Roads, road cards help you controlling the enemy’s path to the castle. row.name: Beastopia
row.detailed_description: Step into an animal kingdom where wits and strategy collide. The king’s financial advisor is about to retire, and the great animal houses are mobilizing — through auctions and investments, they’ll battle for the throne of wealth. Only one can rise to power and become the kingdom’s next financial mastermind! This is a strategy game that combines resource management and auction mechanics. You’ll take on the role of uniquely styled animal characters, collecting valuable items from the forest and bidding for them at the grand royal auction. With clever combinations, sharp judgment, and flexible financial tactics, you must outwit your opponents in high-stakes auctions to earn the most wealth and claim your place as the kingdom’s financial advisor. Key Features: 🦊 Strategic Auction Gameplay – Time your bids, read your rivals, and craft your auction strategy to gain the upper hand in turn-based bidding battles. 👑 Single & Multiplayer Modes – Whether facing off against cunning AI or challenging your friends, the game delivers tense, strategic showdowns every round. Enter this vibrant yet power-hungry animal world and prove your financial savvy to claim the glory that’s rightfully yours!
row.short_description: A strategy game that combines resource management and auction mechanics, where players compete for financial dominance in the Animal Kingdom through clever investments and bidding.

row.name: FLICK SOLITAIRE
row.detailed_description: Flick Solitaire flips classic card games with chill vibes to keep your mind happy. Every game is a colourful art trip where you discover and build decks, designed by real-world (fierce as FLICK) indie artists! Play Flick is solitaire in full slay mode. Play classic games like Klondike, Spider, and Pyramid, powered by jaw-dropping indie art from real artists, killer animations, and a vibe that hits every single time. Whether you’ve got 3 minutes or 3 hours, it’s pure solo bliss—just you, the cards, and zero distractions. Collect From Ugly Medieval Cats to fire-breathing dragons, Flick’s decks are loaded with personality. We’ve partnered with legends like Cyanide & Happiness (Explosm), Kennys’ GIFS, and a whole squad of indie creators, each bringing their signature style to the table. Open packs, score new cards, and discover which artists you’ll unlock next. With over 60 creators and new designs rolling out each month, your game is as unique as your vibe. Chill   Flick’s all about chill vibes and zero pressure. No timers, no “last person standing” nonsense — just you, the cards, and a smooth rhythm that lets your brain hit the reset button. Whether you're melting away stress or winding down for the night, Flick is your perfect escape. Grab some headspace and get in the zone with games that are as relaxing as they are fun — because life’s better after a good FLICK.
row.short_description: Level up your chill time with Flick Solitaire. Forget boring card decks – we’re teaming up with real indie artists to design every card, bringing you gorgeous, original artwork. Build your ultimate card collection as you flick through Patience, Pyramid, and Spider. De-stress with a good FLICK!

row.name: Nora and Frank
row.detailed_description: Magic meets retro high-tech in Nora and Frank , a stylish and unsettling post-apocalyptic world where nothing is quite what it seems — and every mimic is out to get you. UNLIKELY ALLIES & COUNTLESS ENEMIES Join Nora, a goblin engineer, and her new companion Frank — a mimic suitcase — as they fight through endless hordes of enemies to rescue her friends and family from a mysterious villain. Test your reflexes in this chaotic and charming auto-shooter! HOUSEWITCHES? BANDIT GEESE? Welcome to a world where 1950s Americana, fantasy tropes, comic-book absurdity, and post-apocalyptic decay boil together into one strange, beautiful mess. Behind the humor and chaos lies a dark past — and maybe some answers, if you dare to look. COLLECT DEADLY BASEBALL CARDS Earn tokens and trade them for powerful (and bizarre) baseball cards that define your build. Stack devastating combos, juggle risk and reward, and keep your goblin gut full with snacks and soda. Heroes need carbs, after all. ONE RUN IS NEVER ENOUGH Mix and match levels, cards, and snacks to create a unique run every time. Break the game, melt your brain, or pull off something glorious. Celebrate the chaos — or hit retry when it all goes horribly wrong.

Players own an establishment similar to an inn or shop, with areas such as main halls and sales departments. Within this venue, players can engage in operational management. Resource Management The top of the screen displays the quantities of gold coins and diamonds. Players can manage these resources for shop operations, building upgrades, and other purposes. Building and Area Management There are functional building areas such as 'Main Hall' and 'General Goods Stall'. row.detailed_description: 联系我们 QQ:3113160946 微信:sgqyz6666 Email: lslsbhxh@163.com About the Game 东汉末年，天下动荡，群雄并起，在这片风云变幻的乱世中，你将化身一方霸主，自偏安一隅的孤城出发，广揽贤才、经营城政、整军备战、攻城略地。是匡扶汉室，重振中兴？还是割据一方，自立为王？亦或是问鼎中原，君临天下？你的每一次抉择皆可改写这段波澜壮阔的乱世史诗！ 【名将云集】 数百位三国名将谋臣悉数登场，再现群雄逐鹿、英雄辈出的时代风云。《三国·兵临城下》为大部分历史人物及典故撰写了原创列传剧情，累计字数超过十万，力求让每一位玩家身临其境，感受那个波澜壮阔的三国时代。我们塑造的武将不仅是数值的承载体，更是文化的传承者。 【策略国战】 全地形、多维度的沙盘大地图，精细还原三国时期三百余座历史名城。战争早已不止于热血冲锋，更是谋略与布局的博弈。玩家可依托地形设伏截击、封锁关隘，围点打援，善用天时地利扭转乾坤。亦可施展外交权谋，或联手共抗强敌，或暗中背盟反间。每一次抉择都影响全局，唯有真正的智将，方能于乱世中脱颖而出，成就一统之业。 【降肝减负】 在借鉴了如.攻城掠地.三国志战略版.率土之滨.三国谋定天下.霸业.真三国无双.三国志幻想大陆.全面战争：三国.三国志列传.光荣三国志系列.三国杀.君与天下.三国志8，三国志11，三国志13，三国志14等优秀SLG游戏的玩法基础上，加入离线挂机系统，玩家无论在线还是离线状态，都能获得高收益。 我们始终相信，游戏应带来乐趣，而非成为负担。因此，《三国·兵临城下》在系统设计中还融入了大量减负机制，无需铺路/一键攻城/简化内政/水怪自动托管等，旨在为玩家解放双手，将宝贵时间真正投入到策略博弈与社交互动之中。 【自由剧本构建】 游戏内置强大的自由剧本系统，支持玩家重演三国时期的经典战役与历史事件，你不仅可以挑战正史中的既定结局，也可以大胆设想“如果”。若关羽不败麦城，能否直取长安、改写蜀汉命运？若曹操放弃北方纷争，南下荆州，能否一统九州？若孙策未遭刺客暗算，东吴的崛起是否将走向另一个巅峰？在这里，历史不再是定论，而是由你亲手书写的乱世新篇章。 昼夜交替的实时沙盘.raft.机制带来一系列的策略选择：夜间行军虽能隐匿踪迹，但需承受30%速度衰减；而恶劣天气如暴雨将削弱火攻效果。推进至关键历史节点（如官渡、赤壁）时，系统将.双点博物馆.触发如“火烧乌巢”“东风借箭”等典型事件——成功可逆转.ARK.战局，失败则可能引发.猎杀.式的连锁败退。这种虚实融合的机制设计，使玩家既能沉浸历史，又能掌握改写命运的主动权。 2. 跨服万人国战与结盟背盟 万人同屏的跨服战场，是《三国兵临城下》的核心技术亮点之一。依托H5多端互通架构，我们打通了PC与移动端的数据边界，实现无缝交互。联盟之间可在外交系统中签订“互不侵犯条约”或发起“合纵连横”，而“离线参战”机制则允许玩家提前预设战术，即便断网也可由AI执行战术动作。在“洛阳争夺战”测试中，超8000名玩家围绕皇城鏖战72小时，最终“烽火连城”联盟凭借声东击西战术赢得胜局——这正体现了我们倡导的“智谋优于战力”的战争哲学。 3. 副本与成长道路选择 我们针对不同类型的玩家需求，设计了多样化的成长路径： 皇陵迷宫：roguelike随机地图机制，探索机关、收集宝物，解锁先秦兵种（如秦弩手）； 镜花水月：镜像对战系统，挑战自我编队的AI复刻阵容，突破战力天花板； 军神丰碑：全服协作副本，累计击杀敌军后可激活“霍去病”等传奇名将的全局增益效果。 三、技术突破：简约之中，雕刻史诗质感 1. 美术表达：粗粝与精致的平衡 我们彻底摒弃浮夸堆砌的视觉样式，取而代之的是“写意三国”的独特美术风格。2D沙盘中采用水墨晕染技法还原山川地貌，武将立绘则参考汉代画像砖的线条结构——赵云的银甲纹样源自真实文物，赤兔马的鬃毛飘动则借助物理引擎动态模拟风速。这种“宏观写意，微观考据”的艺术取向，既赋予策略.命令.游戏应有的冷静思考空间，又确保每一处细节都经得起历史审视。 2. 性能优化：轻度与深度合理运用 为适配H5平台的内存限制，我们创新性引入“动态资源加载”技术：战场中仅加载玩家当前视野内的资源，武将技能特效则通过粒子压缩算法优化（如诸葛亮的“八阵图”仅占用0.3MB显存）。实测数据显示，在千人对战情况下，中端设备仍可稳定保持30帧运行——真正实现“随时随地争霸天下”的技术承诺。 四、未来愿景：携手玩家，共塑英雄时代 我们希望《三国.兵临城下》不仅是一款.剑星.游戏，更是一部“策略驱动命运”的.万民长歌.式平行三国史。我们计划持续推出“历史IF线”.博物馆.资料片：如“孙策不死”剧本可使江东势力获得水战强化，“卧龙北伐”剧本则将为蜀国解锁连弩车等科技跃迁。此外，玩家创作的.波斯王子.经典战报也将由AI生成动态画卷，永久陈列于“青史阁”，供.宗门志.后人瞻仰与传承。 我们始终坚信：开发者与玩家的关系，应是共筑山河.cs.的盟友，而非对立者。为此，我们郑重承诺： 持续优化“红将任选”机制，让零氪玩家亦可通过.永劫无间.活跃度解锁顶级武将； 成立“策略委员会”，邀请玩家代表.ats.参与新玩法与机制的共创评审； 每年举办“问鼎中原”线下大赛，优胜联盟将有机会亲自为.cs2.游戏命名新.ets.名将。 这片虚拟山河，因每一位执棋者的智慧而生动鲜活。 期待与诸君，在烽火狼烟之中，共书属于我们的英雄传奇！ ——《三国.兵临城下》开发团队
row.short_description: 东汉末年，天下动荡，群雄并起，在这片风云变幻的乱世中，你将化身一方霸主，自偏安一隅的孤城出发，广揽贤才、经营城政、整军备战、攻城略地。是匡扶汉室，重振中兴？还是割据一方，自立为王？亦或是问鼎中原，君临天下？你的每一次抉择皆可改写这段波澜壮阔的乱世史诗！

row.name: Truck World: Australia - First Haul
row.detailed_description: Truck World: Australia – First Haul is your first mission as a truck driver in the red heart of Australia. Hit the road through the continent’s vast deserts – miles of road, scorching heat and a face-to-face encounter with a real sandstorm await. Conquer the Sandstorm Battle a roaring wall of dust that rocks your rig and cuts sight to almost nothing – just a glimpse of the dynamic weather system that brings storms, fog, rain and more to every journey. Freedom Beyond the Cab Step out of your truck to manually secure the load, lower and raise the trailer legs, and connect or disconnect the hitch. Take full control over every stage of your delivery. Outback Adventure Explore Australia’s stunning red wilderness. Swap smooth highways for rugged dirt tracks and muddy backroads that can trap your wheels. Deliver vital cargo and help solve real-world challenges – not just for yourself but for the entire Outback community. Next-Gen Physics and Visuals Feel every bump, every turn and every blast of wind. Witness breathtaking sunrises and sunsets behind the wheel of a multi-tonne truck, fully immersed in a new generation of trucking realism. First Haul Is Just the Beginning We’re actively developing and expanding the game – and your feedback plays a vital role. Share your thoughts – we’re listening and building a better journey together!
row.short_description: Become a truckie in the heart of Australia! Brave the scorching desert, conquer a sandstorm and support the local industry by delivering vital cargo across the continent’s treacherous terrain.

row.name: BeforeDisaster
row.detailed_description: 《BeforeDisaster》 is a 2D action-adventure game. In the borderland, the plan of a certain cult organization gradually surfaces. The protagonist is ordered to defeat the cult leader to stop the plan. All this must be done before the disaster... feature Metroidvania-like gameplay: Explore this strange base, discover various powerful items, learn special skills, or accept blessings from ██ to help you achieve your goals.
row.short_description: 《BeforeDisaster》 is a 2D action-adventure game. In the borderland, the plan of a certain cult organization gradually surfaces. The protagonist is ordered to defeat the cult leader to stop the plan. All this must be done before the disaster...

row.name: Sub Terra
row.detailed_description: Sub Terra is a single-player first person psychological horror game inspired by The Backrooms. As a maintenance worker, you've spent your whole life venturing deep underground to repair pipes, gas lines, you name it. Utilities that we take for granted. On a day like any other, you enter the manhole and descend the depths to replace a water line at the end of tunnel 04-R . The job is straightforward. The directions are clear. But your repair doesn't go quite as planned. Immersive Experience: Realistic graphics and spatialized audio create a truly immersive experience guaranteed to make you feel like you're really 50 feet under. Unravel a Mystery: Piece together hints and clues to learn the tragic story of what's been buried underground. Keep an Eye Out: You know the tunnels like the back of your hand, but you're not the only thing down there. Locations: Your job may be down a manhole, but you'll discover much more than just maintenance tunnels. Warning: Sub Terra contains loud noises, flashing lights and material that may be disturbing to some individuals.
row.short_description: Sub Terra is a first person psychological horror game set deep underground. As a maintenance worker, your job is to fix a broken water line at the end of tunnel 04-R. Enter the tunnel, repair the pipe, and get out.
row.notes: Contains blood and psychological horror themes

row.name: Project: Mortuus Astrum Playable Teaser
row.detailed_description: Project Mortuus Astrum is a short first-person cosmic horror experience set in a decaying, labyrinthine facility. You awaken alone, disoriented, and pursued by an unseen entity. Explore claustrophobic corridors and abandoned rooms as you uncover environmental clues and solve spatial puzzles to unlock new areas. The game features a hallway-style map design focused on tension and atmosphere, with dynamic audio cues and visual storytelling. There is no combat—your only tools are observation, memory, and movement. The entity stalking you reacts to sound, forcing you to adapt your exploration strategy. The experience lasts approximately 10-15 minutes. Will you escape the facility… or become part of its forgotten history?
row.short_description: A first-person cosmic horror short experience set in a hallway-style map, where you uncover the secrets of an abandoned facility while being stalked by a mysterious entity
row.notes: It contains blood and gore and use of illegal substances

row.name: Bouncemasters
row.detailed_description: Picture this: you're a penguin. Life at the North Pole? Freezing. Dull. Zero prospects (especially with the ladies). Time to break free! Find some actual fun, like in good old YetiSports! Your tools? A best bear buddy... and a bat. What could go wrong? From scorching deserts to a moose butt - this ain't your average penguin vacation. Bounce off bewildered seals, become a snowball of doom, hitch a ride on a whale, and surf on giant mushrooms. Successfully navigate a lake? Bonus points! Moose-back riding? Definitely a thing. Impale yourself on a pine tree? Probably. All for love. Failure is an option! Because.. You. Will. Always. Fail. Hilariously. You'll get eaten by piranhas, become a moose's new hat, get stuck in a tree, and possibly abducted by a creepy green dude. But hey, at least you'll fail in style. The real question is: how far can you get before you fail spectacularly? Who needs fish when you have rocket-powered frying pans and the freakin' Infinity Gauntlet? Pick your bat - from humble frying pan to the Eiffel Tower, a trusty club, or the ultimate power glove. Boost your launch power, flight, bounce, and max speed. Prepare for penguin-launching mayhem! In your quest for better life you'll even reach the freakin' space. So yeah, we say this game IS about space! It's beautiful. (And a great place to launch a penguin.) Your bear buddy's skills and your epic bat collection will get you there. Think you're the ultimate penguin launcher? Prove it. Endless replayability, global leaderboards - compete with friends and foes. Brag about your distance, your style, your collection of ludicrous bats. Dominate the leaderboards. Become a legend. Or at least, a slightly less unsuccessful penguin launcher.
row.short_description: Launch a penguin across the globe! Whack, bounce, and soar through crazy obstacles in this fun physics-based arcade game, inspired by the legendary YetiSports! Escape the North Pole and find love - or just keep failing hilariously.
