row.name: Acki Nacki - Popit Game
row.detailed_description: Gameplay Overview Calculate, maneuver, and outplay others using your deck. Pair it with tactically deployed Popits. And don't forget to count. How it works: Play card combos to match or beat each Block’s score and climb upward. Score enough points to lift the Block higher. Think. Count. Adapt. If you fail — you fall. But you’re not alone. Meet the Popits Popits are unique user-generated cards that transform your deck. Use different Popits to trigger, abburate, mutate, distort, corrupt, or invert effects. Boost your score with Block Keepers Block Managers distribute rewards Acki Nacki is a combinatorial genius Attack your enemies with Malicious Block Producers Protect your progress with the help of Block Producers Some appear once and vanish. Others stay with you until your final breath in the game. Core Mechanic: Overdraft Score enough on every block. But do not score too much. If you need X and you score much more than X you pay an overdraft fee with your in-game money. Go far over the target and the game will punish you. This game isn’t about scoring the most. It’s about scoring above and as close to the target as possible. Calculate carefully, using your wits — and your calculator — to claim your reward and not get wasted. Multiplayer System: Other players can attack you — and you can attack them. This is a live, asynchronous multiplayer battlefield. Cross paths with others — sometimes gently, sometimes head-on. The leaderboard breathes. Your rank can rise, fall, or shift — even when you’re offline. Every card counts. Pick your Popits in the Popit Shop. Because Popit Game isn’t just played — it’s lived. Every session writes a new story.
row.short_description: Play Acki Nacki - Popit Game — a massively multiplayer roguelike card game. Сlimb a tower of Blocks. Use game-breaking Popits to defeat other players. Chain strategic combos to boost your score and sabotage your rivals on the live leaderboard.

row.name: SoulGatherer
row.detailed_description: A fallen guardian returns to a shattered world, where souls cry out and fragments decide fate. Soul Gatherer is a dark 3D action roguelite that challenges you to reclaim a ruined world, one soul fragment at a time. Engage in fast-paced real-time combat as you choose your weapon before each run — whether it's a swift blade or a heavy-hitting greatsword. Every weapon offers a distinct approach to combat, letting you shape your playstyle through timing, movement, and skill execution. Defeat elite enemies and bosses to obtain fragments — remnants of powerful beings lost to chaos. Some fragments enhance your strength, while others hold memories that slowly unveil the story of a world broken by ambition and betrayal. You are the spirit of a once-great protector, guided by a mysterious entity known as the Timekeeper. Travel through four cursed domains — each ruled by a tormented being consumed by their past. Learn the truth behind the world's collapse and face the soul that shares your blood. Gather what remains. Defy what’s broken. And decide what comes next.
row.short_description: One world. One soul. Countless fragments.

row.name: Paper Depths
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the office, Florence . Everyone else has been fired, now it's just you… and the tireless mechanical workers serving the company and its shareholders. Your task? Fetch more documents. Always more. The robots follow orders well, but some files remain lost in the chaos of this decaying earlys 1900's bureaucracy. Dive into piles of paperwork, unravel office secrets, and navigate the absurd demands of a system gone mad. The machines can obey. But can you , a human, meet the standard?
row.short_description: In a retro-futuristic office run by machines, help Florence complete the work across looping tasks. Solve puzzles, navigate bureaucracy, and manage your time wisely in this solo isometric adventure.

row.name: GO! GO! Beetle Roller!
row.detailed_description: The devious Androliens have trapped the beloved superhero Beetle Roller inside a digital world, and it's up to you to help him escape. Race to the goal of each stage while posing fabulously! Collect colorful orbs  to grow your Beetle Ball gadget! And use your ball's power to squash your foes! THE BREAKDOWN Gameplay inspired by a mashup of Katamari , Monkey Ball , and Pizza Tower with a Kamen Rider inspired protagonist A vibrant and explosive art style inspired by anime and PS2 era games 10 blood-pumping levels with 3 different aesthetics 3 time ranks to collect in each level - can you get the fastest time? Prepare yourself for BEETLE ROLLER'S FINAL JUDGEMENT... OUR STORY GO! GO! Beetle Roller! was developed as a four-person student project at Eastern Michigan University. The game was created from scratch within a ~10 week period.
row.short_description: The 3D Action Platformer starring the titular superhero BEETLE ROLLER! Collect orbs to grow your ball gadget, blast through walls, and squish foes unworthy of your power in a mad dash to reach the end of each level!

row.name: PIG
row.detailed_description: In a final bid to cheat death, you challenge The Alleyman to a high-stakes dice game where every roll could be your last.  Though the game is simple... what The Alleyman offers isn’t: more time. Beat him, and attain extra life—lose, and he takes what time you have left.  And you? You’re dying anyway, frail body ravaged by an incurable disease.  A single die. A single choice: Will you take the deal? ⌛ GAME FEATURES ⌛ PIG: The Game was made for the O2A2 VN Jam 2025, a micro Visual Novel Jam with strict asset limitations and a 1000 word limit.   3 core conclusions.  Approximately 1,000 words.   Original illustrations.  Original Soundtrack.   The Alleyman plays against you. PIG contains mature themes and is intended for an older audience. Player discretion is advised for visual and written descriptions of gambling, death, and disease.
row.short_description: In a final bid to cheat death, you challenge The Alleyman to a high-stakes dice game where every roll could be your last.

row.name: 下道珍走倶楽部
row.detailed_description: Take on winding mountain roads using a steering wheel controller and race against the clock! Challenge past lap records and aim for the top of the leaderboard—can you beat the developer’s best time? Choose from 4 cars and 2 courses, each available in both day and night settings. Transmission options include automatic and manual. Compatible with 3-pedal + H-pattern shifter setups.*¹ Race through two courses inspired by real-world locations. Master the unique handling characteristics of each of the four cars, and push for the fastest time on twisting, winding roads! Compete against other players’ records and climb the local leaderboard.*² *¹ Confirmed to work only with the Thrustmaster T300RS. Functionality with other steering wheel controllers or gamepads is not guaranteed. *² Leaderboard is local only. Online ranking not supported.
row.short_description: 用意された4種の車で、実在するロケーションをモデルとした２種類のコースを駆け抜けよう！４種の車それぞれの癖を読み取り、曲がりくねるワインディングロードで最速を目指せ！このゲームをプレイした人とタイムを競い合い、お互いに自慢し合おう！

row.name: Master of Piece: Prologue
row.detailed_description: 《Master of Piece: Prologue》is a free prologue version of 《Master of Piece》, a deck-building roguelike game inspired from board games, offering simple yet deeply strategic gameplay. Recruit an expedition team of mercenaries, and embark on a journey to uncover the secrets of a world shrouded in dark mist. Wishlist the full version  to play the complete Mercenary-deckbuilding Game! The full game is scheduled to release in November 2025, as Early Access. Optimize your strategies, Deploy your mercenaries, and fight the battles to achieve victory. Strengthening and combining mercenaries’ unique traits are essential to creating powerful synergies and combinations, which will increase your chances of completing this perilous journey. Combat Deploy one mercenary unit per round to the battlefield and engage in combat. Once combat begins, mercenaries act in order based on their speed. Devise your best next move, given your current situation. With simple controls and a straightforward system, anyone can easily fathom the basic mechanics of the game. However, mastering and optimizing the variable combinations of mercenary traits, relics, and commander’s abilities will demand a deep and complex understanding. Easy learning, but deep, challenging gameplay at the same time! Strategic Combinations Build your team of mercenaries, not cards. Mercenary units can be enhanced and modified in various ways along the journey, offering new strategic combinations every time you play. Explore different journeys with 140+ mercenaries and traits, 80+ relics, and 400+ card events. Discover diverse combinations, build support facilities in campsites, make the ultimate expedition team of your dream. Every new game you play will be perceived differently from the previous experience, with diverse events and randomly generated paths & enemies. 120+ types of mercenaries, 80+ types of relics, 14+ types of building events, and 400+ card events will contribute to creating an infinitely replayable game. The Purpose of the Prologue Version Since launching the demo in March, over 10,000 players have downloaded our game, and many have provided valuable feedback to various parts of the game. Thanks to all the feedback we’ve received since the demo’s release, we’ve been able to improve many aspects of the game. We’re truly grateful for the opportunity to communicate with our players and see the game make progress because of it. Recognizing how essential user feedback is to creating a quality gaming experience, we’ve decided to boldly implement features that, if not for the Prologue, would have been considered only internally—and observe how players respond. The Prologue will function as a kind of test, helping us determine which features should make it into the final version based on community feedback. Prologue Features Aside from the Demo that we have released in March, here are the new features that are added in this Free Prologue Version: New region - The Blazing Sands The 2nd region will be open to play in the Prologue! New region, new enemies, new facilities, new card events and… New Bosses! New Main Lobby system The new game lobby now provides a more immersive game experience. Trait Upgrade System You can now upgrade your favorite traits and cherish even more powerful trait abilities! Commander Level Progress You can gain experience through journeys and Unlock new content through leveling up. Customizable Mercenary presets Start your expedition by customizing the commander's ability, starting relic and mercenary party of your choice.
row.short_description: In this Free version of Master of Piece, build your deck of mercenaries, find powerful synergies between various traits and relics to fight against outlaws, fanatics, and cultists, and uncover the secrets of the Dragon Orb.

row.name: Scope Battle Royale
row.detailed_description: Scope is a high-stakes, 100-player battle royale where survival means everything and freedom is the ultimate prize. Set on a remote island deep in the ocean, players take on the roles of memory-wiped warriors trapped in high-tech robotic suits. Each has been kidnapped, trained, and forced to fight in a ruthless tournament where only one can rise. Dropped from a transport plane into a sprawling, ever-shrinking battlefield, players must explore dense mountain forests to open grassy plains—scavenging for weapons, supplies, and the upper hand. With no special abilities to rely on, only strategy, reflexes, and raw skill will separate the victor from the fallen. Stylized visuals, intense solo or squad action, and a mysterious backstory lurking beneath the surface make Scope more than just a fight—it's a test of who you are when everything else has been stripped away.
row.short_description: Scope, a fast-paced 100-player battle royale where memory wiped warriors fight for survival on a remote island. Dropped into a stylized world with no powers, only skill, strategy, and will-power.
row.notes: There is no gore, but when a player is damaged by a weapon a small blood splatter will happen, indicating that you were damaged.

row.name: Lootimals
row.detailed_description: Lootimals - Collect. Hatch. Complete. Repeat. Welcome to Lootimals — the ultimate idle pet collection game where every 30 minutes could bring you your next favorite critter! Whether you're grinding for that legendary Cuburtle or just trying to finish your Moolox set, there's always something worth hatching. How it Works Drops Every 30 Minutes – watch the loot roll in. Hatch Unique Creatures – Each drop is a surprise egg containing a randomly rolled Lootimal with its own name, style, and rarity. Hatch eggs for new egg skins, click away to unlock new ingame backgrounds, all while collecting new pets for your collection. Rarity Tiers – From adorable commons to legendary beasts, the thrill of the chase is real. Achievements Galore – Completionists rejoice we've got you covered. No battles. No pay-to-win. Just you, your Lootimals, and the slow grind of fate. Lootimals is the chill companion you didn’t know you needed. Features: 30-minute drop cycles (even while minimized!) Currently 5 different Lootimals with 6 rarity tiers. Real-time rarity-based hatching Full collection tracker Collect Lootimals - Convert Into Tickets - Use Tickets On Missing Lootimals! If you love idle games, collectibles, and the satisfaction of seeing your pet library fill out, Lootimals is for you. Drop Rates: Common 95.53% 1 in About 1 Uncommon 3.43% 1 in 29 Rare 0.82% 1 in 121 Very Rare 0.14% 1 in 740 Epic 0.07% 1 in 1375 Legendary 0.010% 1 in 9630
row.short_description: Lootimals is a chill idle pet collection game where you hatch surprise eggs every 30 minutes. Discover uniquely named creatures across rarity tiers, unlock backgrounds and egg skins, complete collections, and trade in extras for missing pets. No combat, no pressure — just pure collecting bliss.

row.name: The Last Guild
row.detailed_description: The Last Guild is a classic third-person RPG with turn-based combat! Powerful beings are rising, and the Kingdom is counting on the last guild to exterminate the forces of darkness. Do you have what it takes to restore order to the world? Choose your adventurers to help restore peace and order to the Kingdom! The Last Guild blends classic RPG heritage with other innovative mechanics, creating an RPG experience like no other! The game will feature several adventures as if it had a GM narrating classic RPG campaigns, from which the player will benefit from new content. The combats are intense and turn-based. Develop your strategies to defeat dozens of unique enemies and deadly bosses. If you defeat them, you will obtain special rewards! You can build up their characters by acquiring EXP and enabling their skills and equipping them with powerful items! Explore the region in search of resources for item creation. Guild quests are essential to obtain many resources!
row.short_description: A classic RPG full of combat and regions to explore, focused on collecting resources to create magical items and defeating monsters. You are the last defense of this kingdom, hire adventurers to help you on your journey.

row.name: イロハニホヘト
row.detailed_description: ▽あらすじ 時は大正―― 主人公は銀座のカフェーで女給として働いてた。 ある日、いつも通りの出勤をすると店長にとんでもないお願いをされる…… 『美男子を紹介してくれないか！』 突然のお願いに戸惑う主人公だったが、お店のためにと引き受けることに。 しかし、思い当たるような知り合いはいない。 そこで頭に浮かんだのは常連の６人……。 彼らの誰かにお願いできないか……と考えた主人公は、彼らに声掛けをしようとするのだが―― ▲概要 フルボイスのノスタルジック乙女ゲーム プレイ時間：１ルート１時間程度 スチル数：27枚（差分含めず） エンド：６ 主人公（泉　一花(名字は固定)）（いずみ　いちか）　＊ボイス無し カフェ『バウリスタ』の店員。（18歳） 細やかな気遣いができ、お客さんからの人気が高い。 突然店長から美男子大会の候補者探しを任されることに……。 コーヒーを入れるのが好きで、時々厨房を手伝っている。 芥川　龍太郎（あくたがわ　りゅうたろう）CV：中嶋　有志 華道の家元で女性からの人気が高い。（24歳） 口数が少なく、何を考えているか分からないと思われることが多い。 真面目で堅物。 コーヒー好きで、週に数回カフェーに通う。 平塚　來（ひらつか　らい）CV：栂井　栄人 人気の舞台俳優。（24歳） 性格は俺様だが、実力が高いので認められている。 劇場が近くにあるため、週に何度か来店する。 芥川とは幼馴染で、犬猿の仲。 谷崎　二郎（たにざき　じろう）CV：ちょすやま 人気が出てきている風景画家。（23歳） 常に女性の恰好をして、喋り方も動作も女性そのもの。声も高いため、男性だと気づく人は少ない。 カウンセリングの一環で森と共にカフェーに通っている。 森　鴻（もり　こう）CV：ぺけ丸 精神科医で谷崎の主治医。（29歳） 穏やかな口調と性格で人気の医師。 カフェーにはカウンセリングを行うために、 谷崎と共に来ることが多い。 中原　昌也（なかはら　しょうや）CV：神崎　智也 尾崎と共に店によく来る客。（26歳） とても近づきにくい雰囲気を放つ怪しい人物。 尾崎（おざき）　CV：佐野　裕理 商人風の風貌の謎の人物。 敬語を話し、物腰柔らかいがどこか読めない不思議な人物。 糸目でいつもにこにこしている。 企画・イラスト・シナリオ Camellia スクリプト 斎場　榊・ときなし 中国語翻訳 无瑟 主題歌 『マドノカミ』 歌唱…花摘藍 作詞・作曲…灰色Logic(六歌) OP動画…みや。
row.short_description: 時は大正時代―― 主人公は銀座のカフェーで女給として働いてた。 ある日、いつも通りの出勤をすると店長にとんでもないお願いをされる…… 『美男子を紹介してくれないか！』 突然のお願いに戸惑う主人公だったが、お店のためにと引き受けることに。 しかし、思い当たるような知り合いはいない。 そこで頭に浮かんだのは常連の６人……。 彼らの誰かにお願いできないか……と考えた主人公は、彼らに声掛けをしようとするのだが――
row.notes: All characters are over 18 years old. Contains mild violence.

row.name: Shards of the library
row.detailed_description: Game Title: Shards of the Library Playtime: Approximately 1–2 hours (You can continue playing freely after finishing the main quests) 🧩 Gameplay Shards of the Library is a story-driven simulation and puzzle game with farming elements and mysterious events that unfold within a strange library. Players can: Explore a small open-world village with seasonal changes and a day/night cycle Complete 90+ quests involving farming, cooking, potion crafting, and toolmaking Interact with 40+ unique NPCs and engage in systems like music performance, painting, and writing Enter procedurally generated forests and caves Build relationships, discover secrets, and collect artifacts The game also features fishing, monster encounters, item crafting (70+), farming crops (15+ types), skill learning (50+), and more. Even after completing the main quests, players can continue enjoying daily farm life at their own pace. 📖 Game Story One day, the protagonist receives a letter from their grandfather, asking them to take care of his farm while he goes on an unexpected journey. After arriving and settling into a quiet rural life, the protagonist visits the town library—only to discover that something strange is happening through the books they borrow. In a world where ordinary life and mystery are intertwined, players will gradually uncover hidden truths. 🛠 Developer's Note This game is a solo-developed project created as part of a graduation portfolio, using skills learned from CSE360 and CSE412 courses. It was inspired by titles such as Stardew Valley , Mabinogi , and Princess Maker . All systems listed above are already implemented and playable. Future updates may include polish, bug fixes, and small expansions based on player feedback. We appreciate your understanding as development continues during Early Access. 🎥 Distribution & Streaming Notice If you share or stream this game, please include the game title or a Steam link in your video description. Unauthorized redistribution is not supported, and we are not responsible for any issues caused by it.
row.short_description: A simulation puzzle game where everyday life and mystery intertwine on a farm as you uncover secrets beyond the books.
row.notes: This game does not contain adult content. The characters are designed based on mannequins, and when the character is fully undressed, the mannequin texture is applied.

row.name: Biophobia
row.detailed_description: Biophobia is an experimental art game that intertwines dissection and gardening mechanics to explore themes of trauma, death and agency. The body becomes a site of decay and creation. You are invited to confront discomfort. Features: Unique Gameplay : Combines a visceral yet delicate dissection with nurturing gardening mechanics. Artistic Body Horror : Experience unsettling yet compassionate depictions of the human form. No gore, but hauntingly beautiful. Sandbox Creation: Choose from a variety of seeds. Shape your own floral expression. Experimental Aesthetic : A blend of surreal visuals and symbolic design, challenging traditional game conventions. Short, Impactful Experience: Designed to be completed in ~20 minutes. Cultural references Inspired by the character  Ophelia from Shakespeare’s Hamlet, Clemente Susini’s wax figure the Anatomical Venus , and Fuyuko Matsui’s painting  Keeping Up the Pureness , Biophobia reimagines historical depictions of women’s bodies through a modern feminist lens. Without text or dialogue, the game speaks through symbolic interaction, haunting visuals, and atmospheric sound. Biophobia is a game intended for players who appreciate experimental design, symbolic storytelling, and confronting mature themes in an artistic setting. Some audiences may find the content of this game unsettling. Viewer discretion is advised.
row.short_description: A woman is violated by a man. In a final act of rebellion to preserve her humanity, she takes control and opens her stomach. Unable to finish what she started she waits for you, and asks you not to look away.
row.notes: Biophobia explores themes of trauma, death, and the human body through a psychological horror lens. The game contains unsettling imagery, including depictions of corpses, dissection, body horror, and medical environments. Narrative elements touch on topics such as sexism, loss, and emotional distress. While there are no explicit depictions of sexual acts, the game does include references to gender-based violence and oppressive cultural views surrounding women's bodies. There are no portrayals of sexual assault, drug/alcohol abuse, or self-harm. However, players may encounter disturbing scenes related to death, vulnerability, and themes of control over the body. Player discretion is advised.

row.name: AS:RA Ashen Skies: Radiant Arena Playtest
Desktop Waifu
row.detailed_description: Congratulations!  After 20 long years, you've finally earned your very own Desktop Waifu. But she's missing something important — clothing!  Help her celebrate by making her clap through your clicks and typing skills. Each clap brings you closer to a new clothing piece or pet to collect for her.  Unlock them all and make your waifu truly happy!  Hourly Item Drop Chance Common - 91%  Uncommon - 7.499%  Rare - 1.4909%  Epic - 0.01%  Legendary - 0.0001%  Task Item Drop Chance Common - 87%  Uncommon - 10.9594%  Rare - 1.9904%  Epic - 0.05%  Legendary - 0.0002%
row.short_description: Congratulations!  After 20 long years, you've finally earned your very own Desktop Waifu. But she's missing something important — clothing!  Help her celebrate by making her clap through your clicks and typing skills. Each clap brings you closer to a new clothing piece or pet to collect for her.

row.name: RISE FROM RUIN
row.detailed_description: RISE FROM RUIN is a third-person, character-action game in which you take control of a massive, unstoppable monster, the BEAST. They aim to defend a vast, icy city from relentless, chaotic, hostile forces. The game offers bombastic gameplay and immense battles in which your sheer power is tested against ever-growing enemy forces.  Once a beacon of civilization, the city teeters on the brink of ruin as an overwhelming army of chaos crashes against its walls. Battle through the different sectors of this massive city. Learn the story of the city through the poems. This battle is not just for survival but a clash between order and chaos. Empowered by ancient forces, the BEAST wields fantastical abilities that reflect this duality, some channeling the controlled might of the city, while others embrace the raw, untamed destruction of the invading horde. As waves of enemies surge forward, the city’s fate rests on the BEAST’s ability to harness its immense power, to adapt and endure. RISE FROM RUIN delivers a power fantasy that places you at the center of this epic struggle. Do you have what it takes to defend civilization?
row.short_description: RISE FROM RUIN is a third-person, character-action game where you take control of a massive, unstoppable monster, the BEAST. Run, Jump, charge, smash, and destroy your way through he invading forces to defend the city. Are you strong enough to defend your city from the hordes?

row.name: 挂机三国-无限升级
row.detailed_description: Hello everyone, this is a card development competitive game that I developed independently A game with multiple heroes and equipments based on the Three Kingdoms theme, integrating elements of strategy, placement, leisure, cultivation, competition, etc. The battle mode is similar to that of auto chess, and unique skills are designed for each general and counselor. Equipment is classified by rarity using the classic gray, green, blue, purple, orange, and red colors, with red being the best and having the most attributes. Each general can be equipped with different types of soldiers, which have a restraining relationship with each other. Reasonable configuration will bring obvious benefits in battle. Carefully designed exclusive weapons for some generals and counselors (to obtain stronger skills and effects), such as Guan Yu's Green Dragon Crescent Blade, Zhang Fei's Zhangba Snake Spear, Cao Cao's Yitian Sword, etc. Tips: During the game, you will randomly meet some other players and defeat them to obtain resources. The color of generals and counselors only represents the strength of their skills and has nothing to do with numerical growth. Resting troops will provide combat bonuses based on their level star rating. Resources prioritize troops and equipment. Daily tasks must be completed. The [?] button in the game has corresponding instructions. If you encounter any questions you don't understand, please add my QQ 375776626 for consultation I have quit my job and am working on games at home full-time. It is inevitable that the games may have some shortcomings. I hope you will be tolerant and encourage me. If you like this game, please give more suggestions and opinions in the comment section, and I will organize and improve it.
row.short_description: Three Kingdoms card development auto chess lineup with battle mode.

row.name: FickleFlame
row.detailed_description: FICKLE FLAME We invite you to experience our immersive, story-driven Platformer about a candle trying to save it's candle world.  Play as the candle brother or candle sister. Explore, meet interesting characters, fight enemies. All to attempt to clear the candle world of the threatening fog and return it to its former happiness.   INTRODUCTORY BIOME This Game covers an introductory biome, in which the player becomes familiar with the moody Waxland. It is completely free and ment to receive the players feedback as well as their interest in a continuation of the full story of this game.   STORY SNIPPET (NON SPOILER) You find yourself in a world of living candles. Where life is simple. Old and young candles spend their day enlightening each others habitats. As it is a candles duty to bring light to its world, for as long and bright as it can! ... One day, however, a gray fog befell this happy candle world. The air became heavy and dusty. To survive in these conditions the candles started to burn their lifeforms away quicker when exposed to this unwelcome fog of death. ...   WHO IS DEVELOPING FICKLE FLAME? We are a group of Indie Game Developers from Poland and Germany. Currently consisting of 3 people, an Artist, Coder and Sound Designer.  SirPine  - the Artist. Introduced the project and re-awoken it from its slumber. He drives the project while creating unique and unpolished art that just has the right edge to it. In every of its creations.  Dezt  - the Coder. Plugging every asset and bit of gamelogic in its right spots. Happy to combine the precise world of code and creative world of art. Kuba  - the Sound Designer. Laying all creations into a melodic tune. He brings the final recipe to cook a masterpiece and immerse the player into the feel of the game. Developing in our free time and trying our best to deliver the immersive, moody and story driven Platformer that we aim for.  No publisher behind it. The Game will initially support the english, polish and german languages.
row.short_description: We invite you to experience our immersive, story-driven Platformer about a candle trying to save it's candle world.

row.name: Slap 'em UP!
row.detailed_description: Get in on the casual party card game where every hand is a chance to roast your friends! Slap them down with the higher cards, blast them with mocking stickers, or drop emotes they won’t forget. Dress to impress and make your way to the crown. Who’s the real king now? Easy rules, anyone can play, instant fun! A well-known classic card game, with simple rules you can understand in just a few minutes. Just play your cards at the right moment, and you could be the winner! Let loose with emojis & hilarious stickers! Mock your opponents with funny cutscenes during epic moments — whether it’s a win or a surprise comeback. Crush them with hilarious emojis or throw in a cheeky sticker to seal the deal! Play in various modes, either with random players or your group of friends. Enjoy both global matchmaking and private rooms for fun with up to 4 friends. Perfect for both serious players and those looking to chill with friends. Make it yours, make it epic. Customize cards, characters, and effects to create your own iconic look. Every match feels fresh when it's in your style.
row.short_description: Get in on the casual party card game where every hand is a chance to roast your friends! Slap them down with the higher cards, blast them with mocking stickers, or drop emotes they won’t forget. Dress to impress and make your way to the crown. Who’s the real king now?

row.name: War Grid Hero
row.detailed_description: War Grid Hero is a turn-based card battle game developed by an independent creator. In the game, players must deploy cards to occupy zones, earning points to defeat their opponents. The game features three main modes。 Online Mode Engage in battles against other players. Host a match or search for an online match as a guest. Currently, 1v1 battles and a basic mode are supported. Guide Mode Learn the game mechanics and familiarize yourself with card characteristics. Complete specific levels to unlock new cards. Levels will be updated with the release of new cards. Practice Mode Battle against AI opponents of varying difficulty to practice card combinations and strategies. You can also enter Free Deployment Mode to configure card arrays. Card Basics Occupy After deployment, the card will occupy neutral or enemy zones. Override Deploying on top of a friendly card will override it to reclaim the zone. Support Increases the points of cards within its influence range after deployment. Weaken Reduces the points of cards within its influence range after deployment. Input Support The game fully supports single-device input (keyboard, mouse, controller).
row.short_description: War Grid Hero is a turn-based card battle game developed by an independent creator. In the game, players must deploy cards to occupy zones, earning points to defeat their opponents.

row.name: Protocol Nadir
row.detailed_description: The Ones Above await You. They  are watching. FIND THEM! Make your way through the facility. Ascend through its abandoned corridors and uncover the chilling truth behind this hidden bunker. Explore procedurally generated rooms, each holding fragments of a forgotten story—items that may help you survive and secrets that whisper of a past buried in darkness. Face terrifying creatures driven to survive and Piece together the pieces of what was left by the ones before you. Explore this facility and avoid the creatures created here. Scavenge for items which may become your only hope. Unravel what awaits in the shadows. Multiple Endings to explore and find. Navigate unique rooms, each concealing its own unsettling mystery. Encounter multiple unique enemies. Make your way to the top.  Will you uncover the truth? Or will THEY uncover you first?'
row.short_description: A first person Horror game containing multiple enemies in a complex series of randomly generated rooms. Fight them and ascend to the truth. Find what awaited others before you. Uncover the mystery and explore the truth.

row.name: Felt Mansion
row.detailed_description: Felt Mansion is a 2D-fangame Adventure mainly focused on boss fights and exploration based on the Homestuck universe by Andrew Hussie. Explore a huge and mysterious mansion as the 4 Beta Kids, and fight your way through a gangster organization to save the young Handmaid from the clutches of the fearsome Doc Scratch. A world entirely based on the Homestuck universe, from the characters to the soundtracks A semi-real time battle system Bosses with their own original combat mechanics Five zones to explore forming a complex and intricate mansion Clocks (A lot...) Choose the character that best matches your style, unleash chain skills, harvest Soul Embers, upgrade your powers, and fight to survive until dawn! From swift assassins to elemental sorceresses—pick your perfect battle companion. Rich Skill Combos Unlock over 20 active and passive skills. Bullet storms, traps, area explosions… freely combine them to create your ultimate soul-reaping arsenal! Pixel Art Beauty Retro pixel graphics blended with detailed lighting effects. Explore misty forests, abandoned cities, and underwater ruins for a post-apocalyptic fantasy experience. Dynamic Upgrade System Collect Soul Embers during battle to enhance weapons and skills, unlock hidden characters and potentials, and push your limits against tougher challenges. row.name: SimShock2025
row.detailed_description: SimShock2025 is a shock simulation game. This is a game based on hemodynamic simulation of shock. It is based on real pathophysiology, but with numerous liberties to make it playable and fun. There are 3 disease modes: Hypertensive cardiogenic shock, Hemorrhagic shock and Distributive shock. They are initiated by pressing their respective buttons: Heart Failure, Hemorrhage, and Shock. There are 9 therapeutic buttons: Dopamine, Furosemide, Nitroglycerin,  Saline (0.9% saline solution), Amiodarone, Propranolol, Desfibrillator, Transfuse and Antibiotics The player can start the simulation by clicking on the Heart Failure, Hemorrhage, or Distributive Shock buttons. Then, using the therapeutic buttons, the goal is to stabilize and cure the patient. During gameplay, cardiac arrest events may occur, requiring immediate defibrillation. In cases of hemorrhage, transfusions are necessary to achieve recovery. In septic shock, you will need to prescribe the correct antibiotics to treat the infection. If you find it complicated, you can call the ICU, which, depending on the patient's age and bed availability, will take them away... or maybe not. There are several additional controls available: Turn the vital signs monitor on or off. Display a background image on the monitor (right-click on the vital signs monitor). Reset the game using the green button on the ECG and respiratory monitor. Switch between different doctors and mute the heartbeat sound by clicking on the doctor image. Adjust simulation speed with a slider available only on Macintosh. (This feature could not be programmed for Windows.) The game is available in both English and Spanish: You can switch languages manually by pressing the specific language button inside the game. The game was written in PureBasic on Apple Macintosh, and compiled for Mac and Windows. This game is signed and notarized by Apple, so it should open without any security warnings. The software is free.
row.short_description: SimShock2025 is a free, bilingual (EN/ES) hemodynamic shock simulator. Treat cardiogenic, hemorrhagic, and septic shock using real drugs and interventions. Written in PureBasic, available for Mac and Windows. Apple-signed and notarized.

row.name: BurnerSphere
row.detailed_description: Get ready to dive into the digital dust of BurnerSphere! Created by BRCvr in collaboration with Burning Man Project, this isn’t your typical VR experience—it's a fully immersive, interactive documentary that lets YOU explore Black Rock City and its vibrant communities from anywhere in the world! Team up with friends, discover iconic art installations, join interactive workshops, and connect with others in real-time. With stunning 360° and 180° videos, detailed virtual environments, and endless opportunities for spontaneous social interaction, BurnerSphere captures the spirit of Burning Man and inspires creativity and community year-round. Ready to burn bright? Let’s go! Set up account at our website and link that account with 6 digit code.
row.short_description: BurnerSphere is an immersive social VR experience where players explore VR documentary content filmed at Burning Man. Navigate iconic art installations, engage with interactive workshops, and connect with friends or meet new ones to go on adventures. Experience Burner Culture like never before!
row.notes: BurnerSphere is an app filled with art from Burning Man. As such, some of these art pieces may contain some mature content.

row.name: The Mountain And The Moron
row.detailed_description: The Mountain and The Moron is a 3D Rage Platformer about a Uncle who is down on his luck, and watches a podcast telling him to 'Climb a mountain to become Enlightened'. Located near the city of Uncleville, Mount Onkle, a previous attraction for the city. After years of neglect, the mountain's platforms are falling apart, making the mountain very dangerous. It has yet to claim a life, so don't be the first! You play as Uncle Dagobert, a local Uncle with no climbing experience. You will try and fail to reach the top of the mountain. You are 'assisted' by other strange characters who watch and record you trying to reach the top! --FEATURES -- 2 challenging levels Plenty of game modifiers that change up you experience in fun and unique ways Ragdolls! Secret codes that add fun Easter eggs to the game Difficult platforming in risky spots A built in timer! This game was made a student project :) -RasberryPi
row.short_description: The Mountain and The Moron is a 3D Rage Platformer about a Uncle who is down on his luck, and watches a podcast telling him to 'Climb a mountain to become Enlightened'.

row.name: 推理小说的关键一定会出现两次 Playtest
The Falling Star
row.detailed_description: The Falling Star is a short, atmospheric first-person narrative adventure set in a fragmented dreamscape. You play as a young girl, journeying through a surreal memory world shaped by grief, love, and unanswered questions. After your mother’s passing, you follow her final wish—to uncover the truth behind your missing Aunt Jiang, and in doing so, begin to understand the family stories left unspoken. A Short, Emotional Journey Designed to be completed in around 20–30 minutes , The Falling Star offers a focused, emotionally resonant experience. Perfect for players who enjoy introspective storytelling and atmospheric exploration. Explore a Dreamlike World Wander through beautifully crafted environments that blur the line between memory and imagination. From quiet bedrooms to abandoned factories and the remains of a once-bustling town, each area reflects pieces of the past waiting to be pieced together. Solve Environmental Puzzles Uncover clues hidden in the world—handwritten notes, old objects, and family relics. Light puzzle-solving is used to guide your journey and encourage thoughtful exploration. A Story Told Through Objects Instead of lengthy cutscenes, the narrative unfolds through environmental storytelling . Examine everyday items and listen to the protagonist’s inner thoughts as she reflects on her family’s history. A Meditative Soundscape Accompanied by original gentle music and ambient sound design, the experience invites players to slow down, feel, and remember. If you appreciate narrative-driven games like What Remains of Edith Finch , Gone Home , or To the Moon , The Falling Star offers a similarly heartfelt tale in a compact and accessible format. No combat. No time limits. Just you, your memories, and the stars. Chase the star, while you still can.
row.short_description: The Falling Star is a first-person exploration and narrative-driven walking simulator. Following the mother's last wish, the girl embarks on a journey in a dream to uncover the story of her missing aunt’s past.

row.name: Electoral Carnage
row.detailed_description: Electoral Carnage is a 2D fighting game featuring American Presidents. The game has an emphasis on comedy, movement, and easy to learn, hard to master gameplay. Blood, Guts, Supers From the historical, to the offensive, to the intentionally stupid, every fighter has been blessed with an absurd, balls to the walls super move that will have you and all your friends laughing. Since every super one-shots your opponent, Electoral Carnage is a game about getting your super and landing it first, leading to lightning fast gameplay and quick salty rematches. Movement Mania As lifelong fighting game fans, we've pulled inspiration from fighting games across genres to give each character unique and deeply expressive movement. Dash dance with Obama, air-assault with Teddy Roosevelt, and wavedash with JFK! The American (Fighting Game) Dream Our game has no combos. Instead, after landing a hit, you'll be thrust back into neutral, reemphasizing your movement and giving your one-shot supers even more impact. The unique gameplay loop allows for a fighting game that aims to bridge the gap between competitive and casual players; allowing the sweats to grind out stylish movement tech, but inevitably letting the noobs win a game or two with a lucky super.
row.short_description: Electoral Carnage is an absurd 2D fighting game featuring America's most famous (and infamous) politicians. If you don't download it you hate America. Also JFK can assassinate himself. What more do you need to know?
row.notes: Game contains depictions of pixelated gore, blood, and violence, such as heads exploding and bullets piercing through enemies in slow motion. JFK also a has a "suicide" self-assassination attack where he grabs the opponent and Lee Harvey Oswald shoots both of you.

It’s a choice-driven narrative with multiple endings, where your decisions truly affect the characters, determining who lives, who dies, and who you want to continue your life with. The game is inspired by adult visual novels and some of the best choice-based story games.

row.name: BRUV - Bold Retaliation of Ultimate Vengeance Playtest
Bloodquest From HELL
row.detailed_description: Underpaid and overworked—hell might be better than the burger joint. Bloodquest From Hell is a first-person exploration puzzle game set in a grotesque dimension of meat, fire, and minimum wage. Developed as a senior project at Ringling College of Art and Design’s Game Art department, the game blends surreal puzzles with an aesthetic inspired by 1980s horror and fantasy films. You play as a fry cook teetering on the edge of unemployment. When a mysterious portal opens behind the grill, your only shot at keeping your job is to step through—and get cooking. Key Features: First-Person Exploration: Navigate a grotesque otherworld filled with meat corridors, and strange denizens. Puzzle-Focused Gameplay: Solve bizarre environmental puzzles to gather infernal ingredients and unlock new areas of this nightmare. Interactive Narrative: Make deals and trade with the inhabitants of hell—some friendly, some… less so. Retro 1980s Aesthetic: Inspired by the visual flair of 1980s and cult classics. The portal's open, the fryer’s cold, and hell is hungry. Time to clock in.
row.short_description: Bloodquest From Hell is a first person exploration game made in Unreal Engine. You play as a humble fry cook, who must journey through a mysterious portal in order to keep your job.
publishers: Ringling College of Art and Design

row.name: Living Pipes
row.detailed_description: Hired to fix a building, paid too much to ask why. In Living Pipes , a first-person narrative mystery game created as a senior project at Ringling College of Art and Design, you are sent to a remote building under mysterious circumstances. What starts as a routine repair job quickly unravels into something far more unsettling. Explore, repair, and uncover the truth. Navigate dimly lit corridors and strange, decaying rooms using your scanning and repair tools to restore broken infrastructure—fix electrical systems, seal pipe leaks, and reconnect disrupted networks. But as your tasks progress, the environment becomes increasingly unnatural, and you're forced to question the real reason you're here. Key Features: First-Person Exploration : Immersive atmospheric environments powered by Unreal Engine 5. Narrative Mystery : Piece together the story through found documents, audio logs, and environmental storytelling. Puzzle Mechanics : Use diagnostic tools to identify faults and solve spatial and logic-based puzzles tied to the building’s systems. Unsettling Progression : As you dig deeper, the building—and whatever controls it—begins to resist your presence. Will you finish the job… or find out what really lives behind the walls?
row.short_description: A narrative-driven first-person puzzle game set in the dystopian future of 2080. Take on the role of a maintenance worker investigating strange malfunctions in a crumbling apartment building, where nothing is as it seems.
publishers: Ringling College of Art and Design

FEATURES Presented in Ultra-wide vision, creating an immersive cinematic experience Haunting atmosphere and soundscape Beautiful retro-inspired visuals Thrilling gameplay that throws you into the deep end No powers or weapons. Just a suitcase

row.name: Dreamlocked
row.detailed_description: Dreamlocked is a 3D psychological horror game where you and up to three others descend into surreal, procedurally generated dream layers filled with fear, puzzles, and unknown entities. Each session features randomized objectives, unpredictable monster behaviors, and unsettling environments that evolve as you progress. Features include: Procedurally generated levels with recurring and random threats Solo or 4-player online co-op gameplay Adaptive AI entities that stalk, hunt, and react dynamically Puzzle-solving and exploration Resource-based inventory and survival mechanics Your goal is to descend, administer the antidote, and escape alive if you can.
row.short_description: A psychological horror game that centers on exploration, puzzle-solving, and terrifying entity encounters

row.name: Decaying Memories
row.detailed_description: You are presented with 3 photos, if all three are the exact same move on and press the next button. If Any image has a discrepancy, meaning something is different about it compared to the others, press the burn button and burn it. This process is then repeated until the ingame clock has reached 6:00. You can't take too long however because you constantly have a meter that rises, if it fills completely you lose, but if you guess correctly when spotting the difference in the photos, your meter goes down. If you're having a hard time seeing something in a photo, the magnifying glass allows you to zoom in and out.
row.short_description: Spot the difference in the 3 given photos and survive for six minutes! Take too long to spot enough discrepancies and you lose to the fear meter!

row.name: Hack Back
row.detailed_description: Hack Back is a real-time strategy game that teaches offensive and defensive cybersecurity concepts through intuitive, hands-on gameplay. No textbooks, no terminals, and no prior experience required—just jump in and start hacking. As you command your team through an engaging campaign, you’ll infiltrate networks, deploy malware, defend infrastructure, and outsmart corporate adversaries in a battle for digital dominance. Learn by doing as you uncover the story of a rogue hacker who turns against the very megacorp they once served. Each mission introduces real-world cyber principles—like DDoS attacks, intrusion detection, and lateral movement—presented in a way that's approachable, fast-paced, and fun. Key Features: Simple Cybersecurity Learning : Grasp complex concepts through gameplay—no coding or tech skills required. RTS Meets Cyber Warfare : Generate resources, launch attacks, build defenses, and adapt in real-time. Story-Driven Campaign : Follow the journey of a hacker-turned-hero across 8 immersive missions. Unique Units & Abilities : Deploy hackers, engineers, and defenders—each with special powers. Multiplayer Skirmishes (future) : Test your skills against other players in head-to-head cyber battles. Pixel Art Visuals & UI : Enjoy the simple beauty of GameBoy era art. Whether you're a gamer curious about cybersecurity or a cyber pro looking for a relatable world, Hack Back offers a fresh, strategic spin on what it means to learn, play, and win.
row.short_description: Breach networks, plant malware, steal secrets, and outsmart digital defenses in a real-time strategy campaign that teaches cybersecurity through immersive, hands-on gameplay—no experience or skills needed!

row.name: Zerowake GATES
row.detailed_description: [ Characters ] Park Mujin/Esper 'What am I, your d*mn puppet? Sit when you say sit, go when you say go?' Alpha energy commands the room and you. Once he marks you, it’s game over: obsession begins Beast-like instincts, especially scent #ObsessiveTop #SizeDifference #DarkTop ------ Seong Yebin/Esper 'The military’s looking for a way to end the Creature crisis. I believe you’re the key.' Control freak Strategic brilliance Smiles when he's about to destroy you #BeautifulTop #SchemingTop #PshycoTop ------ Han Gaon/Guide “Even if it hurts me… I can’t just ignore someone suffering right in front of me.” Mature beyond his years Brilliant, but chooses silence over action Carries the exhaustion of someone who's seen too much #SmartUke #Reserved #NarrativeTwist [ STORY ] When I finally opened my eyes after seven years, something was straddling my body… moving against me. Han Gaon wakes with a shard of meteorite buried deep in his chest. The world he knew is long gone. Now, monstrous alien creatures called 'Creatures' fill the skies, the land, and his vision. Among the infected, only a rare few are born with the ability to suppress the creatures’ power and unleash supernatural strength. They’re called the Awakened. The battlefield belongs to the 'Espers'— men with power, driven by madness. And the only ones who can calm that storm… are the 'Guides'. Men who wield power. And men who know how to handle it. In a world where bonds are forged through submission, desire, protection, and obsession, survival depends on one thing— needing each other completely. ------ Meteorites fired by alien Creatures to invade Earth pierced the atmosphere and crashed across the globe. From the Gates opened by the impact, parasitic monsters poured out relentlessly. Due to the Creatures seeking Earth's life force, almost all of Korea has been devastated. The survivors scattered across the country, forming new survival orders through factions like the Awakened guilds New Tiger, Daybreak Dragon, and Taeul, military organizations such as the 710 Commando, the S.E.M.A Research Institute, and those who belong nowhere—the Wanderers. Why did I gain these powers…? The truth of this chaotic world lies hidden within the shard embedded in my chest! [ Game Description ] Draw cards at random to build your own deck and join the battle. Each Esper card is paired with a Guide card. When you include a connected couple in your deck, they unleash even greater power. In a battlefield where madness and pleasure collide, you must fight alien creatures and find the most effective pairings to survive. Between battles, a dangerous and provocative story unfolds— centered on the protagonist Han Gaon, and the tangled fates of Espers and Guides. Uncover the secret behind the meteor fragment in his chest and fight to save a world in ruins. [ Game Features ] Battle System & Survival Strategy Deploy Espers and Guides into battle for every fight Your choices determine each action—plan your attacks wisely Use couple synergy to form optimal strategies and survive to the end Deep Worldbuilding & Rich Story Enter a deadly universe of madness, obsession, pleasure, and longing Between battles, unlock the captivating story of Han Gaon and the Espers Take on story missions to uncover the alien invasion hidden within the fragments Diverse Characters & Strategic Deckbuilding Build your deck with random card draws Pair Esper and Guide cards to strengthen couple synergy Activate couple bonuses and special skills to claim victory in battle
row.short_description: Enter a battlefield where madness and desire collide. Pair Espers and Guides for powerful synergy, and join Han Gaon as he uncovers the meteor’s secret and fights to survive a world under alien invasion.

Players can experience endless growth and exciting progression as they defeat a variety of charming monsters and powerful bosses. Grow stronger even while idle! Embark on an enchanting journey accompanied by adorable monsters crafted with captivating 2D pixel art, and enjoy relaxed yet deeply satisfying gameplay. ✅ Easy Idle Gameplay & Boss System Your character continuously grows and battles automatically without requiring complex controls. Defeat waves of monsters to summon formidable field bosses, then conquer them to progress to higher stages filled with valuable resources and generous rewards! ✅ Collect and Enhance Diverse Equipment & Skills Gather various pieces of equipment and unique skills as you progress through stages. row.name: 漫游五千年
row.detailed_description: 《漫游五千年》是一款结合了策略塔防和放置元素的休闲游戏。玩家可以轻松体验资源管理的乐趣，同时享受策略布局的成就感。国风美术风格和丰富的福利系统，都是游戏的亮点所在。 游戏概述 《漫游五千年》融合了策略塔防与放置玩法，玩家可轻松管理资源，体验布局策略的乐趣。游戏以中国传统元素为美术风格，打造出国风浓郁的游戏世界。无论是喜欢策略游戏还是放置类游戏的玩家，都能在此找到乐趣。 核心特色 融合玩法 ：结合策略塔防和放置元素，玩家可在塔防关卡中布置武将抵御敌人，离线也能获得资源。 国风美术 ：游戏融入中国传统元素，为玩家呈现充满国风色彩的游戏世界。 丰富福利 ：登录送刘备、吕布等强力武将，闯关领1000抽豪礼，还有多种礼包和签到奖励。 关键功能 任务系统 ：包含日常、周常和主线任务，玩家可获丰厚奖励和宝箱。 特权卡系统 ：至尊月卡和臻享永久卡提供高返利和每日资源领取。 经天轮系统 ：玩家可招募英雄，有标准池、阵营池和友情池多种招募方式。 驿站系统 ：提供英雄遣散和重生功能，助玩家优化阵容。 军团系统 ：每日挑战BOSS，获取魂玉、星石、银币等资源。 文武庙 ：等级共享玩法，提升文武庙领袖等级增强全体英雄实力。
row.short_description: 《漫游五千年》是一款结合策略塔防与放置元素的休闲游戏，以三国为主题并融入中国传统元素。玩家主要通过招募和培养武将、建立塔防来抵御敌人入侵，同时管理资源以提升整体战力

row.name: DETRA
row.detailed_description: Vir and Druxy. Druxy and Vir. Vir would do anything for the woman that he loved. And Druxy knew that. Vir and Druxy go on an expedition to explore an abandoned laboratory, in search for a cure to treat a mystery illness that Druxy has come down with. It becomes Vir’s responsibility to explore the eerie floors of the building and complete his goal of saving the one that he loves. Little does he know, Druxy has another plan up her sleeve. FEATURES Compelling storytelling and characters: The story of DETRA spans four in-game days, with intriguing twists and turns. Stealth mechanics and difficulty: Switch between first-person and third-person cameras as you avoid glaring security cameras, explore the four different levels and complete your mission to save Druxy. Atmospheric graphics: Enjoy a dark 3D atmosphere and beautiful 2D graphics. CONTROLS The controls can be changed in the game, but these are the defaults. Movement: WASD Interact: E Run: Left Shift Sneak: Ctrl Camera Swap: G – Default FOV: 90 Default sens: 2
row.short_description: DETRA is a story-rich supernatural horror game where you follow the story of Vir and Druxy, a scientist couple who delve into an abandoned laboratory, in search of a cure for an illness that Druxy has got. Follow along as the trip ends up revealing more about their relationship than was intended.
row.notes: This game follows the guidelines of PEGI 16, showing depictions of non-graphic violence, cursing and mature themes.

row.name: The Fantastic Adventures of Mr. Don and Friends Playtest
Cards of Fortune
row.detailed_description: Cards of Fortune is a cooperative multiplayer game blending rogue-like , deckbuilding , bullet hell , and real-time strategy . Play as a cartomancer and venture into an ancient world filled with magicians, dragons, and forgotten deities. Room by room, you’ll face hordes of enemies or take part in unpredictable events. Each victory rewards you with a new spell card, strengthening your magical arsenal with more than 30 unique spells . Sharpen your tactics— mana and health management are key to survival. Every 10 rooms , a terrifying boss blocks your path. Fight alongside your allies all the way to the final battle against the divine forces of chaos . Designed for cooperation, Cards of Fortune offers high replayability thanks to the wide variety of enemies (40+), room configurations, and custom challenges. It’s perfect for fun and strategic gaming sessions with friends. ✦ Platforms : Windows, Linux ✦ Languages : French, English ✦ Cooperative Multiplayer ✦ Art direction inspired by Final Fantasy and Undertale
row.short_description: A co-op rogue-like where strategy and chaos meet ! Battle monsters and gods in a magical universe, upgrade your deck, and survive hellish rooms in this tactical multiplayer bullet hell.

row.name: Lo-Fi Golf
row.detailed_description: LoFi Golf is a chill, third-person, physics-based golf game set to relaxing LoFi music. Your goal is to complete five maps using the limited number of shots available. Choose your preferred difficulty level, explore atmospheric maps, and build your strategy to succeed! Improve your skills in Training Mode. Once you complete a map, progress to the next one. Enjoy highly interactive environments full of creative paths and surprises!
row.short_description: Chill out with a third-person, physics-based golf game set to relaxing LoFi music.  Explore dreamy, atmospheric maps with the freedom to find your own path. Will you risk a tricky shortcut or play it safe? Every shot counts, complete each course before running out of strokes!

row.name: Tails of the North
row.detailed_description: Tails of the North  is a third person story-focused adventure and exploration game. You're a young cat, a survivor from a cat colony ravaged by unstable forces of nature, and you've been given a task to find out what happened. After escaping your shattered home, you found yourself following a pair of ravens who carry the symbol of Hovialis on their feathers. Offering your help, you begin to uncover the truth to why the natural order is out of balance. Create your cat! Choose from plenty of fur colors, eye colors, and ear and tail shapes to give your cat an unique look, and follow the adventure of a main character [b]you[/b] want to see! Explore the world! Walk around the beautiful, northern landscape, scale the tall mountainside, or climb up an ancient tree to see everything  - the choice is yours! Meet quirky characters! Along with a buddy of your choosing, you can meet up to 6 unique characters all over the world! You can talk with them to get to know them better, and some may even have a quest for you. Talk to them at different moments of the story to read dialogue you might otherwise miss! Learn new skills! With the help of a mentor, you can learn to use your paws for more than just walking; you can break branches and stones! Clean up the temple site, and find mysteries hidden beneath the rubble.
row.short_description: Explore northern lands and it's inhabitants as a young cat. Begin unraveling the mystery of a spirit's disappearance.

row.name: Overgrown
row.detailed_description: In Overgrown, join up with a friend to explore a vibrant world overtaken by nature. A robot and a raccoon embark on a short adventure that they can only make it through together. Solve puzzles and navigate a post-human world to reveal a wordless story of disregard and abandonment. Key Features: Co-op - Two-player, local cooperative gameplay Puzzles - Use each character's unique abilities to solve puzzles Exploration - Discover lush environments while you travel into an abandoned city Meaningful Play - Consider the impact of play in a subtle cautionary tale about climate change
row.short_description: Grab a friend in this 2-player cooperative exploration and puzzle game where a robot and a raccoon explore a city overtaken by nature, revealing a wordless story of disregard and abandonment.
developers: Three Raccoons in a Trench Coat
publishers: Three Raccoons in a Trench Coat

row.name: CollabSession
row.detailed_description: I have a 3D model, but I don’t really know what to do with it... There’s a collab stream coming up, but if we’re just going to sit side-by-side in OBS, maybe Live2D is enough... But deep down, I really want to express more with 3D... Have you ever felt the same way? Still, doing a collab in VRChat seems like a hassle, and renting a studio—how much would that cost? Don't worry. The 3D collaboration streaming system 'CollabSession' has you covered! Using VMC, it supports facial expressions and full-body tracking—all with just a webcam! You can move freely around a virtual city, making it easy to collab from any location you like! Besides standard cameras, it also supports Spout cameras ! By installing the Spout plugin in OBS, you can capture high-quality video without showing the UI to your viewers! Supports up to 8 participants! Even with a large group, everyone can hang out in the same city! You can view the operation manual by clicking 'View the Manual' at the bottom right of the Steam store page. ━━ About Webcam Tracking ━━ ※Tracking uses a webcam that has been pre-configured on Windows. If a capture card or a video device that does not show your upper body is set, tracking will not function properly. ※Linking a Pixiv account is required to use this software. ※If you want to use your own avatar, you need to register your model on VroidHub. Some fully custom VRM models are not supported when using webcam-based tracking. This follows the naming conventions of VRM models created with Vroid Studio. Meshes corresponding to the face should be named 'face', 'head', 'body', or '顔'. The Blendshape for closing the left eye must include 'eye' in its name and end with 'L' or 'l'. The Blendshape for closing the right eye must include 'eye' in its name and end with 'R' or 'r'. The Blendshape for opening the mouth must end with 'mth_a'. ※Screenshots 1-4 depict character models which are not included with the base game.   These models are downloaded from 3rd party websites.
row.short_description: I have a 3D model, but I don’t really know how to make the most of it… There’s a collab stream coming up, but if we’re just going to be side-by-side in OBS, maybe Live2D is good enough… Have you ever felt the same way? The 3D collaboration streaming system 'CollabSession' has you covered!
