row.name: Tradie Tapper
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Tradie Tapper The Aussie-built idle game where you tap, hire, and rebirth your way to tradie stardom. Start from a bare dirt lot and build your empire one job site at a time. Hire sparkies, plumbers, roofers and more, each tradie adding to your passive income machine. Upgrade their gear, smash milestones, and take on brutally scaled rebirth contracts as you climb the ranks. Whether you're smashing tinnies or topping leaderboards, one thing’s for sure: the grind never stops. Features Tap to earn coins and upgrade your tradie crew Hire Electricians, Builders, Apprentices, and more 20+ unique backgrounds from trailer parks to disaster zones Rebirth system with randomized mutators and scaling challenge Skill tree integration for long-term progression Steam leaderboards and achievement tracking Offline support with anti-cheat protections Built with pixel charm, Aussie humour, and a relentless pace Aussie-made. Meme-fueled. Built for the grind. Join us in Early Access and help shape the future of Tradie Tapper, one contract at a time.
row.short_description: Tap, hire, and rebirth your way to tradie stardom in this Aussie-made idle clicker. Build job sites, collect gear, unlock skill trees, and climb the monthly leaderboards. Whether you're laying bricks or chasing ranks, the grind never stops.

row.name: Unity to survive
row.detailed_description: 'Unity to Survive' is a third-person co-op shooter where up to 4 players team up to survive relentless waves of monsters. Fight through ever-intensifying stages, upgrade your weapons and abilities, and take down massive bosses with teamwork and strategy. Customize your loadout and develop your own survival style in an action-packed battlefield. ✔️ Online 4-player co-op ✔️ Endless monster waves and dynamic stages ✔️ Real-time upgrade and reward system ✔️ Intense boss battles
row.short_description: A 3rd-person co-op survival shooter for up to 4 players. Fight off endless waves of monsters, upgrade your gear, and defeat giant bosses through teamwork and fast-paced action.

row.name: 千军纵横-专服版
row.detailed_description: 《千军纵横》游戏概述 《千军纵横》是一款以仙魔大战后的三国世界为背景的MMORPG游戏。玩家将扮演纵横大陆的冒险者，与三国名将并肩作战，体验策略养成、战斗挑战、社交协作等多元玩法。游戏通过丰富的系统设计（如合成、四象、官职、帮派）和深度付费引导机制，为玩家提供沉浸式的成长体验。 核心玩法与系统介绍 1. 游戏背景 世界设定：仙魔大战后，神器和圣地散落人间，三国英雄崛起，玩家需在万域城开启征程，争夺资源、提升实力，成为大陆的霸主。 特色融合：三国历史与仙魔幻想结合，剧情中融入神兵、法相等奇幻元素。 2. 关键系统 ① 攻略系统 功能入口 ：战力右侧显眼位置，开服7天后关闭，并入日常活动。 核心内容 ： 分类攻略 ：土豪、小资、平民、神豪玩家专属策略，提供充值引导和资源分配建议。 奖励机制 ：根据攻略完成度领取道具（如吸血武器“方天画戟”），优化付费玩家体验。 界面设计 ：分页签展示“霸服指南”“神兵利器”等模块，支持文本跳转和滚动查看。 ② 合成系统 入口位置 ：主界面右下方功能区域。 核心功能 ： 装备合成：低级装备+材料→高级战装、生肖装备。 神装/法相合成：专属界面合成神武帝装、供奉法相等顶级装备。 ③ 四象系统 入口位置 ：主界面右下方功能区域。 核心玩法 ： 朱雀/玄武装备 ：集齐七宿激活共鸣技能（如朱雀之主施加“离火”状态，玄武提升防御）。 符文强化 ：装配符文解锁闪避、免伤等特殊属性。 ④ 官职系统 入口位置 ：主界面右下方功能区域。 核心机制 ： 完成官职任务→积累政绩→晋升官阶→领取称号与俸禄。 前期优先推荐，助力快速成长。 ⑤ 帮派系统 入口位置 ：主界面右下方功能区域。 核心功能 ： 创建/加入帮派，参与捐献、建设、挑战（如获取四象圣装）。 帮派技能升级、仓库共享，强化社交协作。 ⑥ 打金宝库 入口位置 ：主界面右上方活动区域。 核心玩法 ： 野外地图挑战各等级BOSS，击杀后领取元宝、装备等奖励。 与任务系统联动，提升资源获取效率。 ⑦ 日常活动 入口位置 ：主界面右上方活动区域。 核心活动 ： 限时玩法 ：世界BOSS、跨服阵营战、双倍护送（元宝奖励）。 副本挑战 ：九重试炼（爬塔）、四象秘境（材料获取）。 日历整合 ：活动时间表清晰展示，避免错过高收益玩法。 游戏特色总结 策略付费引导 ：分阶攻略精准适配玩家消费层级，优化付费体验。 深度养成体系 ：合成、四象、官职等多系统交叉，提供长期成长目标。 社交协作 ：帮派挑战、仓库共享增强玩家互动。 高自由度战斗 ：打金宝库、日常活动满足不同战斗偏好（PVE/PVP）。
row.short_description: 在三国与仙魔交织的战场上，用策略养成征服大陆，用神兵利器书写你的传奇！
row.notes: 含有部分性成熟内容

row.name: Sporeborne
row.detailed_description: SporeBorne is a top-down, action hack-and-slash game where you play as an estranged mutation of a fungus infesting the planet H311. Embark on a journey, slashing through your enemies, growing more powerful, and uncovering abilities as you traverse this planet's infested land. Action- packed slashing! In SporeBorne, you jump in to explore the infested land of planet H311 in our new top-down, action hack-and-slash game! Slash your way through foes and discover new abilities to downright ANNIHILATE  them! Experience the riveting and enchanting world of H311 via It's stunning visuals accompanied By an unnerving and wild atmosphere. Our goal is to give you a challenging but fun gaming experience paired with a visual style and world that immerses you into its depths. 5 Different Abilities! 2 Different Enemies Large Play Area! Lots of fun!
row.short_description: SporeBorne is a top-down, action hack-and-slash game where you play as an estranged mutation of a fungus infesting the planet H311. Embark on a journey, slashing through your enemies, growing more powerful, and uncovering abilities as you traverse this planet's infested land.

row.name: MoonLight
row.detailed_description: Play as Moon, little girl waking up in a nightmare, scary shadows surrounding you. With the help of an talking ball of light, you must solve puzzles to get rid of nightmares. KEY FEATURES Light it up! Your flashlight is you best friend. No really - you literally have a friend in there. 'Light' makes your flashlight like no other, making it able to banish shadows, activate objects and collect star shards. Solve puzzles to move forward Use your flashlight and objects around you to find a way through Moons dream. Push and carry objects in correct places, in correct order, and find different ways to use your light. A dreamlike world, starlight as your guide Find light in the darkest corners of childhood bedroom, twisted with imagination and fear. Immerse yourself in Moons dream through nostalgia, atmospheric audio and beautiful, handcrafted visuals.
row.short_description: Remember the feeling of being frozen of fear under your blanket, in your childhood bed, being absolutely sure there’s monster under the bed? In MoonLight you get to face your childhood fears, getting rid of shadows through an atmospheric dream world filled with puzzles and wonder.
developers: Please go to Sleep, This is not Healthy Entertainment

row.name: Subspace Reticulum
row.detailed_description: Subspace Reticulum is a work-in-progress, proof-of-concept research project that channels the chaotic 2D spaceship combat of Subspace Continuum into an offline, AI-driven experience. Born from a deep love for the classic multiplayer mayhem, this preview offers a bold glimpse into a much larger vision—an alternative Subspace universe powered by revolutionary AI. This project attempts to immortalize the feeling  Continuum  once provided, in a timeless experience, always available without the need for servers or an internet connection. Blast through a handcrafted map that pays homage to iconic Subspace base warfare, with every chokepoint, corridor, and open stretch built for heart-pounding dogfights. Enhanced with vibrant particle effects, this nostalgic yet modern battlefield sets the stage for intense, tactical deathmatches that test your reflexes and cunning. As a research project, Subspace Reticulum is an effort to push the boundaries of AI in gaming. Its Transformer based neural network drives NPCs that don’t just fight—they adapt, strategize, and behave with an almost human flair. These dynamic opponents create unpredictable, replayable encounters, making every match feel fresh and alive. This is just the beginning, a teaser of a grander experience yet to come. Whether you’re a Subspace veteran with a nostalgic craving, or a newcomer hungry for innovation, Subspace Reticulum invites you to dive into this early preview. Strap in, take the helm, and experience the future of AI-driven combat—a thrilling taste of a galaxy-spanning adventure still in the making! The current preview is just the start, and I’m hard at work expanding this proof-of-concept into a richer, more dynamic experience. Here’s a sneak peek at what’s on the horizon: • New Ship Types: Get ready to pilot a variety of ships, each with unique handling characteristics. From nimble speedsters to heavy-hitting tanks, these additions will deepen combat strategies and let you find your perfect ✓(Added in 1.0.7)  1v1 Duel Mode: Face off against a single, cunning AI opponent in a compact, high-stakes arena designed for intense, skill-driven showdowns. Perfect for honing your reflexes and outsmarting the transformer-powered AI. • 2v2 Team Battle Mode: Team up with an AI ally to take on an opposing duo in a dedicated medium-sized arena. This mode will introduce cooperative tactics and fast-paced team-based combat, pushing the AI’s strategic depth to new heights. • Expanded Maps: More handcrafted maps are in development for the core deathmatch mode, offering fresh layouts with varied chokepoints, open zones, and tactical opportunities to keep every battle exciting and unpredictable. • New UI and Menu: An overhaul to the visual experience of the game is in the works to accommodate the upcoming game modes and settings. Stay tuned as I continue to evolve Subspace Reticulum, building toward the ultimate AI-driven Subspace experience! Controls: Left / Right : Control Rotation Up / Down : Control Thrust Spacebar : Shoot bullets E : Fire Bomb F : Thrust Boosters Esc : Toggle Menu Q (From Menu) : Quit
row.short_description: Blow up bots beyond the stars. AI Driven 2D Spaceship Warfare

row.name: Prima Materia XXV
row.detailed_description: A local multiplayer brawler from the streets of Prague Prima Materia is an experimental 3D fighting game created as part of the Fashion Week 2025 Tobias Equipment showcase. A stylistically uncompromising brawler with a unique aesthetic — reminiscent of classic fighters like Mortal Kombat , but reimagined through the lens of fashion and alchemy. The game features characters based on real icons of the Czech rap and fashion scenes, captured through 3D scanning and transformed into avatars of chaos within a dark fantasy version of Prague. Each fighter is a vessel of destruction — and a victim of it. ⸻ ✦ LEGENDARY LORE According to legend, a secret group of alchemists once operated beneath the cobbled streets of Prague. They uncovered the mystery of Prima Materia — the primal chaotic substance from which all matter is born. Realizing its immense power, the alchemists split the substance into several relics, each containing a fragment of chaos. These relics held transformative powers — from reshaping bodies to defying death — and ultimately ignited a war. Now, the streets of Prague have become blood-soaked arenas, where the fight for power, identity, and survival continues. ⸻ ✦ GAME FEATURES • Local multiplayer for 2 players • Fast and brutal combat in the spirit of classic fighters • Real-time 3D scans of real-life personalities • Stylized environments inspired by gothic Prague ⸻ Chaos is the cause… and the consequence. Enter the arena. And restore the order.
row.short_description: Stylizovaná lokální mlátička z temné fantasy Prahy. Prima Materia propojuje surové souboje s alchymií, chaosem a módou. Zahraj si za 3D nasnímané ikony české rapové a fashion scény.
row.notes: This game contains stylized violence and strong language in Czech. It is not recommended for players under the age of 18.

row.name: Parallel
row.detailed_description: PARALLEL Parallel is a linear survival horror game developed by a group of Algonquin Students. The game has a strong emphasis on stealth and evasion. Intended for fans of Sci-fi and Horror, Parallel will take advantage of Unreal Engine 5 to create an immersive experience that will get your heart pumping. STORY You are an engineer responding to a fellow corporate space station distress signal. Once you land, you are immediately familiar with how dire the situation truly is. Explore deeper into the station discovering the remains of its crew and the experiments that led to their untimely demise. Can you contain the experiments gone wrong or will you succumb to the same fate as your fallen comrades? GAMEPLAY As you explore the station, you discover a machine that aids you change the fabric of reality. Using this newfound power, you continue to explore the station, phasing through materials and bypassing obstacles throughout the station. While exploring the space station, you will encounter varied and numerous encounters with the monsters that roam the halls and malfunctioning security defences that view you as a target. Along the way, you will find other inventions left by the crew that can be used to distract the monster or even interfere with both the creatures and the security system.  The monster's keen hearing and poor eyesight leave opportunities to exploit its blind spots, just don't get caught in the crossfire. Using everyday objects found throughout the room you crawl through, you can use its greatest strength against it. FEATURES With a plethora of accessibility settings, the game is playable by a wide variety of players. Colorblind modes, independent audio controllers, different methods to play the game, and forgiving save allow for a tailor-made experience for every gamer out there. FUTURE The game is actively being developed with plans to release a VR port soon, all feedback to help mould the game into something we will all be proud of is always appreciated.
row.short_description: Parallel is a stealth-based survival horror sci-fi game where you must unravel the mysteries of what happened on a local space station. Can discover the experiments that took place here and live to tell the tale?
row.notes: Contains horror elements, jumpscares, and depictions of the dead throughout the level.

row.name: Mantle
row.detailed_description: Mantle is a 2D first-person narrative superhero simulation game with turn-based puzzle-like combat. Face off against a wide host of heroes and villains! Witness headlines in the news that respond to your actions as a superhero robot in a proud and egotistical world . Behold, as the pressure and expectations of being a hero... Can lead to a place no one ever expected .          Minigames that dictate the power of your high-tech gadgetry and skills to defend yourself Careful decision-making in turn-based strategy combat – Kill , or Capture ? Mercy , or Safety ? Interact with a desktop to drive the game’s story through news outlets and emails Colorful, interactable comic-book sequences Hybric Energy, a source of energy whose origin is unknown to the masses. Its incredibly versatility has led to the rapid development and prosperity of the city, Amourtia. A proud city that celebrates its heroes and sneers at its villains. That is not to say that Amourtia lives “above the clouds.” Every day, there are those who seek to prove themselves as one of the great. It is a city of dreams and ego. Opportunities can come from anywhere for those with ambition. But sometimes, the pressure of always winning can be too much. Become the Superhero Robot As Mantle, you control all the machinery. You decide the best course of action, and you manipulate your gadgetry to achieve the desired outcome. Experience a plethora of minigame-challenges through various gadgets that rely on your skill in order to do what needs to be done. Are you up to the task? Experience the Hero's Dilemma: Where do you stand?
row.short_description: Alert! It’s time to rise to the occasion. Every nut and bolt is fitted. Every high-tech gadget is primed. Step forth, Mantle, and become the greatest superhero robot ever…hopefully. Face off against good and evil and discover who the true villain of your story is.

row.name: Ye Guild Clerk!
row.detailed_description: Ye Guild Clerk! is a short 2.5D, interactive narrative game, where you play as a newly hired guild clerk in a world full of cute animal adventurers! Perfect for players who love character-driven stories, cute animals, and cozy medieval fantasy worlds. Features Meet a cast of cute animal adventurers, each with their own stories and quirks! Have 5 days to prove you're a good fit for the role! .. or suffer the consequences and get fired... As a guild clerk, you'll hand out quests, rewards and equipment!...  But be wary: Your choices matter , each action you take shapes the outcomes and stories for each adventurer you run into... for better or for worse! Over 40+ individual endings between all of the adventurers you can meet! Decorate your clerk booth with various customizations and decorations!  Select from 3 different music tracks to listen to! Controls: Point & Click Controls - Drag, Select, & Camera Movement WASD/Arrow Keys - Camera Movement Click/Space - Continue Dialogue ESC - Pause/Settings Menu Please Note: There is no current way to save your progress . It is highly recommended to play in one sitting. The average playthrough can take from 35 - 50 minutes.
row.short_description: The local Adventurer's Guild is hiring!... Not for adventurers, but for guild clerks! You play an important role in handing out quests, gold, and equipment as your actions shape the stories of these animal adventurers for better, or for worse..!

row.name: Mycroft Holmes Simulator
row.detailed_description: Become Sherlock Holmes' more intelligent, more languorous older brother in this (very) short point and click experience from the world of 'The Beekeeper's Picnic'* FEATURES OF MYCROFT HOLMES SIMULATOR: EXPLORE the famous Diogenes Club WALK at a very leisurely pace! BE QUIET and refuse to talk to a wide range of delightful characters! OBSERVE things, without having to act on them! MYSTERIES! There aren't any! Contains an entire ten minutes of gameplay.  (*A longer, fully voice acted and critically acclaimed point and click game available now on Steam! See, Mycroft is always in his brother's shadow...)
row.short_description: Become Sherlock Holmes' more intelligent, more languorous older brother in this short point and click experience from the world of 'The Beekeeper's Picnic'.

row.name: Sky Die
row.detailed_description: Sky Die is a 2D brawl that drops two-to-four players from tall heights, quickly approaching the bottom. Will you be the first to reach the finish line? Or will you succumb to traps scattered around the skies? There are three different stages to choose from: Factory: Saw blades and pistons decorate this mechanical arena. Dodge them all and try not to get squished! Ocean: Plunge into the depths of the ocean where schools of fish call home. Look out, though! They’re not here to make (more) friends. Jungle: This green landscape is home to various traps, including viscous monkeys. Did you steal their bananas or something? Each “sky-dier” is equipped with a unique ability to secure their spot in the skies. Here’s your lineup: Robot: This mecha menace can project a force field that blocks the next hit taken. Nothing gets past this machine. Diver: The diver is no stranger to the seas. During one of their travels, they found a pet! The diver can launch an opponent-seeking squid that disables the opponent’s abilities. Explorer: The explorer and his bird are inseparable. This character can transform into a nimble bird to traverse around traps with ease. Lizard: This lizard isn’t any ordinary lizard, but instead one of the lightning variety. The lizard sends out a bolt of lightning that can briefly stun opponents. On top of their abilities, each character has a dash that can be charged and released to quickly escape peril… or send your friends towards it! Powerups can also be found in these dangerous skies: Slow Down: Opponents’ move speed becomes slower for a short period of time. Switcheroo: Opponents disappear and reappear in randomly swapped positions. Shocked: Opponents cannot use any actions for a short period of time. Safe Zones: Safe zones appear that opponents must remain in until they expire. If they are too late, they will become stunned. Well, what are you waiting for? Grab your controller, invite your friends, and be the last one falling!
row.short_description: Sky Die is a 2D brawl that drops two-to-four players from tall heights, quickly approaching the bottom. Will you be the first to reach the finish line? Or will you succumb to traps scattered around the skies?

row.name: Terrors to Unveil - Intrusion
row.detailed_description: Terrors to Unveil is a series-based psychological horror game that immerses players in disturbing stories, each one unraveling the terrifying stories of those who lived to tell their experiences. This is the first episode in the series: Episode 1:  Terrors to Unveil - Intrusion David Hopster, a 15-year-old high school student, has just been left home alone for the weekend while his parents head out of town. At first, everything seemed normal. He spent the day enjoying his freedom. But by nightfall, strange things started happening. The Gameplay This game is primarily a first-person narrative walking simulator with exploration, and conversation mechanics. Key Features Atmospheric environment and photo-realistic graphics. 2 Endings VHS film aesthetic. Interact with NPCs. Player voice activity.
row.short_description: David Hopster, a 15-year-old high school student, has just been left home alone for the weekend while his parents head out of town. At first, everything seemed normal. He had no idea how quickly things would spiral.

row.name: Bound in Time
row.detailed_description: Controller Needed Player 1 can use a Mouse and Keyboard but player 2 must use a controller to be able to play. Player 2 can only control menus when they're selecting Hexes or Upgrading About the Game Bound in Time is a two player, co-op horde shooter with a sci-fi, futuristic twist – play as two flashy heroes with a number of abilities, a cyborg and a samurai, working together to defend worlds across space and time from invasions of creatures and monsters. As levels are explored and cleared, upgrade each character’s abilities in order to take on harder enemies and bosses! Join together in a local coop where one of you will play as Lux the high fire power cyborg and Hikari the highly mobile Samurai. You will have a number of cooperative actions to help you through such as medkits to heal each other, revive the other in their time of need and use your abilities to kill and stun enemies when your partner needs it. Take on hordes of creatures which different features such as spitting acid and holding the player down. 3 levels to complete, take on waves of the horde in the old ruins, fight through a burning village on the fire plant and make it to the castle to take on Egon the evil Knight and save time from falling under his control.
row.short_description: A two player, co-op horde shooter with a sci-fi, futuristic twist – play as two heroes, a cyborg and a samurai, working together to defend worlds across space and time from invasions of creatures. As levels are explored, upgrade each character’s abilities in order to take on enemies and a boss!

row.name: Samurai's path
row.detailed_description: You’ve just arrived in town. The soft spring air lifts the cherry blossoms around you, and for the first time in a long while, you feel you’re fighting for something honorable. As you step inside your temple, it’s time to train and prepare for what lies ahead. Samurai’s Path is an experimental game that evolves alongside its community. Your journey begins with the following: Train with Mini-Games Every few hours, you’ll receive new missions. Embark on small training challenges and earn a Katana Box for each successful completion. Grow Your Katana Collection Discover Katanas inside boxes and expand your collection: from Common and Rare to Epic and Legendary blades. All Katanas can be traded and collected through the Steam Market . First set of Seasonal Katanas F our honoring Amaterasu , and four dedicated to Susanoo, will not be dropping after the season two releases. Only available as drop in Limited Boxes Amaterasu and Susanoo In the ancient tales, Amaterasu , the radiant goddess of the sun, embodies honor, clarity, and creation, her light guiding every true samurai’s path. Susanoo , her tempestuous brother, commands storms and chaos, testing the strength of all who seek mastery. Their eternal balance between order and fury shapes the soul of every blade forged in Samurai’s Path , whether it shines with divine grace or strikes with untamed power. Special Katana Boxes Vanilla Box The original boxes of Samurai’s Path . Contain Katanas following standard drop rates. Common Katana 70% Rare Katana 27% Epic Katana 3% Limited Box Available only during the first weeks after launch. This limited-edition box offers a higher chance of Epic Katanas and a slight chance to obtain one of the eight Legendary.  Common Katana 27% Rare Katana 60% Epic Katana 10% Legendary Katana (Amaterasu or Susanoo collection) 3% Forge More Katanas Combine three Katanas to forge a new Katana Box. Using rarer Katanas increases your odds of receiving a Limited Box . Limited Box: +5% for each common Katana used +10% for each rare Katana used Vanilla Box: The remaining percentage is related to this box. Example: Forging by using tone common katana (+5%) and two rare katanas (+10% X2). Total rate: 75% Vanilla Box and 25% Limited Box Letter System From time to time, you’ll receive letters from your family or townsfolk. These messages reveal hints of future content and allow you to accumulate wealth and resources for the next stage in the evolution of the game. Founder’s Quest Available only until the next major update , the Founder’s Quest rewards Seals for each completed mission. Obtain the Expanded Book to unlock access to a unique Legendary Katana that hides true power (which will never drop again in the game) and gain exclusive perks. What’s Next Samurai’s Path will continue to evolve with the guidance of its community. Here’s a glimpse of what’s coming in Season 2 : New Legendary Katanas A revamped Letter System featuring hidden easter eggs that unlock limited-edition Legendary blades. The Merchant : Buy Katanas that refresh daily and sell your own for fluctuating coin values. The Gambling House : Test your luck in games of cards, dice, and bluffing while waiting for your next mission. These updates mark the next step in the evolution of Samurai’s Path , introducing character progression and customization that will shape your destiny as a true warrior.
row.short_description: Idle gacha collection game set in a dojo. Train through skill-based minigames, collect and fuse hundreds of unique blades tradeable on the market. Follow your own path and become a Samurai.

row.name: Phase Cross
row.detailed_description: Listen up Herd Nerds! Phase Cross is a fan-made nonogram puzzle game centering around Iori Hakushika, a talent from Phase Connect Origins. Complete nonogram puzzles to unlock (badly) hand-made pixel art images referencing Iori's work and community memes. Chill out and play some nonograms with this casual puzzle title centered around your favorite talent! The game includes: 30 nonogram puzzles in sizes 5x5, 10x10, and 15x15! Original artwork accompanying each puzzle, with descriptions in both English and Japanese! Relive classic moments from Iori Hakushika's past streams! Original (AI-generated) music with tags like melancholic, energetic, and.. barbershop quartet?? Estimated playtime is around 45 minutes to one hour. Excellent value for a free game! Note: This game does not include a detailed tutorial on how to solve nonogram/picross puzzles. If you are not familiar with nonogram puzzles, it is highly recommended to learn how to solve these puzzles before playing the game. This game was not created by Phase Connect Corp, nor is it associated in any way with Phase Connect Corp, Staff, etc. This is purely a fan work
row.short_description: A fan-made nonogram/picross puzzle game centering around Phase Connect: Origins talent Iori Hakushika. Solve nonogram puzzles and enjoy a relaxed ambiance!

row.name: OiiAi Cat
row.detailed_description: OiiAi Cat is a free, fun, and meme-fueled virtual desktop pet that brings chaos and charm to your everyday typing! Whether you're working, studying, or just smashing your keyboard for fun, OiiAi Cat reacts in real-time — spinning wildly, making its iconic 'OiiAi' sounds, and counting every word you type. This is more than a meme — it's a quirky productivity companion with unlockables, achievements, and ridiculous visual flair (coming soon). --------------------------------------------- ✨ Key Features Real-Time Typing Reaction The cat spins whenever you type. Stop typing? It stops spinning. Simple, satisfying, and hilarious. Meme Sound Madness Enjoy the chaotic 'OiiAi' meme audio that plays while typing — you can even unlock alternate sound packs. Typing Word Counter Tracks how many words you’ve typed while the cat is active. Think of it as your productivity (or chaos) score. --------------------------------------------- Whether you want to boost your productivity with a fun twist or just watch a cat spin out of control while yelling “OiiAi!”, this virtual desktop companion is the purr-fect sidekick. And yes — it’s totally free. --------------------------------------------- Get ready to type. Get ready to spin. Get ready for OiiAi Cat . Follow Ethel the oiia cat on Instagram: @oiiacat_ethel
row.short_description: A chaotic virtual desktop cat that spins when you type, screams 'OiiAi,' tracks your word count, and rewards your keyboard fury with meme-powered madness.

row.name: Thank You for Your Time
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the definitive surreal audition purgatory experience! The outside world is a cold, harsh place. That's why you came here. The cavern provides you with a minimum of shelter and  - more importantly -  the hope that you will one day be chosen to receive a place by the enormous fire hidden away in the dark depths below . To be chosen, you will have to impress the inscrutable hooded figures that rule this place, but that is much easier said than done. Nobody has ever seen the Hoods react to an audition before - positively or negatively, or at all, and their Shadow servants never give anything away either. And yet, there's always a chance . So long as you can outwait your competition . Thank You for Your Time  is a visual novella that I made with Ren’Py as a solo dev. It’s a surreal parable where  you make choices as a violinist stuck in an audition purgatory and ultimately answer a difficult question​: how long will you wait for your once-in-a-lifetime opportunity?  The player will have to decide the answer that's right for themselves. I hope this game will be cathartic for anyone who has had to go for an audition or a job interview, or who has just felt stuck - so, most people.  Play duration is about 40 minutes to an hour. The game features a final choice that leads to two different endings, as well as a few smaller choices along the way that also impact the story. All of the images in this game are AI generated. The story and narrative design are my own. This is a passion project that cost me nothing to create. It should cost you nothing to play. That said - the best ways to support me are to share this game with someone who might like it or to review it!  I want to grow as a game designer and storyteller, so it would be invaluable to know what worked for you and what didn't. Created by Alex Laney with Ren'Py  Game Tester / Best Girl: Lena Böse
row.short_description: In a surreal audition purgatory, how long will you wait to be chosen?
row.reviews: “compelling and atmospheric... I was absorbed throughout.” Rose Behar, Narrative News

row.name: AcroChallenge
row.detailed_description: AcroChallenge is a simple, yet fun and creative word game where you compete against others to make the best phrase that fits a 3 to 7 letter acronym (ie. 'ABCG') generated by the server.  Race against the clock to create the best phrase (ie. 'Already Been Chewed Gum').  Impress your friends with your wit and intellect, or just entertain them with stupid and funny phrases. You choose how to play - against bots, with Stream friends or make new friends.  If you want simple - one click will get you into a random game.  Or you can create your own game - play against just bots or with only Steam friends (coming soon).  Make it more challenging by including per-round 'Topics' that can be set by the server, game winner, or game creator.  Once in a game you can chat with other players as well.  But don't worry, you can 'mute' them if you don't like what they have to say.
row.short_description: AcroChallenge is a fun and creative word game where you compete against others to make the best phrase that fits a 3 to 7 letter acronym generated by the server.  Race against the clock to create the best phrase.

row.name: All Aboard! The Twilight Train
row.detailed_description: It’s Not Easy to Stay on Track All Aboard! The Twilight Train is a 10-15 minute (give or take a few dozen hours of watching Steamboat Willie on loop) adventure game that takes place on an interdimensional train. You wake up on the train with no memories of who you are or what you are doing on this train. Explore!  Explore each of the nooks and crannies of this 1950s-inspired luxury train (but between dimensions). Talk to each of the passengers, and find secret activities! Narrative!  Enjoy All Aboard! The Twilight Trains' blend of humorous and emotional storytelling. Spend time with such characters as the wacky Conductor, the kooky Bartender, and the quirky Attendant (who are definitely not the same character in a different hat). Along the way, you will learn the emotional story of the Felinis Family as you help them find their lost son, Ruckus. TRASHKETBALL!   Experience the high-octane thrill of our innovative mini-game, “TRASHKETBALL!” The goal is to throw trash into a trash bin and get the high-score (disclaimer: All Aboard! The Twilight Train does not record your score for throwing trash in a trash bin)
row.short_description: All Aboard! The Twilight Train is a first-person narrative-adventure set on an interdimensional train. Explore the train, talk to the passengers, drink carrot juice, and help fellow passengers make it to their destination off this weird train.

row.name: Songs of the Broken Crowns Playtest
呼~/huuu
row.detailed_description: 'Huuu~' is a 30-minute healing experience. During the days of recovery from illness, the protagonist begins to communicate with the wind. Guided by the breeze, they embark on a journey through the memories of the four seasons—healing old wounds and awakening the courage to reconcile with themselves. Blending natural aesthetics with adventure and puzzle-solving, the game introduces a unique form of natural interaction: breathing . Players take on the role of a breeze in Hoo~ , accompanying and aiding the protagonist on their journey. The wind has shape and emotion—every breath resonates with the game world. In the game, players control the character’s actions and environmental changes through the intensity and rhythm of their breath. Breathing directly influences the world’s dynamics: a gentle, long breath sets feathers dancing through the air; a steady, short puff pushes the character forward; and a warm exhale can awaken slumbering plants and spirits.
row.short_description: Huuu~ is a healing interactive narrative game where players become a breeze, using breath to guide and comfort the protagonist. Drifting through the four seasons, they join in a quiet journey of reflection, emotion, and inner healing.

row.name: Elysian Siege
row.detailed_description: Take on the role of Keziah! A newly ascended Enforcer whose duty is to carry out the will of her goddess, Anthea. In this action-fantasy platformer, you'll face deadly enemies and avoid dangerous traps as you delve into a divine temple to fulfill your sacred mission. ● Agile gameplay focused on movement and quick reactions ● A short yet satisfying traversal experience ● Challenging achievements for seasoned adventurers! Jump on enemies or dash through them with a deadly attack to defeat them. Bounce on walls, climb vines, and glide as you venture deeper into the temple, dodging threats with precision. Death is a lesson rather than something to fear — while inside the temple, you'll rise again by Anthea’s power until your task is complete. The temple spirits await your arrival. Save them from the evil corrupting your sacred land! Keziah’s mission is only just beginning… Are you ready to fulfill the divine will?
row.short_description: Stand in Keziah’s footsteps and heed the Divine Order. Jump your way through, reclaim your goddess’s temple, obliterate enemies, and find the Tear of Creation in this beautiful platformer game!

row.name: Tiris
row.detailed_description: Enter the darkness. Fight for his soul. In a world ravaged by the Emerald Plague, death is not the end... it’s only the beginning of corruption. In Tiris, you embody Liria, an alchemist and sorceress determined to defy death itself to save her beloved Narcis, turned into an abomination in the service of a dark Necromancer. Face hordes of infected, solve ancient puzzles, and unravel the cursed secrets of a disgraced cathedral. Isometric Twin-Stick Shooter Combine reflexes and strategy in a fast-paced, intense combat system with cover and shooting mechanics. Use alchemy, magic, and arcane weapons to face increasingly deadly enemies. Explore, Solve, and Survive Between battles, you'll face clearly designed yet profound puzzles that will test your wits in areas filled with traps, secrets, and hidden artifacts. A dark, melancholic and stylized world Discover a unique artistic universe: characters of heroic proportions with stylized textures, soft ambient lighting and decadent settings covered in fog and vegetation. A story of love, death, and redemption Immerse yourself in a tragic and heroic narrative: after the loss of Narcis, Liria embarks on an odyssey through the catacombs and cursed halls of a corrupted cathedral. Her mission: to gather the fragments of her beloved's soul and confront the monster they have turned him into. All while the corruption spreads and the Necromancer prepares his rise to immortality. Player Objective in the Demo Traverse three key areas of the Tiris Cathedral complex. Face the Necromancer and his hordes to win back your beloved. Can you restore his soul... or will you fall like so many others?
row.short_description: Infiltrate in Tiris Cathedral and recover your beloved's soul in this medieval, lowdark fantasy Top-Down Shooter. Deal with hordes of enemies, solve the puzzles that block your path, and free your loved one and the people from the tyranny of the Necromancer and his commanders.

row.name: Inside the Crow´s Nest
row.detailed_description: Inside the Crow 's Nest is a Survival Horror game inspired by old-school genre classics. You play as the Hunter, who awakens in a cell marked with strange symbols, trapped in a cult-infested monastery. To escape, you must survive horrifying cultists, uncover dark secrets, and solve intricate puzzles that block your escape. Nostalgic Survival Horror Feel: Experience tense, atmospheric gameplay with fixed camera angles and tank controls - an homage to the pioneers of the genre. Challenging, Rewarding Puzzles Collect clues, decipher their meaning, and use them to navigate and unlock new areas of the cursed monastery. Relentless Cultists and Monstrous Horrors Face off against twisted followers of The Forgotten One—inhuman abominations warped by devotion to their dark god. A Mystery Waiting to Be Uncovered Delve deep into the monastery’s haunted halls and piece together the chilling history of its inhabitants and their eldritch faith. Will the Hunter escape, or become the next sacrifice?
row.short_description: Inside the Crow's Nest is a game inspired by classic survival horror. Explore an ancient monastery, face the terrors hidden within its corridors, and search for a way to escape. Will you survive... or be hunted?
row.notes: Our game centers on an arcane cult that aims to resurrect an ancient deity. To accomplish this, they have kidnapped the protagonist. Their plan is to sacrifice him to summon a god who will unleash chaos and terror upon the Earth. The game features dark, eerie locations, mysterious figures whose state—alive or dead—is uncertain, enemies with features resembling cadaverous birds, and an environmental narrative in which stains and filth create a disturbing atmosphere. You will shoot your crossbow against the enemies, who will fall dead and disappear. And once you pick up the doomed dagger, you will hear unsettling whispers.
